companies.description:
Role Overview We are seeking exceptional early-career software engineers who aspire to build the next generation of AI-native software platforms, reusable software IP and intelligent enterprise solutions. As an Elite Technology Engineer you will combine strong full-stack engineering foundations with AI-first development practices to create production-grade software, domain-specific AI capabilities and reusable engineering assets that power the future of enterprise technology. You will work on real client programmes across industries, designing and delivering AI-native applications using modern cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools and software engineering best practices. Working alongside architects, product teams and AI specialists, you will help shape intelligent, scalable and continuously evolving software solutions. This role provides accelerated learning through structured AI certification pathways, exposure to leading AI ecosystems and hands-on experience developing reusable AI capabilities that create long-term client value.

companies.description:
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

Job Description
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

companies.description:
About Accenture Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. About the role : Skill - Strategy & Consulting Level - CL 12 - Associate Location - Gurugram/New Delhi/Mumbai/Bangalore/Kolkata/ Pune/Hyderabad/Chennai as applicable Travel Percentage - Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100% Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role: You will be working with our team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services that help our clients achieve their business objectives faster. This includes assisting your team in the following – 1. Identifying, assessing, and solving complex business problems for area of responsibility, where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. 2. Identifying a client’s high-level business needs and in the creation of detailed functional specs and other documentation, such as requirement traceability matrices, work-flow diagrams, and use-cases 3. Defining how our clients can leverage new technologies for greatest strategic impact in the digital world that supports business requirements and reduces costs 4. Solving key business problems and challenges by painting a picture of, and charting a journey from the current state to a “to-be” enterprise environment 5. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practice’s deep industry, Digital and business process acumen to leverage technology for greatest strategic impact. 6. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate, and implement programs. 7. Assisting our clients build the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. 8. Reimagine, build, and transform client business and operations by developing cutting edge assets, tool and methodologies, development of PoVs, research, white papers, support development of Go-to- market offerings. Your experience counts! 1. BE/B.Tech from Tier-1 institute. 2. Academic excellence - Demonstrate consistency throughout academic career. 3. Knowledge of Microsoft tools - PowerPoint, Excel, Word & MS Project 4. Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) along with any other foreign language is a plus. 5. Strategic and analytical thinker, effective and proactive problem solver 6. Aptitude to learn, problem solving, ability to think creatively to solve real global business problems. 7. Ability to seamlessly integrate and work collaboratively in fast-paced global environment. 8. Competence in building credibility and effective relationships with stakeholders Must have skills: • Knowledge of tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Microsoft Axis, Azure, AWS or any other data visualization platform • Proficiency in Japanese, German, French and Italian Language is a plus. • Effective presentation development and delivery skills to diverse stakeholders • Demonstrated leadership skills in projects or any other allied activities (e.g., college clubs, pro-bono volunteering) • Knowledge of programming language C++, Java, R, S-Plus, Python or another niche technical capability • Knowledge on key technology implementation solutions including MES, SAP, IOT, Analytics • Knowledge on after-market service operations including spare parts management, warranty management is a plus • Curiosity about AI and its business applications; willingness to build AI fluency on the job • Familiarity with AI/GenAI tools or platforms What’s in it for you? 1. An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients 2. Potential to co-create with strategy leaders, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, BI professionals to innovate solutions that leverage emerging technologies 3. Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen while growing your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities 4. Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization. Disclaimer 1. Accenture is committed to providing veteran job opportunities to our service men and women. 2. Accenture is an equal opportunity employer and I&D is a critical part of our talent agenda for PWD and LGBTQ candidates. 3. All selection decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 4. Please take note that, unless there is a formal offer of employment from Accenture, any communication made by Accenture in respect of open position/selection process or steps related thereto shall not be assumed or treated to be as a commitment or an offer of employment or guarantee of employment with Accenture 5. At Accenture, the health and well-being of our people, our clients and the community is our top priority. We are also committed to complying with all government safety protocols as we bring our people to our offices. Before onboarding, we strongly encourage you to take both doses of the COVID-19 vaccine as per government prescribed timelines. 6. Accenture has not authorized any agency, company or individual to either collect money or arrive on any monetary arrangement in exchange for a job at Accenture. Accenture's criterion for hiring candidates is merit. Any agency, company or individual offering employment with Accenture in exchange for money is misrepresenting their relationship with Accenture, which has not authorized any such action. If you are approached by any entity or individuals who demand money or any other form of compensation in return for a job offer at Accenture – even if they present themselves as representatives or employees of Accenture – please send the details to Accenture Business Ethics Line https://businessethicsline.com/accenture or india.fc.check@accenture.com 7. Accenture has not authorized its officials to either collect money, benefit(s) and or favour(s) of any kind from the college Placement committee, student body and or college administration for participating in campus recruitment events at the time of confirming Accenture’s participation in the same

Accordion is looking for motivated AI/ML Engineer 2 to join our new AI-augmented delivery pods: purpose-built teams that combine AI engineering, data science, and product management to accelerate value creation in PE ecosystem. About the company	Accordion is a global consulting firm and value creation partner for Private Equity firms and their portfolio companies. Through consulting rooted in data, technology and AI, we help clients drive value. Accordion works at the intersection of Private Equity sponsors and portfolio companies’ management teams across every stage of the investment lifecycle. We provide hands-on, execution-oriented support, driving value through the office of the CFO by building data and analytics capabilities and identifying and implementing strategic work, rooted in data and analytics and AI. Accordion is headquartered in New York City with 11 offices worldwide, including the India office based out of Hyderabad.

As a Data & AI Analyst 2 at Accordion will be working closely with the Project Manager and other Analysts/Engineers, on performing detailed business requirements analysis, executing complex data implementation, business intelligence and analytical projects, and defining processes to deliver robust analytical solutions consistently. Job Description
AiPrise is hiring a Software Engineer II (Full Stack – Frontend Focused) for its Engineering team in Bengaluru to build and scale its customer-facing products, including KYC/KYB onboarding flows, Web/Flutter/React Native SDKs, and case management platforms. The role involves developing frontend applications, building supporting backend APIs and database integrations, and owning features end-to-end from design and development to deployment. The engineer will focus on performance, responsive user experiences, cross-browser compatibility, and building reliable products in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.

companies.description:
AiPrise is hiring a Software Engineer II (Frontend) for its Engineering team in Bengaluru to build and own its customer-facing onboarding platform for KYC and KYB workflows. The role involves developing responsive React-based applications, implementing camera-based features such as ID capture, selfie verification and liveness detection, and maintaining Web, Flutter and React Native SDKs. The engineer will focus on performance optimisation, cross-browser and mobile compatibility, improving user experience and owning frontend features end-to-end, with opportunities to contribute to backend development.

Job Description
AiPrise is hiring Software Engineer II for its Engineering team in Bengaluru to build and scale its AI-powered compliance orchestration platform. The role involves designing and developing scalable backend APIs, microservices, data pipelines, vendor integrations, and customer-facing tools, while independently owning features end-to-end from requirement gathering to deployment. The engineer will drive technical decisions, improve system performance and reliability, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and mentor junior engineers while building solutions for KYC, KYB, AML, fraud detection, and risk assessment workflows.

AiPrise is hiring Software Engineer II for its Engineering team in Bengaluru to build and scale its AI-powered compliance orchestration platform. companies.description:
We’re hiring a Software Engineer I to help build and scale the core platform behind AiPrise’s compliance orchestration and AI agent systems. This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You’ll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate, across our case management product, vendor integrations, orchestration APIs, and customer facing tools. You’ll be in the trenches with founders and a fast moving team, turning messy real world compliance problems into clean, reliable systems. If you’re a hungry engineer who wants real ownership, high impact, and a product that gets used in production every day, you’ll love this.

Job Description
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: * Design and development of robust, efficient and real-time algorithms for Analysis and Classification of Medical Images using state-of-art techniques from Image Processing, Pattern Recognition, Computer Vision and Machine Learning. * Development of innovative solutions for various problems related to Segmentation, Detection, classification and quantification of high resolution (~50K x 50K) coloured images for applications in Digital Pathology. * Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design. Expertise in one or more of: Python, C, C++, or Java. * Strong problem solving skills. Hands on, get-it-done attitude * Design of efficient models in Machine Learning / Deep Learning for accurate analysis and classification of High resolution Images. * To learn and update oneself on the emerging trends of technology and apply them in the projects for better results leading to publications and patents. * Explore new areas of Expert Systems, Cognitive Computing, Quantum Computing, Computational Photography etc.

We leverage machine and deep learning techniques to develop diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive solutions. Our solutions provide cost benefits in the pharmaceutical domain, by speeding up pre-clinical drug development timelines, and by enhancing the efficiency of environmental monitoring required in manufacturing. In healthcare applications, our solutions improve treatment outcomes by aiding disease stratification and enabling management protocols tailored to individual patients. Our clients and partners include leading hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, CROs, and research labs around the world. Our deep learning platforms with existing network models and pre-built AI applications provide the foundation for fast customizations and help tackle any unique challenges in your image analysis and study management workflows. With absolute flexibility to choose and use the latest technologies, our AppDev team comes up with best-in-class enhancements and feature upgrades which are highly appreciated by the customers.

companies.role: Associate Engineer - Industrialisation_Robotics and Data Analytics_UG
companies.description:
Airbus is building the future of aviation, and data is our engine. We are looking for passionate engineering students who want to bridge the gap between physical aerospace hardware and digital intelligence. In this role, you won’t just be coding; you will be applying data-driven insights to real-world industrial challenges—from analyzing sensor data to optimizing shopfloor processes. This involves both developing Data Foundations , AI models and industrializing these algorithms into functional software solutions that our teams can use daily. ● Your Mission : You will join a dynamic project focused on Industry 4.0. You will help us translate raw shopfloor signals into actionable data models and AI to help our engineers make smarter, faster decisions. Whether it’s standardizing data for robots or identifying patterns in manufacturing signals, your work will directly impact how we make it fly. Beyond modeling, you will bridge the gap between proof-of-concept and production, helping to develop and industrialize AI algorithms into usable software applications. ● Who You Are : You are a "Data-fluent" Engineer. You are eager to learn how to acquire Industrial operational Data from machines to build data foundations and industrialize algorithms into reliable software solutions. You have a logical mindset, a passion for industrial systems, and a curiosity about how Data Analytics can be applied to Shop Floor processes. Core Competencies (Must-Haves): ● A Logical Thinker: You enjoy breaking down complex problems into data-driven solutions. ● Proficient with Data Basics: You have hands-on with Python scripting (e.g., using Pandas or NumPy to clean/analyze data sets). ● Technically Curious: You understand that data is more than just numbers—it’s signals and time-series data from hardware and software. ● An Effective Communicator: You can explain your findings simply and document your process clearly for the team. ● Industrialization Mindset: Once the core modeling is done, you have the drive to progress those solutions into deployable software applications. ● Familiarity with Data structures ● Familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e.g., you’ve played with basic models in scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).

Responsibilities: ● The jobholder will be responsible for understand the requirements, performing the concept/Digital mockup studies, trade-off studies, technical repercussion assessment, detail design & integration, check & release of Engineering drawings and Bill of materials and Non-Conformity management ● Ability to define, configure, design and integrate cabin interiors and system installations allowing to build and deliver the aircrafts as per the customer requirements. ● Application of the new technologies while building new aircraft definitions. ● Propose and implement the improvements in terms of Cabin and System Installation with impact on weight, lead-time and cost of the aircraft. ● Network & liaise with a broad range of Airframe, Systems and Cabin sub-domains including Industrialization, Standardization, Research & Environment Integration. ● Propose and implement digitization ideas through new ways of working. ● Reporting of all activities as per Airbus procedures. ● Identify improvement opportunities, analyze the current situation and potential benefits, apply lean principles by selection of appropriate approaches, methods and tools, and lead or contribute (at expected level according to responsibilities, role or perimeter) to deliver business improvements. ● Willing to travel internationally and work in a multi-cultural environment on a need basis. Soft skills: ● Very good communication and presentation skills ● Ability to demonstrate effectiveness in holding conversations with customers and customer-centric outreach. ● Ability to work in a fast paced environment with changing priorities, requirements and ramp-up of skills. ● Demonstrate agility and autonomy in a transnational environment. ● Demonstrate ability to work as a team in a highly collaborative environment. ● Ability to coordinate the efforts of a large team of diverse specialists & experts. ● Ability to lead in an environment of constant change involving multiple internal processes.

Job Description
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon

companies.description:
The role involves contributing to software quality assurance through structured testing, automation, debugging, and validation of software and system-level components associated with semiconductor products. Responsibilities include understanding software requirements, developing test plans, test cases and scenarios, executing functional, regression, integration, and system-level testing, developing and maintaining automated test scripts using Python or other programming languages, identifying, reproducing, documenting, and tracking software defects, and collaborating with developers to investigate issues and validate fixes. The role also involves supporting test automation frameworks and continuous integration workflows while maintaining test reports, documentation, and quality metrics. Candidates should have strong programming fundamentals in Python, C, C++, or similar languages, an understanding of software testing principles and test case design, and basic knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. Academic projects or internships involving software testing or automation, familiarity with Linux/Unix, Git, shell scripting, and command-line tools, exposure to automation frameworks, APIs, or CI/CD pipelines, and an interest in embedded software, firmware, system validation, or semiconductor-related software will be preferred. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills are essential.

companies.description:
The goal for our GET program in the Department of Product Ownership is to forge the future leaders of electric mobility. We are seeking a select few to navigate through the complexities of building technology and manufacturing products with a first principles approach, and be at the forefront of driving Ather’s mission. This is not a product management role, which has a completely different job description. Product Owners at Ather are in-charge of delivering engineering projects / programs, balancing time, cost and quality. Over 24 months, you will embark on a high-velocity journey through Ather’s development ecosystem. It is a fully immersive experience to build a product owner from the ground up. Each rotation is a deep dive into a specific function, where you will be given meaningful, technically challenging work that supports critical business priorities ○ Phase 1: Engineering and validation - Hands-on understanding of what it takes to build our products - vehicle engineering, powertrain dynamics, battery technology and software. Own a component or part of code and ship it to our customers. Understand the way we build our technology fundamentally ○ Phase 2: Industrialisation and supply-chain - Work alongside our manufacturing engineering and supply-chain teams to take a design from a prototype to industrialising it for scale. Learn what it takes to work with partner suppliers, and the considerations (financial, operational and technical) at play for manufacturing parts that need to be supplied at scale at utmost reliability ○ Phase 3: Financial acumen - get acquainted with financial tools that help to do what it takes to run development operations including budgeting, setting PnL targets, technology benchmarking, zero-based costing, and writing out compelling business cases for pitching newer ideas. ● Post an assessment at the end of 2 years including technical depth as well as soft skills such as the ability to negotiate, lead without formal authority and being comfortable working with ambiguity, you shall commence work as a Product Owner / Associate Product Owner for one of our modules ● As a Product Owner, you will take charge of a cross-functional development team to define its roadmap in alignment with Ather’s vision and near-term objectives, pitch your roadmap to the upper management to obtain resources to fund your projects, and then get into the weeds with the relevant cross-functional teams and deliver those projects. Along the way, you will have to set priorities, make many micro-decisions in terms of where to take risks and where not to by assessing trade-off’s, decide whether to outsource a certain aspect of the project or do it in-house, negotiate with various stakeholders across the board on specifications / costs / manufacturing strategy / timelines, and inspire your team to achieve exceptional results in a way that is uniquely Ather

Job Description
The goal for our GET program in the Department of Product Ownership is to forge the future leaders of electric mobility. We are seeking a select few to navigate through the complexities of building technology and manufacturing products with a first principles approach, and be at the forefront of driving Ather’s mission. This is not a product management role, which has a completely different job description. Product Owners at Ather are in-charge of delivering engineering projects / programs, balancing time, cost and quality. Over 24 months, you will embark on a high-velocity journey through Ather’s development ecosystem. It is a fully immersive experience to build a product owner from the ground up. Each rotation is a deep dive into a specific function, where you will be given meaningful, technically challenging work that supports critical business priorities ○ Phase 1: Engineering and validation - Hands-on understanding of what it takes to build our products - vehicle engineering, powertrain dynamics, battery technology and software. Own a component or part of code and ship it to our customers. Understand the way we build our technology fundamentally ○ Phase 2: Industrialisation and supply-chain - Work alongside our manufacturing engineering and supply-chain teams to take a design from a prototype to industrialising it for scale. Learn what it takes to work with partner suppliers, and the considerations (financial, operational and technical) at play for manufacturing parts that need to be supplied at scale at utmost reliability ○ Phase 3: Financial acumen - get acquainted with financial tools that help to do what it takes to run development operations including budgeting, setting PnL targets, technology benchmarking, zero-based costing, and writing out compelling business cases for pitching newer ideas. ● Post an assessment at the end of 2 years including technical depth as well as soft skills such as the ability to negotiate, lead without formal authority and being comfortable working with ambiguity, you shall commence work as a Product Owner / Associate Product Owner for one of our modules ● As a Product Owner, you will take charge of a cross-functional development team to define its roadmap in alignment with Ather’s vision and near-term objectives, pitch your roadmap to the upper management to obtain resources to fund your projects, and then get into the weeds with the relevant cross-functional teams and deliver those projects. Along the way, you will have to set priorities, make many micro-decisions in terms of where to take risks and where not to by assessing trade-off’s, decide whether to outsource a certain aspect of the project or do it in-house, negotiate with various stakeholders across the board on specifications / costs / manufacturing strategy / timelines, and inspire your team to achieve exceptional results in a way that is uniquely Ather

companies.description:
.As a Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) in Ather's Data Office, the candidate will work on developing and deploying machine learning and deep learning models to improve electric vehicle reliability, predictive maintenance, and spare parts demand forecasting. The role involves building end-to-end data pipelines using Python, SQL, Databricks, and cloud platforms, covering data ingestion, model development, deployment, and real-time monitoring. Key responsibilities include analyzing time-series telematics, vehicle usage, and service data to identify degradation patterns, anomalies, and early failure indicators using statistical techniques, supervised and unsupervised learning, and predictive modelling. The candidate will contribute to Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation, Weibull analysis, failure rate estimation, and reliability growth tracking while developing automated dashboards for failure trends, quality KPIs, and predictive alerts. The role also involves collaborating with engineering and design teams to map failure modes to data signals, establish reliability targets, and optimize testing and monitoring processes.

companies.description:
As an Engineer in Ather's Module Quality team, the candidate will be responsible for ensuring quality standards throughout new product development and sustenance phases. The role involves identifying and mitigating quality risks at vehicle and component levels, ensuring adherence to Gate review processes, and reviewing and signing off on Design Verification Plans (DVP) and test results. Key responsibilities include overseeing component quality during development and vehicle builds, conducting systematic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and driving structured bug resolution using 8D methodology. The candidate will ensure compliance with quality systems such as FMEA, APQP, PPAP, PSW, drawing release processes, and homologation testing while monitoring key quality indicators, including IPH, CPV, and PPM. The role also involves managing A-COP plans, evaluating change requests and deviations, and collaborating with Design, Sourcing, Manufacturing Engineering, and testing teams to improve product quality, process robustness, and overall vehicle reliability

Job Description
As an Engineer in Ather's Module Quality team, the candidate will be responsible for ensuring quality standards throughout new product development and sustenance phases. The role involves identifying and mitigating quality risks at vehicle and component levels, ensuring adherence to Gate review processes, and reviewing and signing off on Design Verification Plans (DVP) and test results. Key responsibilities include overseeing component quality during development and vehicle builds, conducting systematic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and driving structured bug resolution using 8D methodology. The candidate will ensure compliance with quality systems such as FMEA, APQP, PPAP, PSW, drawing release processes, and homologation testing while monitoring key quality indicators, including IPH, CPV, and PPM. The role also involves managing A-COP plans, evaluating change requests and deviations, and collaborating with Design, Sourcing, Manufacturing Engineering, and testing teams to improve product quality, process robustness, and overall vehicle reliability

companies.description:
As a Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) in Ather's Department of Chief Engineering, the candidate will work on multidisciplinary engineering problems across mechanical, electrical, and software systems through a structured two-year rotational programme. The role involves working with cross-functional teams on various electric vehicle components and systems, contributing to simulation, design, characterization, testing, and project delivery. Candidates will gain hands-on experience with CAD, coding, schematics, datasheets, and diagnostic tools while developing an understanding of EV technologies, system integration, and engineering programme management. Based on satisfactory performance and assessment during the rotational programme, candidates may be considered for Module Lead or Assistant Module Lead positions, taking responsibility for specific EV modules.

We are seeking a talented and innovative AI/ML Software Engineer to join our technology team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions to solve complex business problems and enhance user experiences. You will collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to build scalable, production-ready AI systems. Responsibilities - Develop, train, and optimize machine learning models. - Build and deploy AI-driven applications and services. - Work with large datasets for data preprocessing and feature engineering. - Integrate machine learning models into production systems. - Monitor model performance and continuously improve accuracy. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement AI solutions. - Stay updated with the latest AI/ML research, frameworks, and tools. Qualifications & Skills - Strong programming skills in Python or similar languages. - Knowledge of TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn. - Understanding of machine learning algorithms and deep learning concepts. - Experience in data processing, analysis, and feature engineering. - Knowledge of APIs and backend integration. - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Required Courses - Python for Intermediate - Advanced Python Programming

Job Description
**About the Position:** We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to collect, analyze, and interpret data to support business decision-making. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in statistics, SQL, and data visualization, with an eagerness to learn and apply analytical skills to real-world business challenges. **Key Responsibilities:** - Collect, clean, and analyze datasets from multiple sources. - Identify trends, patterns, and insights to support business decisions. - Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. - Use SQL to query, manipulate, and validate data. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand reporting requirements. - Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. - Assist in developing data models and automating recurring reports. - Document analytical processes and perform data quality checks. - Present findings and actionable insights to stakeholders.

About the company	Auroville Investment Management (“AIM") is an investment management firm headquartered in Hong Kong SAR, China with offices in Mumbai and New Delhi in India. While AIM specializes in investments in the Asia Pacific region, it combines world-class financial expertise and talent from the East and West, to deliver attractive absolute returns over time. Auroville Investment Management (HK) Limited was formerly registered with the SFC in HK holding a Type 9 Asset management license, and prior with the SEC in the US as a Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) and SEBI in India as a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) license holder. Founded in 2017 by Amar Anand, it has brought together experienced PMs and analysts from leading investment firms globally. Investment team is assisted by a high caliber Data Science, Trading, and Operations team.

**About the Position:** We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to collect, analyze, and interpret data to support business decision-making. Job Description
About the Position: We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Product Manager to join our Business & Management team. The ideal candidate should have at least 2 years of experience in product management, with the ability to develop and enhance products based on customer needs and market trends. Key Responsibilities: - Plan and implement new products and features based on market research and business strategy. - Collaborate with engineering, marketing, sales, and customer service teams. - Define product success metrics, analyze performance, and incorporate customer feedback. - Manage the product lifecycle from conception and development to launch and post-launch evaluation. - Develop product roadmaps aligned with business objectives. - Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities. - Gather customer insights and prioritize product features and development backlogs. - Prepare performance reports and present findings to stakeholders. - Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and quality standards. Required Qualifications and Skills: - Minimum 2 years of experience in product management or a similar role. - Strong understanding of market research, data analysis, and user experience design. - Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. - Knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools. - Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities. - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field. About the company	Auroville Investment Management (“AIM") is an investment management firm headquartered in Hong Kong SAR, China with offices in Mumbai and New Delhi in India. While AIM specializes in investments in the Asia Pacific region, it combines world-class financial expertise and talent from the East and West, to deliver attractive absolute returns over time. Auroville Investment Management (HK) Limited was formerly registered with the SFC in HK holding a Type 9 Asset management license, and prior with the SEC in the US as a Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) and SEBI in India as a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) license holder. Founded in 2017 by Amar Anand, it has brought together experienced PMs and analysts from leading investment firms globally. Investment team is assisted by a high caliber Data Science, Trading, and Operations team.

**About the Position:** We are seeking a motivated and commercially minded Sales & Business Development Associate to support revenue growth, client acquisition, and strategic partnership development across our technology businesses. Research market opportunities, customer requirements, and potential strategic partnerships. - Support sales initiatives across blockchain, digital infrastructure, education technology, and recruitment technology. - Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and customer satisfaction. - Maintain accurate sales records, pipeline information, and client interactions in CRM systems. - Assist in preparing sales presentations, proposals, reports, and client communications. - Contribute to revenue targets, lead conversion, and business growth initiatives. - Represent the company professionally in client meetings, networking events, and industry forums. **Required Qualifications and Skills:** - Basic understanding of market research, lead generation, and sales processes. - Good negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. - Ability to build relationships, learn quickly, and work collaboratively. - About the company	Auroville Investment Management (“AIM") is an investment management firm headquartered in Hong Kong SAR, China with offices in Mumbai and New Delhi in India. While AIM specializes in investments in the Asia Pacific region, it combines world-class financial expertise and talent from the East and West, to deliver attractive absolute returns over time. Auroville Investment Management (HK) Limited was formerly registered with the SFC in HK holding a Type 9 Asset management license, and prior with the SEC in the US as a Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) and SEBI in India as a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) license holder. Founded in 2017 by Amar Anand, it has brought together experienced PMs and analysts from leading investment firms globally. Investment team is assisted by a high caliber Data Science, Trading, and Operations team.

Job Description
**About the Position:** We are looking for a skilled Back End Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance API solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, Django, AWS, backend architecture, and database management, with the ability to build reliable backend systems that support our technology platforms. **Key Responsibilities:** - Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based APIs using the Django framework. - Build scalable and high-performance backend services following coding best practices. - Implement and manage AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, and API Gateway. - Design and optimize backend architecture for scalability, flexibility, security, and cost efficiency. - Manage SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design, data storage, and query optimization. - Use Git and GitHub for version control, code collaboration, and source management. - Integrate backend APIs with frontend applications and Node.js services as required. - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, deployment, and release processes. - Conduct code reviews and implement testing strategies to ensure code quality and reliability. - Monitor backend performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement security best practices. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and efficient software solutions. **Required Qualifications:** - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. - Strong proficiency in Python and the Django framework. - Knowledge of AWS services and cloud-based server architecture. - Understanding of REST API development and backend system design. - Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL database management. - Familiarity with Node.js, Git, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines. - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. - Ability to work collaboratively in a remote development environment. **Work Mode:** Remote **Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description
**About the Position:** We are seeking an enthusiastic Full Stack Developer to build and maintain web applications with responsive frontends and reliable backend functionality. This entry-level opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates eager to work with modern technologies and develop their skills across the full software development lifecycle. **Key Responsibilities:** - Collaborate with developers and product managers to design and implement software solutions. - Develop responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. - Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic. - Design, manage, and optimize databases using SQL or NoSQL technologies. - Test, debug, and troubleshoot applications to ensure performance and reliability. - Implement mobile-responsive designs and basic security practices. - Integrate frontend and backend components for seamless functionality. - Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards. - Prepare technical documentation and maintain existing applications. - Learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.

While AIM specializes in investments in the Asia Pacific region, it combines world-class financial expertise and talent from the East and West, to deliver attractive absolute returns over time. Auroville Investment Management (HK) Limited was formerly registered with the SFC in HK holding a Type 9 Asset management license, and prior with the SEC in the US as a Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) and SEBI in India as a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) license holder. We cover the entire Risk Management spectrum from Credit risk, Market risk and Operational risk along with regulatory consulting like Basel II/III, IFRS 9, FRTB, ICAAP, Stress Testing etc. We have served 100+ clients in multiple countries across the globe over the last 10 years with more than 200+ engagements in risk, analytics & compliance area, creating a niche for ourselves by providing our clients best in class solutions, while competing with the best in the industry. We have gained valuable experience over time while working with leading banks and financial institutions across the globe.

About the company	Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale. We bridge the gap between advanced artificial intelligence and complex real-world operations, applying deep tech, computer vision, and autonomous intelligence to critical industrial environments.

companies.description:
Flying Start Graduate Trainee Engineer 2027: Research & Development From “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian,” Bajaj Auto has spent eight decades building motorcycles the world rides. Today that means more than 20 million on roads across 108 countries, over 1,200 patents, and one of Asia’s most advanced automotive R&D centres. We are India’s No.1 motorcycle exporter and home to brands like Pulsar, Dominar, Chetak, KTM and Triumph. Flying Start, our Graduate Trainee Engineer programme, is the talent pipeline behind every function in the company, and several of those functions are now led by engineers who joined as GTEs straight from campus. For 2027, we are inviting final-year engineering students to join R&D at Bajaj Auto Ltd. (BAL) and Bajaj Auto Technology Ltd. (BATL). As an R&D GTE, you will take real products from concept to road. In BAL R&D, you will own vehicle and component design through to production readiness. You will benchmark competitors to set weight, cost and performance targets, build 3D layouts and hard points, and optimise designs through CAE and CFD simulation before a prototype is ever built. You will also plan and run design verification and validation, test components and full vehicles for durability, NVH and ride performance, and support prototype and pilot builds through to SOP. In BATL R&D, you will design, prototype and validate EV hardware and software alongside multidisciplinary teams working on motors, batteries, power electronics and control systems. That work involves applying model-based design and simulation, and analysing test data to make next-generation EVs more efficient, reliable and safe. We are looking for engineers with strong fundamentals in mechanical, automobile, electrical or related disciplines, sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and across teams. Knowledge of vehicle systems and validation methods will serve you well on the vehicle side. On the EV side, a grounding in power electronics, control or embedded systems helps, and familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink, Python/C/C++, PCB design or motor modelling is a plus. In return, you get world-class labs and EV platforms, serious mentorship, early ownership, a culture where filing patents is part of the job, and the pride of seeing your work on roads around the world. As Kamalnayan Bajaj put it, “Do what you think is best but be the best in what you do.” Come help build Hamara Kal, the future of mobility. #JoinTheTribe

Flying Start Graduate Trainee Engineer 2027: Research & Development From “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian,” Bajaj Auto has spent eight decades building motorcycles the world rides. Today that means more than 20 million on roads across 108 countries, over 1,200 patents, and one of Asia’s most advanced automotive R&D centres. We are India’s No.1 motorcycle exporter and home to brands like Pulsar, Dominar, Chetak, KTM and Triumph. Flying Start, our Graduate Trainee Engineer programme, is the talent pipeline behind every function in the company, and several of those functions are now led by engineers who joined as GTEs straight from campus. For 2027, we are inviting final-year engineering students to join R&D at Bajaj Auto Ltd. (BAL) and Bajaj Auto Technology Ltd. (BATL). As an R&D GTE, you will take real products from concept to road. In BAL R&D, you will own vehicle and component design through to production readiness. You will benchmark competitors to set weight, cost and performance targets, build 3D layouts and hard points, and optimise designs through CAE and CFD simulation before a prototype is ever built. You will also plan and run design verification and validation, test components and full vehicles for durability, NVH and ride performance, and support prototype and pilot builds through to SOP. In BATL R&D, you will design, prototype and validate EV hardware and software alongside multidisciplinary teams working on motors, batteries, power electronics and control systems. That work involves applying model-based design and simulation, and analysing test data to make next-generation EVs more efficient, reliable and safe. We are looking for engineers with strong fundamentals in mechanical, automobile, electrical or related disciplines, sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and across teams. Knowledge of vehicle systems and validation methods will serve you well on the vehicle side. On the EV side, a grounding in power electronics, control or embedded systems helps, and familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink, Python/C/C++, PCB design or motor modelling is a plus. In return, you get world-class labs and EV platforms, serious mentorship, early ownership, a culture where filing patents is part of the job, and the pride of seeing your work on roads around the world. As Kamalnayan Bajaj put it, “Do what you think is best but be the best in what you do.” Come help build Hamara Kal, the future of mobility. #JoinTheTribe

The BlackBuck Leadership Program (BLP) is an elite incubation track for passionate builders. This program bypasses traditional hierarchies and gives you immediate ownership of mission-critical mandates that shape the future of Indian logistics. • 12-Week Immersive Bootcamp: Experience the end-to-end user lifecycle on the frontline. You will travel across India to drive sales and deliver direct customer service, building the unvarnished insights required to command our business tracks. • Multi-Stint Exposure: Take on diverse cross-functional roles across different departments. This fast-paced rotation builds a well-rounded business perspective and comprehensive domain mastery early in your career. • High Ownership Bias & Rapid Grooming: Potential beats tenure. We measure success by velocity, grit, and execution. This program serves as a high-velocity framework to compress a decade of career growth into years, grooming you to lead our business independently. Post-induction, you will rotate through multiple high-impact stints over 24 to 48 months, before narrowing into leadership roles. This rotation builds the comprehensive domain expertise required to independently own, drive, and lead high-impact leadership roles at BlackBuck. What type of roles does BlackBuck offer? The roles can evolve around the following areas (but are not limited to): • Category Management: Design compelling value propositions, identify untapped market opportunities, and shape product offerings that solve critical customer needs. • Operations Management: Lead a particular region with large teams reporting into you to deliver growth in sale/revenue and PnL for different businesses. • Sales Excellence: Unlock hyper-growth by optimizing sales strategies, sharp execution, and building highly scalable commercial engines. • Program Management: Turn big ideas into reality by leading high-stakes strategic initiatives, aligning cross-functional teams, and delivering clear business outcomes. • Business Strategy: Evaluate emerging/new business models from first principles, design the operational architecture to execute them flawlessly, and turn conceptual frameworks into highly profitable business verticals. Who is the Right Fit? • First-Principles Problem Solvers: You have the analytical stamina to break down chaotic, real-world challenges and iterate until solved. • Real-World Experience: You are excited to step out of your comfort zone and hustle on the ground to get things done. • Resilience: You treat execution setbacks as debugging loops—you optimize, patch the logic, and ship a better solution the next day. • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility, proactively identify problems and drive solutions without waiting for instructions. You take accountability for outcomes and stay persistent in getting things done. A few Clarifications for Careers at BlackBuck • Homegrown Leaders First: We fundamentally value and promote homegrown talent. The BLP is explicitly built to identify early-career builders and groom you into the future business leaders at BlackBuck. • Branch Agnostic: Your engineering discipline will not dictate your final role. We prioritize your logical framing over a specific degree. • Radical Parity: MBA vs. non-MBA graduates are treated completely on par for compensation, role gravity, and career growth. • Impact Over Seniority: You don't need to wait your turn. Freshers get the playground to create real impact from Day 1.

You will travel across India to drive sales and deliver direct customer service, building the unvarnished insights required to command our business tracks. • Multi-Stint Exposure: Take on diverse cross-functional roles across different departments. This fast-paced rotation builds a well-rounded business perspective and comprehensive domain mastery early in your career. • High Ownership Bias & Rapid Grooming: Potential beats tenure. We measure success by velocity, grit, and execution. This program serves as a high-velocity framework to compress a decade of career growth into years, grooming you to lead our business independently. Post-induction, you will rotate through multiple high-impact stints over 24 to 48 months, before narrowing into leadership roles. This rotation builds the comprehensive domain expertise required to independently own, drive, and lead high-impact leadership roles at BlackBuck. What type of roles does BlackBuck offer? The roles can evolve around the following areas (but are not limited to): • Category Management: Design compelling value propositions, identify untapped market opportunities, and shape product offerings that solve critical customer needs. • Operations Management: Lead a particular region with large teams reporting into you to deliver growth in sale/revenue and PnL for different businesses. • Sales Excellence: Unlock hyper-growth by optimizing sales strategies, sharp execution, and building highly scalable commercial engines. • Program Management: Turn big ideas into reality by leading high-stakes strategic initiatives, aligning cross-functional teams, and delivering clear business outcomes. • Business Strategy: Evaluate emerging/new business models from first principles, design the operational architecture to execute them flawlessly, and turn conceptual frameworks into highly profitable business verticals. Who is the Right Fit? • First-Principles Problem Solvers: You have the analytical stamina to break down chaotic, real-world challenges and iterate until solved. • Real-World Experience: You are excited to step out of your comfort zone and hustle on the ground to get things done. • Resilience: You treat execution setbacks as debugging loops—you optimize, patch the logic, and ship a better solution the next day. • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility, proactively identify problems and drive solutions without waiting for instructions. You take accountability for outcomes and stay persistent in getting things done. A few Clarifications for Careers at BlackBuck • Homegrown Leaders First: We fundamentally value and promote homegrown talent. The BLP is explicitly built to identify early-career builders and groom you into the future business leaders at BlackBuck. • Branch Agnostic: Your engineering discipline will not dictate your final role. We prioritize your logical framing over a specific degree. • Radical Parity: MBA vs. non-MBA graduates are treated completely on par for compensation, role gravity, and career growth. • Impact Over Seniority: You don't need to wait your turn. Role – Aladdin Data Engineering Analyst Locations: Gurgaon, Mumbai, and Bangalore, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, our purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients invest to achieve meaningful goals—preparing for retirement, funding education, purchasing homes, and building businesses. These investments also support the global economy by financing infrastructure and driving innovation. Our people are our greatest investment. We are committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and forward thinking workplace where individuals are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. To learn more, visit www.blackrock.com. About the Aladdin Data Graduate Program The Aladdin Data Graduate Program is designed for recent graduates who are passionate about data, technology, and innovation. As a graduate hire, you will contribute to meaningful, real-world projects that support BlackRock's Aladdin platform—a leading investment management and operations system used by financial institutions around the world. Based on your interests and experience, you may be aligned with one of the following engineering tracks: • Data Engineer: Build scalable data pipelines while supporting data quality, governance, and reliability. • Private Markets Engineer: Develop data and analytics solutions tailored to the unique requirements of private markets. • Product Engineer: Help shape product capabilities and user experiences through data-driven insights and engineering solutions. What You'll Do As a graduate hire, you will have the opportunity to: • Understand business and engineering requirements and translate them into focused, testable AI or data solutions. • Work with structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, files, documents, and enterprise systems. • Develop prototypes for use cases such as document extraction, information classification, semantic search, retrieval, summarization, and workflow automation. • Prepare data for machine-learning and generative-AI applications through ingestion, transformation, validation, metadata management, and quality checks. • Build and test solutions using technologies such as Python, Java, Spark, data stores, APIs, and relevant AI or natural-language-processing frameworks. • Create evaluation datasets and assess AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, reliability, and common failure patterns. • Add appropriate logging, monitoring, validation, and human-review steps to improve the operational reliability of AI-enabled workflows. • Collaborate with engineers, data specialists, product teams, and other technology partners to refine solutions through feedback and testing. • Document technical decisions, experimental results, limitations, and recommended next steps. • Present your work through demonstrations, design discussions, team forums, hackathons, and innovation challenges. • Take ownership of a defined project from initial exploration through implementation, testing, documentation, and handover. Role – Aladdin Data Engineering Analyst Locations: Gurgaon, Mumbai, and Bangalore, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, our purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients invest to achieve meaningful goals—preparing for retirement, funding education, purchasing homes, and building businesses. These investments also support the global economy by financing infrastructure and driving innovation. Our people are our greatest investment. We are committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and forward thinking workplace where individuals are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. To learn more, visit www.blackrock.com. About the Aladdin Data Graduate Program The Aladdin Data Graduate Program is designed for recent graduates who are passionate about data, technology, and innovation. As a graduate hire, you will contribute to meaningful, real-world projects that support BlackRock's Aladdin platform—a leading investment management and operations system used by financial institutions around the world. Based on your interests and experience, you may be aligned with one of the following engineering tracks: • Data Engineer: Build scalable data pipelines while supporting data quality, governance, and reliability. • Private Markets Engineer: Develop data and analytics solutions tailored to the unique requirements of private markets. • Product Engineer: Help shape product capabilities and user experiences through data-driven insights and engineering solutions. What You'll Do As a graduate hire, you will have the opportunity to: • Understand business and engineering requirements and translate them into focused, testable AI or data solutions. • Work with structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, files, documents, and enterprise systems. • Develop prototypes for use cases such as document extraction, information classification, semantic search, retrieval, summarization, and workflow automation. • Prepare data for machine-learning and generative-AI applications through ingestion, transformation, validation, metadata management, and quality checks. • Build and test solutions using technologies such as Python, Java, Spark, data stores, APIs, and relevant AI or natural-language-processing frameworks. • Create evaluation datasets and assess AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, reliability, and common failure patterns. • Add appropriate logging, monitoring, validation, and human-review steps to improve the operational reliability of AI-enabled workflows. • Collaborate with engineers, data specialists, product teams, and other technology partners to refine solutions through feedback and testing. • Document technical decisions, experimental results, limitations, and recommended next steps. • Present your work through demonstrations, design discussions, team forums, hackathons, and innovation challenges. • Take ownership of a defined project from initial exploration through implementation, testing, documentation, and handover. What We're Looking For We welcome applications from graduates who demonstrate: • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for technology and continuous learning. • An understanding of object-oriented design and software development principles. • Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, data engineering frameworks, or related tools—considered an advantage. • Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills. • A strong commitment to product quality, reliability, and user experience. Learning and Development As an Aladdin Data Graduate Hire, you will benefit from a supportive and engaging learning environment that includes: • Experience within a specialized technology stream, complemented by broader exposure through networking and cross-functional project work. • Access to BlackRock Academies, mentorship programs, career coaching, and professional-development resources. • Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and participate in internal forums, events, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Equal Opportunity Employer BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Description
Role – AI & ML Engineer (Aladdin Engineering) Analyst Locations: Gurgaon and Mumbai, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s education, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support small and large businesses; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock | Twitter: @blackrock | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock Our team is known for: • Being passionate about technology and solving complex problems • Being from diverse industries and academic backgrounds • Developing in Java, Python, Cassandra, Kubernetes, Azure, Kafka, Docker, a host of languages and open-source technologies • Domain SMEs to build, test and provide 24/7 support for Aladdin • Being technology leaders that unlock incremental innovation and drive technology culture at BlackRock What We Are Looking For We seek high-caliber talent with exceptional analytical aptitude, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for solving complex challenges. Successful candidates combine strong quantitative and technical capabilities with the ability to think critically, learn rapidly, and deliver meaningful outcomes in dynamic environments. Candidates should possess: • Outstanding academic achievement and a consistent record of excellence. • Strong analytical, quantitative, and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex challenges from first principles. • Strong foundations in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or related quantitative disciplines. • Understanding of core machine-learning concepts including model training, generalization, feature representation, evaluation, optimization, and experimentation. • Ability to program in Python and familiarity with modern software-engineering practices; exposure to ML frameworks, LLMs, retrieval systems, or AI application development is advantageous. • Ability to reason about probabilistic or non-deterministic systems, design meaningful evaluations, analyze failure modes, and improve solution quality iteratively. • Curiosity and ability to develop expertise across business, technology, and product domains. • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. • A growth mindset, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and innovation Key Responsibilities • Work on complex, high-impact engineering and business problems spanning AI-native solutions, AI-enabled applications, and foundational engineering that enables broader AI adoption. • Apply data-driven and first-principles thinking to design scalable solutions to business and technology challenges. • Design, build, evaluate and productionize platforms, systems, analytical solutions, models, and workflows that support informed decision-making and deliver measurable impact. • Apply AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI to engineering, testing, design, automation, analytics and business workflows where intelligent capabilities can materially improve outcomes. • Develop deep business and domain knowledge to identify opportunities where technology and AI can create meaningful value • Engineer AI systems beyond the model itself, integrating data pipelines, models, retrieval layers, APIs, tools and application workflows into scalable end-to-end solutions. • Analyze diverse datasets to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful products, processes, and technology solutions. • Contribute to foundational engineering and infrastructure that strengthens scalability, resilience, data readiness, and future AI adoption. • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and user experiences. • Demonstrate ownership and sound judgment while communicating insights and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. • Explore emerging technologies and bring creativity and fresh thinking to evolving engineering and business challenges. Your Learning & Development You will gain: • Hands-on experience solving complex, high-impact problems across AI-native, AI-enabled and foundational engineering initiatives, while developing deep expertise in the underlying business and technology domains. • Exposure to the development of AI/ML systems from problem formulation and experimentation through evaluation, engineering and production application. • Opportunities to deepen your expertise across software engineering, AI/ML, data, platforms and emerging technologies. • Exposure to BlackRock's culture, leadership, and industry-leading platforms. • Access to structured learning, technical training, career coaching, mentorship, and professional networks. • Opportunities to collaborate with diverse, high-performing teams and solve complex challenges at global scale. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

companies.description:
At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Capital One is the 6 th largest US bank in consumer deposits, among the country’s top 5 Auto Lenders and a Fortune 500 company. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will apply strategic and analytical skills to major business challenges. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives

At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
