Job Description
At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. Capital One is looking for business analysts to drive our foray into autonomous and intelligent data products that solve the full gamut of business and analytical needs. The role will be part of an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad and focused on our mission to develop world class data products. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company and a great place to work. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives.

About the company	Cashfree Payments is a leading payments and API banking solutions company. We provide full-stack payments solutions enabling businesses in India to collect payments and make payouts via all available methods with a simple integration. Cashfree Payments’s offerings include an advanced and easy way to integrate payment gateway, a split payment solution for marketplaces, bank account verification API and Auto Collect -a virtual account solution to match inbound payments to customers. Founded by IIIT Hyderabad alumnus Akash Sinha and IIT Kharagpur graduate Reeju Datta, www.cashfree.com is among the leading payment service providers in India processing transactions worth USD 80 Billion annually. We have leveraged technology to lead payment disbursals in India with more than 50% market share among payment processors. Cashfree enables more than 10,00,000 businesses with payment collections, vendor payouts, wage payouts, bulk refunds, expense reimbursements, loyalty and rewards. Apart from India, Cashfree’s products are used in eight other countries including USA, Canada and UAE. Cashfree is backed by Silicon Valley investor Y Combinator, Apis Partners, State Bank of India (SBI) and was incubated by PayPal. Recently we raised USD 53 Million/INR 450 Crore in Funding Round Led by KRAFTON to Drive Product Innovation, Market Expansion, and Global Growth.

Job Description
Cognizant® Ace Team is Cognizant's premier engineering program that brings together a select group of high-potential AI engineers to solve real-world enterprise challenges using AI-native technologies, agentic systems, and modern engineering practices. As an Ace Frontier Engineer, you will operate within a lean, high-impact Frontier pod, building and delivering AI-native solutions end-to-end across software, data, infrastructure, quality, and operations. In this role, you will design multi-agent systems, build RAG pipelines and knowledge platforms, deploy production-grade LLM applications, and integrate AI-powered workflows across business and technology environments. You will also validate AIgenerated outputs, implement guardrails, and ensure reliable AI operations in production. The program provides exposure to diverse domains, technologies, and problem spaces, enabling rapid growth across agentic AI, LLMOps, AI quality, automation and full-stack engineering. Beyond delivering working solutions, you will be responsible for driving measurable business outcomes and owning what the pod builds in production.

About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

Technology is an integral part of virtually everything we do, and our team enjoys access to some of the most advanced computing resources in the world. The technology teams work on a variety of projects ranging from the firm's diversified strategies, trading systems, portfolio management and visualization platforms, quantitative analysis tools, real‐time financial data‐feed infrastructure, high‐performance low‐latency middleware systems, or workflow tools to making talent functions more efficient and effective. Successful candidates have traditionally been the top students in their programs and have extensive software development knowledge. What you will do day-to-day: ● Gaining insights into financial domain ● Acquiring end-to-end understanding of trading systems workflow and building core trading system components ● Working on transformative tools, enhancing data analysis libraries, and building data visualization platforms ● Designing and implementing scalable, real-time software Who we are looking for: ● The ideal candidate should be a final year student with a minimum CGPA of 7.00 in Computer Science branches and 8.00 in all other branches with no current backlogs ● Their programming skills in C/C++/Java/Python should be proficient ● They should have practical understanding of CS concepts in the following areas: − Data Structures and Algorithms − Operating Systems − Computer networks − Database management systems ● Problem-solving and logical reasoning abilities are important for this role The D. E. Shaw group (DESCO) is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. Our activities range from computer-based quantitative investment management to the development and financing of technology-oriented business ventures. D. E. Shaw India (DESIS) is a core member of DESCO's Global Information Technology Group and was established in Hyderabad in 1996. DESIS provides research, development, and support for all of D. E. Job Description
Technology is an integral part of virtually everything we do, and our team enjoys access to some of the most advanced computing resources in the world. The technology teams work on a variety of projects ranging from the firm's diversified strategies, trading systems, portfolio management and visualization platforms, quantitative analysis tools, real‐time financial data‐feed infrastructure, high‐performance low‐latency middleware systems, or workflow tools to making talent functions more efficient and effective. Successful candidates have traditionally been the top students in their programs and have extensive software development knowledge. What you will do day-to-day: ● Gaining insights into financial domain ● Acquiring end-to-end understanding of trading systems workflow and building core trading system components ● Working on transformative tools, enhancing data analysis libraries, and building data visualization platforms ● Designing and implementing scalable, real-time software Who we are looking for: ● The ideal candidate should be a final year student with a minimum CGPA of 7.00 in Computer Science branches and 8.00 in all other branches with no current backlogs ● Their programming skills in C/C++/Java/Python should be proficient ● They should have practical understanding of CS concepts in the following areas: − Data Structures and Algorithms − Operating Systems − Computer networks − Database management systems ● Problem-solving and logical reasoning abilities are important for this role The D. E. Shaw group (DESCO) is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. Our activities range from computer-based quantitative investment management to the development and financing of technology-oriented business ventures. D. E. Shaw India (DESIS) is a core member of DESCO's Global Information Technology Group and was established in Hyderabad in 1996. DESIS provides research, development, and support for all of D. E. Shaw's business initiatives.

Overview: Are you passionate about applying data science and artificial intelligence to solve some of the world’s biggest challenges? So are we! Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At the Esri R&D Center-New Delhi, we are applying cutting-edge AI and deep learning techniques to revolutionize geospatial analysis and derive insight from imagery and location data. Our team develops tools, APIs, and AI models for geospatial analysts and data scientists, enabling them to leverage the latest research in spatial data science, AI and geospatial deep learning. As a Data Scientist, you will develop foundation and task specific deep learning models for various modalities of GIS data including Satellite imagery. If you are passionate about deep learning applied to remote sensing and GIS, developing AI and deep learning models, love maps or geospatial datasets/imagery, this is the place to be! Responsibilities: • Develop tools, APIs and pretrained models for geospatial AI • Integrate ArcGIS with popular deep learning libraries such as PyTorch • Develop foundation models for computer vision, language, location and multimodal data • Develop AI Agents / Assistants to perform various GIS tasks • Author and maintain geospatial data science samples using ArcGIS and machine learning/deep learning libraries • Curate and pre/post-process data for deep learning models and transform it into geospatial information • Perform comparative studies of various deep learning model architectures Requirements: • Self-learner with coursework in and extensive knowledge of machine learning and deep learning • Experience with Python machine learning and deep learning libraries such as PyTorch • Experience in one or more of the following areas: - Traditional and deep learning-based computer vision techniques with the ability to develop deep learning models for computer vision tasks (image classification, object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, GANs, super-resolution, image inpainting, etc.) - Transformer models applied to computer vision - Expertise in 3D deep learning with Point Clouds, meshes, or Voxels with the ability to develop 3D geospatial deep learning models, such as PointCNN, MeshCNN etc. - Development of AI assistants / Agents to perform specific tasks • Experience with hyperparameter-tuning and training models to a high level of accuracy • Bachelor of Technology or Engineering in any discipline Recommended Qualifications: • Experience applying deep learning to satellite or medical imagery or geospatial datasets • Familiarity with ArcGIS suite of products and concepts of GIS • Practical experience applying deep learning concepts from theory to code, evidenced by at least one significant project (internship, research, or personal portfolio) About Esri: At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. Job Description
Overview: Are you passionate about applying data science and artificial intelligence to solve some of the world’s biggest challenges? So are we! Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At the Esri R&D Center-New Delhi, we are applying cutting-edge AI and deep learning techniques to revolutionize geospatial analysis and derive insight from imagery and location data. Our team develops tools, APIs, and AI models for geospatial analysts and data scientists, enabling them to leverage the latest research in spatial data science, AI and geospatial deep learning. As a Data Scientist, you will develop foundation and task specific deep learning models for various modalities of GIS data including Satellite imagery. If you are passionate about deep learning applied to remote sensing and GIS, developing AI and deep learning models, love maps or geospatial datasets/imagery, this is the place to be! Responsibilities: • Develop tools, APIs and pretrained models for geospatial AI • Integrate ArcGIS with popular deep learning libraries such as PyTorch • Develop foundation models for computer vision, language, location and multimodal data • Develop AI Agents / Assistants to perform various GIS tasks • Author and maintain geospatial data science samples using ArcGIS and machine learning/deep learning libraries • Curate and pre/post-process data for deep learning models and transform it into geospatial information • Perform comparative studies of various deep learning model architectures Requirements: • Self-learner with coursework in and extensive knowledge of machine learning and deep learning • Experience with Python machine learning and deep learning libraries such as PyTorch • Experience in one or more of the following areas: - Traditional and deep learning-based computer vision techniques with the ability to develop deep learning models for computer vision tasks (image classification, object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, GANs, super-resolution, image inpainting, etc.) - Transformer models applied to computer vision - Expertise in 3D deep learning with Point Clouds, meshes, or Voxels with the ability to develop 3D geospatial deep learning models, such as PointCNN, MeshCNN etc. - Development of AI assistants / Agents to perform specific tasks • Experience with hyperparameter-tuning and training models to a high level of accuracy • Bachelor of Technology or Engineering in any discipline Recommended Qualifications: • Experience applying deep learning to satellite or medical imagery or geospatial datasets • Familiarity with ArcGIS suite of products and concepts of GIS • Practical experience applying deep learning concepts from theory to code, evidenced by at least one significant project (internship, research, or personal portfolio) About Esri: At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. For more information on Esri’s Racial Equity and Social Justice initiatives, please visit our website here. Esri is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email askcareers@esri.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address. Esri Privacy Esri takes our responsibility to protect your privacy seriously. We are committed to respecting your privacy by providing transparency in how we acquire and use your information, giving you control of your information and preferences, and holding ourselves to the highest national and international standards, including CCPA and GDPR compliance.

District: Going-out experiences, including dining, movies, sports and live events. Hyperpure: B2B supply of quality ingredients and products to restaurants. companies.description:
EY-Parthenon’s GDS SCM practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions and supply chain transformations. We are a group of experienced strategy and transaction professionals with a background in supply chain and operations who work across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. As such, we bring a wealth of deep supply chain functional knowledge to our clients in the context of complex transactions and transformations. This is an opportunity to work across the entire transaction lifecycle (pre-sign diligence, sign-toclose planning, post-close execution, etc.) of the most complex integrations (M&A) and divestitures. Moreover, you’ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain. We’re looking for an Associate Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex workstreams in supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a fastgrowing service offering in Strategy and Transactions. Your key responsibilities • Manage small to mid-sized engagements or parts/workstreams of large engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain functions (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery • Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products • Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives • Manage supply chain consultants/analysts. Help the team members develop expertise in supply chain. Mentor team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements • Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects

PLACEMENT	Senior Analyst - Supply Chain Management	1760000 INR			6.0

Job Description
EY-Parthenon’s GDS SCM practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions and supply chain transformations. We are a group of experienced strategy and transaction professionals with a background in supply chain and operations who work across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. As such, we bring a wealth of deep supply chain functional knowledge to our clients in the context of complex transactions and transformations. This is an opportunity to work across the entire transaction lifecycle (pre-sign diligence, sign-toclose planning, post-close execution, etc.) of the most complex integrations (M&A) and divestitures. Moreover, you’ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain. We’re looking for an Associate Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex workstreams in supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a fastgrowing service offering in Strategy and Transactions. Your key responsibilities • Manage small to mid-sized engagements or parts/workstreams of large engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain functions (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery • Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products • Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives • Manage supply chain consultants/analysts. Help the team members develop expertise in supply chain. Mentor team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements • Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects

Job Description
EY-Parthenon’s GDS SCM practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions and supply chain transformations. We are a group of experienced strategy and transaction professionals with a background in supply chain and operations who work across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. As such, we bring a wealth of deep supply chain functional knowledge to our clients in the context of complex transactions and transformations. This is an opportunity to work across the entire transaction lifecycle (pre-sign diligence, sign-toclose planning, post-close execution, etc.) of the most complex integrations (M&A) and divestitures. Moreover, you’ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain. We’re looking for an Associate Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex workstreams in supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a fastgrowing service offering in Strategy and Transactions. Your key responsibilities • Manage small to mid-sized engagements or parts/workstreams of large engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain functions (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery • Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products • Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives • Manage supply chain consultants/analysts. Help the team members develop expertise in supply chain. Mentor team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements • Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects

The opportunity We’re looking for an employee with knowledge in data science, strong understanding in Machine Learning; Python Programming and responsible for developing solutions using data driven techniques and Machine learning models. Your key responsibilities • Uses scientific methods and advanced technologies to analyze data, obtain knowledge and insights and develop models and solutions that deliver value to the business. • Creates cognitive services involving complex algorithms that collect data in a wide range of formats to automate processes, recommend actions and help in enhancing value creation opportunities on transactions. • Development and validation of predictive models using machine learning algorithms. • Deliver value through insights, reporting and data visualization techniques. • Cross collaborate across functions and regional teams to design and build analytics solutions. Skills and attributes for success • Knowledge of Python programming language • Well versed with data structure algorithm, Familiarity with different frameworks related to Data Science, ML, LLM, NLP, Deep learning, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar. • Understanding of Software development principle • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. • Good interpersonal skills and excellent written and verbal communication skill • Team player, open, pleasure to work with and positive in a group dynamic. Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications To qualify for the role, you must have • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field • Hands-on experience through academic projects, internships, or personal projects related to data analysis and machine learning. • Proficient in SQL, Python and R • Any certification in AI/ML is a plus. What we look for • A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment • An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. • Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries What working at EY offers At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you About EY EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The opportunity EY Parthenon is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size, growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advant age and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and en hance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities • Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them • Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities • Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or serving new customer segments • Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and transform the organization for the digital world • Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer segmentation • Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is imperative • Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment strategy and execution FY 2025 2 • Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Also focusing on operational due diligence and IT due diligence • Responsible for a specific workstream in the project • Responsible for contributing towards knowledge sharing portals to build the practices intellectual property Skills and attributes for success • Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex assignments • Experience in delivering business strategy and diligence projects in complex environments • Strong quantitative skills for data analysis, interpretation of output, and generation of insights • Research oriented mindset • Should have an eye for detail • Ability to flex individual styles and work back with diverse teams • Strong communication skills – oral and written (in terms of making presentation) • Strong financial modelling skills and clarity of financial concepts • Desire to contribute and succeed in a fun, exciting, collegial, and challenging environment • Proficient in the English language both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment • Willingness and ability to travel To qualify for the role, you must have • Engineering graduates (from premier institute) with a good academic background Ideally, you’ll also have • Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills. • Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative. • Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client) • Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Job Description
The opportunity EY Parthenon is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size, growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advant age and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and en hance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities • Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them • Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities • Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or serving new customer segments • Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and transform the organization for the digital world • Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer segmentation • Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is imperative • Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment strategy and execution FY 2025 2 • Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Also focusing on operational due diligence and IT due diligence • Responsible for a specific workstream in the project • Responsible for contributing towards knowledge sharing portals to build the practices intellectual property Skills and attributes for success • Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex assignments • Experience in delivering business strategy and diligence projects in complex environments • Strong quantitative skills for data analysis, interpretation of output, and generation of insights • Research oriented mindset • Should have an eye for detail • Ability to flex individual styles and work back with diverse teams • Strong communication skills – oral and written (in terms of making presentation) • Strong financial modelling skills and clarity of financial concepts • Desire to contribute and succeed in a fun, exciting, collegial, and challenging environment • Proficient in the English language both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment • Willingness and ability to travel To qualify for the role, you must have • Engineering graduates (from premier institute) with a good academic background Ideally, you’ll also have • Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills. • Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative. • Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client) • Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

About the company	At FinArb, We started by solving complex business problems with high-volume data engineering, analysis, and predictive modeling, and now we’re extending those capabilities into completely automated and scalable solutions, to aid our clients better As a brief introduction to our team, we are a group dedicated analytics professionals having a combined experience of 20 years in machine learning, artificial intelligence, deep learning, etc. in a wide range of industry verticals with an emphasis on banking, trading, risk and finance sectors.​We have a rich background of data ETL, algorithm development and dashboard/visualization creation in domains of marketing analytics, customer analytics, text modeling/natural language processing, image processing, financial analytics, equity valuation, financial engineering, trading algorithms and credit risk analytics. Though we have a huge experience in proprietary technologies, we encourage our clients to go the open source way using Python, R, Spark or the big data Hadoop - MapReduce framework or use d3 visualization, just for the sheer flexibility of the open source development stack.

Integrate AI models with production systems using APIs and microservices. Monitor model performance and retrain models when necessary. Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams. Ensure models are scalable, efficient, and production-ready. Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML technologies.

At FirstClub, product isn’t just about features and roadmaps — it’s about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. We’re hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You won’t be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone else’s roadmap. You’ll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what we’re building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some don’t, and what we can do to bring them back more often. You’ll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey — product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. You’ll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. What You’ll Work On: • Framing problems clearly from first principles • Writing SQL queries and pulling data yourself — you won’t be waiting on analysts • Synthesising insights from customer interviews, support tickets, and behavioral data • Writing crisp PRDs that engineers and designers actually want to build from • Running experiments and reading results honestly • Working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, design, ops, and category teams • Owning a real metric — not just a feature shipped Why This Role Is Different: Most early product roles involve shadowing PMs and shipping nothing. At FirstClub, you’ll own a real problem from day one. This means: • You’ll be measured on outcomes, not output • You’ll have direct access to founders and senior leadership • You’ll ship to real customers, not slides • You’ll learn how product gets built in an AI-native, high-velocity startup • You’ll touch every part of the stack: data, design, engineering, operations Required Skills & Traits: We care far more about mindset than pedigree. We value people who: • Learn insanely fast • Are highly curious • Love building things • Have strong ownership mentality • Can think from first principles • Obsess over customer experience • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity • Can leverage AI tools effectively • Thrive in fast-moving environments • Want to create real-world impact Must-Have Skills: • Knowing SQL — or being willing to learn it fast — is a MUST. You will be writing queries from day one. All three projects are deeply data-driven and you cannot rely on someone else to pull numbers for you. • Strong ability to churn through messy data, identify patterns, and extract actionable insights • Comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, and analytical thinking • Sharp written and verbal communication — you should be able to explain a problem in 3 sentences • Structured problem-solving and the discipline to break ambiguous problems into solvable pieces Bonus if you have: • Built side projects, products, communities, or businesses • Used Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT heavily for research, analysis, or prototyping • Worked on data analysis, analytics, or research projects • Run experiments or A/B tests • Built anything end-to-end independently • Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, or similar Expected Outcomes: By the end of the program, you should be able to: • Define and frame product problems clearly • Write SQL and pull data independently • Translate raw data and customer signals into product decisions • Write PRDs that engineering and design love to work from • Ship features that move real business metrics • Run experiments end-to-end — hypothesis to readout • Think like a product owner, not a feature factory • Operate with founder-level ownership What You’ll Learn: • Product thinking from first principles • Data-driven decision making • Customer research and synthesis • Experimentation and hypothesis testing • Working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and ops • Trade-offs between speed and quality • Business-first product development • How elite startup teams actually operate Specific Courses / Learning Expectations: We strongly encourage familiarity with: Product Foundations • Product management fundamentals • Writing PRDs and product specs • User research basics • Prioritization frameworks (RICE, ICE, etc.) Data & Analytics • SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL syntax) • Cohort analysis and retention metrics • Funnel analysis and conversion math • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets • Tools like Mixpanel / Amplitude / Metabase AI Tools for Product • Using LLMs for research, synthesis, and prototyping • Prompt engineering for product workflows • Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT for everyday product work Recommended Platforms: • Lenny’s Newsletter • Mode SQL Tutorial / SQLBolt • Mixpanel / Amplitude product analytics courses • Y Combinator startup library • Writings from top product leaders (Shreyas Doshi, Marty Cagan, John Cutler) Culture at FirstClub: We are a close-knit group of builders who genuinely care about: • Product quality • Customer trust • Fast execution • Radical ownership • Open door policy • No unnecessary process theater • Just smart people building ambitious things together Who Should NOT Apply: This role may not be a fit if: • You prefer heavily structured environments • You wait for detailed instructions • You dislike fast iteration cycles • You are uncomfortable with ownership • You think product is about meetings and frameworks, not metrics • You want to write strategy decks without shipping anything • You’re allergic to SQL and getting your hands dirty in data Who Will Thrive Here: You’ll love FirstClub if: • You’ve ever built something just for fun • You obsess over how products make you feel • You enjoy solving hard, messy, ambiguous problems • You want to work at startup speed • You believe great products come from great taste backed by great data • You want to help build the future instead of watching it happen

About the company	India lacks trust. There are not many brands which stand for trust. And if there are brands that stand for trust and high quality products then it’s not available at value for money pricing. India lacks a retail platform specifically built for the top 20mn India 1 households. Most platforms are built as a marketplace and not a retail store without an opinion on what they stand for, what they want to sell, who they want to sell to. Vision of FirstClub is to build a quality-first retail platform built for discerning Indian consumers with 3 pillars of trust, quality and value. While the ambition is to build a retail platform selling all categories, we have currently started with Fruits & Vegetables, Packaged grocery, Home & Kitchen categories and are currently live through quick commerce delivering to customers under 30 minutes in Bangalore and Hyderabad. Our Mission: To make high-quality products accessible and affordable to Indian consumers, while educating, empowering, and earning their trust We are not building a transaction engine We are building a curated retail experience that improves everyday life through better food and better choices The Problem We’re Solving: Indian retail has largely been built around the assumption that consumers are only price-conscious. This has resulted in mass-market products with compromised quality - “Everything stores” that optimise for assortment and discounts rather than trust Consumers are left to judge quality on their own. At the same time, there is a large and growing segment of Indian households, typically with ₹15L+ annual income, who: Care deeply about what they consume Are value-conscious rather than discount-driven Want to upgrade the quality of everyday products, not just indulge occasionally FirstClub exists to serve this overlooked middle ground. These are customers who want better, without paying luxury mark-ups or buying into marketing gimmicks. FirstClub is a curated grocery and food platform where every product is intentionally chosen, Quality is pre-verified and not assumed, customers are guided without being overwhelmed. We start with fresh and food categories such as fruits, vegetables, dairy, bakery, eggs, staples, packaged snacks and beverages. Over time, we will expand into adjacent non-food categories including kids, personal care, home and kitchen, and home care. Our initial operating model is quick commerce for metro consumers, where fast delivery helps preserve freshness. Speed, however, is a service we offer, not what defines us as a brand. What We Want to Be Known For: Across categories like fruits, vegetables, dairy, bakery, eggs, and staples, FirstClub should stand for: The freshest possible produce Finest ingredients and clean formulations Clean sourcing, preparation, and quality standards Products that create a genuine “aha” moment when used or consumed That moment when a customer thinks: “This is clearly better, and it didn’t cost me a premium.”

Job Description
At FirstClub, product isn’t just about features and roadmaps — it’s about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. We’re hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You won’t be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone else’s roadmap. You’ll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what we’re building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some don’t, and what we can do to bring them back more often. You’ll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey — product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. You’ll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. companies.description:
The AI Solutions Org is a new, high-velocity engineering unit at Flipkart with a singular mission: to accelerate AI adoption across the entire company. Will operate as a "SWAT team" for AI - building end-to-end solutions for business functions that lack engineering bandwidth, while also partnering with the core Data Science team to optimize and scale state-of-the-art models (FK LLMs, Open Source, Commercial). This is not a traditional software engineering role. We believe the future of coding is AI-assisted. You are expected to be an AI-Native Engineer: ● You don't just write code; you orchestrate it. You leverage tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and LLMs to write code, generate test cases, debug, and perform RCAs at 10x speed. ● You are Full-Stack + AI. You are comfortable setting up a backend API, building a quick UI, and engineering a complex RAG pipeline in the same sprint. You'll be responsible for: 1. End-to-End AI Feature Development: Write clean, efficient code using AI coding assistants to build, test, and own full AI features from concept to release. 2. LLM Integration & RAG Pipelines: Implement LLM API integrations, craft effective prompts, construct E2E RAG architecture using Vector DBs and embeddings, analyze commercial vs. open-source models for cost and performance. 3. Architecture, Deployment & Performance: Design mid-sized AI application architectures, deploy services via Docker/K8s or internal platforms, optimize inference latency, and assist Data Science teams with basic fine-tuning. 4. AI Native Operations & Engineering Mentorship: Use AI tools for automated unit testing, documentation, and production root cause analysis.

FLIPSPACES JOB DESCRIPTION — US SBU Flipsapces - Entrepreneur-in-Residence (FEiR) Flipspaces Technology Labs | US SBU Location: Mumbai, India & United States Reporting To: Business Leaders Function: Cross-functional Leadership Development About Flipspaces Flipspaces is a global design-tech powerhouse reshaping the future of commercial interiors. Its VR-powered platform lets clients visualize and co-create their spaces in real time. Backed by in-house manufacturing and end-to-end execution capabilities, Flipspaces has built over 10 million sq. ft. for top startups, enterprises, co-working brands, and global giants. Born at the intersection of design, tech, and manufacturing, Flipspaces is led by IIT founders and is scaling rapidly across India, the US, Singapore, and the Middle East, with 7 offices and a 500-strong team. Flipspaces recently closed a $50M Series C, with plans to scale its US SBU, double down on AI-powered technology, and pursue strategic acquisitions. The Role The Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) is a high-potential leadership program designed for individuals who want to become owner-operators and future business leaders. This is not a traditional management trainee role. From Day 1, you will work on live business mandates, take ownership of outcomes, solve real operational and commercial problems, and work closely with senior leadership. Over 24 months, you will rotate across four critical areas of the business: Primary Responsibilities 1. Project Management, Design & Execution | India Understand the complete design-to-delivery lifecycle. Work with design and project teams on live projects. Read and interpret GFC drawings and project documentation. Participate in design reviews and client/project discussions. Own a defined project package from planning through execution. Develop an understanding of site execution, quality, timelines, and project delivery. 2. Operations & Procurement | India Work across procurement, vendor management, costing, and supply chain. Develop and manage vendor relationships. Work on BOQs, costing, sourcing, and commercial evaluation. Leverage Flipspaces' technology and sourcing ecosystem to identify products and solutions. Support quality, snag closure, and project-level P&L hygiene. Identify opportunities to improve cost, quality, and delivery efficiency. 3. US Stint – Project Management & Operations | United States Work with the US business and on-ground project teams. Support client and site coordination. Gain exposure to the US vendor and execution ecosystem. Understand US project processes, permitting, and compliance requirements. Work with cross-border teams and stakeholders. Take ownership of defined project and operational mandates. 4. Sales & Business Development | India / United States Build and manage business pipelines. Participate in pre-sales, client pitches, and proposal development. Understand client requirements and translate them into commercial solutions. FLIPSPACES JOB DESCRIPTION — US SBU Flipsapces - Entrepreneur-in-Residence (FEiR) Flipspaces Technology Labs | US SBU Location: Mumbai, India & United States Reporting To: Business Leaders Function: Cross-functional Leadership Development About Flipspaces Flipspaces is a global design-tech powerhouse reshaping the future of commercial interiors. Its VR-powered platform lets clients visualize and co-create their spaces in real time. Backed by in-house manufacturing and end-to-end execution capabilities, Flipspaces has built over 10 million sq. ft. for top startups, enterprises, co-working brands, and global giants. Born at the intersection of design, tech, and manufacturing, Flipspaces is led by IIT founders and is scaling rapidly across India, the US, Singapore, and the Middle East, with 7 offices and a 500-strong team. Flipspaces recently closed a $50M Series C, with plans to scale its US SBU, double down on AI-powered technology, and pursue strategic acquisitions. The Role The Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) is a high-potential leadership program designed for individuals who want to become owner-operators and future business leaders. This is not a traditional management trainee role. From Day 1, you will work on live business mandates, take ownership of outcomes, solve real operational and commercial problems, and work closely with senior leadership. Over 24 months, you will rotate across four critical areas of the business: Primary Responsibilities 1. Project Management, Design & Execution | India Understand the complete design-to-delivery lifecycle. Work with design and project teams on live projects. Read and interpret GFC drawings and project documentation. Participate in design reviews and client/project discussions. Own a defined project package from planning through execution. Develop an understanding of site execution, quality, timelines, and project delivery. 2. Operations & Procurement | India Work across procurement, vendor management, costing, and supply chain. Develop and manage vendor relationships. Work on BOQs, costing, sourcing, and commercial evaluation. Leverage Flipspaces' technology and sourcing ecosystem to identify products and solutions. Support quality, snag closure, and project-level P&L hygiene. Identify opportunities to improve cost, quality, and delivery efficiency. 3. US Stint – Project Management & Operations | United States Work with the US business and on-ground project teams. Support client and site coordination. Gain exposure to the US vendor and execution ecosystem. Understand US project processes, permitting, and compliance requirements. Work with cross-border teams and stakeholders. Take ownership of defined project and operational mandates. 4. Sales & Business Development | India / United States Build and manage business pipelines. Participate in pre-sales, client pitches, and proposal development. Understand client requirements and translate them into commercial solutions. Support BOQ/proposal discussions and commercial negotiations. Develop key-account understanding and relationship-building skills. Work closely with the Business Development leadership team on closures. What You Will Build By the end of the program, you will have exposure to: Design & Project Management Construction & Execution Procurement & Supply Chain Operations & P&L Sales & Business Development Client & Stakeholder Management US business operations Cross-functional leadership Problem-solving and business ownership Your eventual role will be aligned to your demonstrated strengths, interests, and business requirements, with potential career paths across Sales, Business Development, Project Management, Operations, Design, Procurement, and Supply Chain. Preferred Qualifications & Experience We are looking for high-potential, entrepreneurial individuals who are excited by ambiguity, ownership, and building things from the ground up. Tier-1 institute alumni (IIT/IIM/ISB or equivalent top-tier MBA program) preferred. Bachelor's/Dual degree in: Mechanical Engineering Civil Engineering Architectural Engineering / Architecture Materials / Metallurgical Engineering Construction & Project Management Related engineering or built-environment disciplines Engineering Design Demonstrated leadership through student bodies, technical/cultural fests, sports, placement cells, or other initiatives. Entrepreneurial mindset demonstrated through startups, E-Cell activities, B-plan competitions, live projects, or self-initiated ventures. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. High ownership and willingness to work in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to travel, rotate across functions, and relocate when required. Strong interest in building a career across both India and the US. What We Look For - Think like owners – Take responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks. Move fast – Are comfortable making decisions and learning through execution. Solve problems – Approach ambiguous problems with structure and initiative. Build relationships – Can work effectively with clients, vendors, teams, and leadership. Learn across functions – Are curious enough to understand the entire business rather than staying within one silo. Have the ambition to lead – Want to eventually own teams, businesses, projects, or P&Ls. Why Join the EiR Program? Real Ownership from Day 1 - Work on live business mandates instead of being limited to shadowing or classroom training. Four Careers in Two Years- Build experience across Design, Execution, Procurement/Operations, and Sales in one accelerated leadership journey. US Exposure- Get an opportunity to work with the US business and gain on-ground exposure to the American design-build and project ecosystem. Technology + Design + Business- Work at the intersection of technology, design, construction, procurement, and business. Leadership Access- Work closely with senior leaders and gain direct exposure to business decisions and strategic priorities. Build Your Own Career Path- Your eventual role will be shaped by your strengths, interests, demonstrated performance, and Flipspaces' business needs. The Opportunity - If you are someone who doesn't want to spend the first few years of your career simply learning one function, the EiR program gives you an opportunity to understand the business end-to-end, take ownership early, and build towards a future leadership role. Come build the future of Design-to-Build with Flipspaces.When working from the Mumbai office, the working hours will be 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST (these timings are subject to change based on business requirements) www.flipspaces.com

companies.description:
Associate Consultant GDi is an impact-driven start-up committed to transforming the lives of individuals and communities for an equitable and inclusive world. We work in partnership with governments and impact-oriented organisations to design and execute large-scale development programs in domains like education, agriculture, environment, skill development, digital service delivery, and health. In 5 years since our founding, we've grown to become a 70+ member team working across 13 projects with 8 state governments and 3 central government ministries, as well as several strategy projects with large philanthropies and NGOs. We partner with prominent organizations—including the Gates Foundation, World Bank, Children's Investment Fund Foundation, NITI Aayog, and the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation—to address India’s most complex development challenges. To know more about GDi’s work, please visit our Website and LinkedIn. What working in GDi brings for you: At GDi, we tackle some of the most complex challenges in governance and development—transforming public systems so they work better for millions. This high‑impact work demands resilience, curiosity, and continuous learning—and offers unmatched opportunities for personal and professional growth. Accelerated, All‑Round Growth You’ll work in a fast‑paced, multi‑dimensional environment that will stretch and shape you into an all‑round leader. Every day brings a new problem to solve, and you’ll learn how to think of quick, structured solutions in real time. A Startup for Systems Change As a mission‑driven startup, GDi offers the best of both worlds—the agility to explore, experiment, and own your ideas, with the support of a team committed to delivering transformative results for governments and communities. You’ll gain broad‑based exposure across sectors while going deep into solving real issues that matter. Learning From the Best You’ll collaborate with colleagues from diverse academic, professional, and cultural backgrounds, bringing fresh perspectives to entrenched problems. Our diversity—of people and of projects—means you’ll quickly build mastery in addressing society’s most critical challenges, while growing your own problem‑solving toolkit. Impact You Can See Beyond competitive compensation, the real reward is knowing that your work directly improves public programs and services for communities across India—making your growth as a professional inseparable from the difference you make in people’s lives. At GDi, you won’t just build a career—you’ll build solutions that last. Key Responsibilities As an associate consultant, you will work in a team of 3-5 consultants to play an active role in all aspects of outcome delivery. In this client-facing role, you will regularly engage with senior leaders across political, bureaucratic, and philanthropic arenas, enhancing your leadership acumen and broadening your professional connections. Typically, you will work on: 1. Diagnosing complex challenges by breaking down the problem statement and analysing data sets to identify gaps and design effective solutions. 2. Brainstorming with your team and partners to problem-solve, plan, and decide on the deliverables and next steps. 3. Participating in field visits and interacting with partners/beneficiaries to gain first-hand insights and understanding of their needs. 4. Managing stakeholders by attending meetings, discussing progress, and aligning program objectives and next steps with them. 5. Engaging in organisation-building activities and leading new initiatives within the organisation. 6. Supporting the implementation of large-scale government initiatives impacting crores of lives Required Competencies There are 3 key competencies we look at - alignment with our values, fit within our culture and key skills including: 1. Strong logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving abilities 2. Strong communication and articulation skills (verbal and written) 3. Basic data analysis and technology skills The field of education is not a constraint. Location The base location for all selected candidates is New Delhi. Depending on the project, significant time will be spent at project locations (generally state capitals). Frequent travel to meet various officials within/outside Delhi/client locations will be required. Remuneration and Benefits Highly competitive remuneration package commensurate with social impact consulting industry standards, along with fast-paced growth typical of the consulting industry.

Job Description
Associate Consultant GDi is an impact-driven start-up committed to transforming the lives of individuals and communities for an equitable and inclusive world. We work in partnership with governments and impact-oriented organisations to design and execute large-scale development programs in domains like education, agriculture, environment, skill development, digital service delivery, and health. In 5 years since our founding, we've grown to become a 70+ member team working across 13 projects with 8 state governments and 3 central government ministries, as well as several strategy projects with large philanthropies and NGOs. We partner with prominent organizations—including the Gates Foundation, World Bank, Children's Investment Fund Foundation, NITI Aayog, and the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation—to address India’s most complex development challenges. To know more about GDi’s work, please visit our Website and LinkedIn. What working in GDi brings for you: At GDi, we tackle some of the most complex challenges in governance and development—transforming public systems so they work better for millions. This high‑impact work demands resilience, curiosity, and continuous learning—and offers unmatched opportunities for personal and professional growth. Accelerated, All‑Round Growth You’ll work in a fast‑paced, multi‑dimensional environment that will stretch and shape you into an all‑round leader. Every day brings a new problem to solve, and you’ll learn how to think of quick, structured solutions in real time. A Startup for Systems Change As a mission‑driven startup, GDi offers the best of both worlds—the agility to explore, experiment, and own your ideas, with the support of a team committed to delivering transformative results for governments and communities. You’ll gain broad‑based exposure across sectors while going deep into solving real issues that matter. Learning From the Best You’ll collaborate with colleagues from diverse academic, professional, and cultural backgrounds, bringing fresh perspectives to entrenched problems. Our diversity—of people and of projects—means you’ll quickly build mastery in addressing society’s most critical challenges, while growing your own problem‑solving toolkit. Impact You Can See Beyond competitive compensation, the real reward is knowing that your work directly improves public programs and services for communities across India—making your growth as a professional inseparable from the difference you make in people’s lives. At GDi, you won’t just build a career—you’ll build solutions that last. Key Responsibilities As an associate consultant, you will work in a team of 3-5 consultants to play an active role in all aspects of outcome delivery. In this client-facing role, you will regularly engage with senior leaders across political, bureaucratic, and philanthropic arenas, enhancing your leadership acumen and broadening your professional connections. Typically, you will work on: 1. Diagnosing complex challenges by breaking down the problem statement and analysing data sets to identify gaps and design effective solutions. 2. Brainstorming with your team and partners to problem-solve, plan, and decide on the deliverables and next steps. 3. Participating in field visits and interacting with partners/beneficiaries to gain first-hand insights and understanding of their needs. 4. Managing stakeholders by attending meetings, discussing progress, and aligning program objectives and next steps with them. 5. Engaging in organisation-building activities and leading new initiatives within the organisation. 6. Supporting the implementation of large-scale government initiatives impacting crores of lives Required Competencies There are 3 key competencies we look at - alignment with our values, fit within our culture and key skills including: 1. Strong logical reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving abilities 2. Strong communication and articulation skills (verbal and written) 3. Basic data analysis and technology skills The field of education is not a constraint. Location The base location for all selected candidates is New Delhi. Depending on the project, significant time will be spent at project locations (generally state capitals). Frequent travel to meet various officials within/outside Delhi/client locations will be required. Remuneration and Benefits Highly competitive remuneration package commensurate with social impact consulting industry standards, along with fast-paced growth typical of the consulting industry.
