About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
As a Quantitative Strategists you will be working in one of the business-aligned teams. You will work on a variety of workstreams including pricing and risk models for complex financial products, alpha generating strategies, portfolio allocation problems and models for prediction, trading automation, data analysis. Candidates would be required to apply their mathematical and problem-solving skills to a real-world business problem.As a member of our team, you will: • partner globally across multiple divisions and engineering teams to create quantitative modelingbased solutions. • be able to innovate and incubate new ideas. • learn from experts in quantitative finance. • have an opportunity to work on a broad range of problems, across multiple revenue generating as well as control divisions.

companies.description:
We are seeking an advanced Propulsion & Turbomachinery Engineer with specialised domain depth to drive high-fidelity aerodynamic, thermal, and dynamic modelling for next-generation propulsion systems. Designed for Master’s or Ph.D. researchers, this role bridges the gap between deep numerical physics and physical test hardware, and demands a rigorous, first-principles grasp of turbomachinery fluid dynamics, advanced CFD numerics, conjugate heat transfer, and rotordynamics. The selected candidate will take ownership of high-risk, high-complexity physical challenges, from aerothermal interactions in the hot gas path to structural and rotordynamic stability on the test rig. Key Responsibilities High-Fidelity CFD & Aerodynamic Modelling • Conduct advanced 1D/3D numerical analyses on axial/radial compressors, turbines, and nozzles • Apply turbulence modelling (RANS, URANS, LES/DES) to secondary flow physics, tip clearance losses, and boundary layer interactions • Analyse component performance under off-design and transient conditions Thermal & Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) • Perform coupled fluid-thermal simulations to evaluate extreme heat flux zones • Assess cooling passage effectiveness (film and internal cooling) • Evaluate transient thermal-structural responses across hot gas path components Rotordynamics & Structural Dynamics • Evaluate dynamic behaviour of high-speed rotating assemblies • Perform lateral/torsional rotordynamic analyses, Campbell diagram evaluations, and critical speed predictions • Conduct bearing-seal interaction studies and dynamic stability assessments Experimental Testing, Instrumentation & Validation • Design specialised aerodynamic and thermal test rigs • Select and deploy advanced instrumentation (dynamic pressure transducers, rake probes, thermocouples, hot-wire anemometry/PIV, vibration sensors) • Execute test campaigns and lead the correlation of physical data back to numerical models In-House Tooling & Scripting • Develop custom analytical models and post-processing workflows in Python or MATLAB • Build automated optimisation scripts to support design iterations

companies.description:
We are looking for an Aero-Structures Engineer to design, analyse, and test the airframe structures and mechanisms of our UAV platforms. This role covers the fuselage, wings, empennage, joints, and mounts in composites and metals, along with the hold-and-release, parachute deployment, and separation mechanisms that make launch and recovery possible. The selected candidate will take hardware from load cases and analysis through fabrication and testing, working closely with the propulsion, avionics, recovery, and flight-test teams, and will see their work fly within months of joining. Key Responsibilities Airframe Structures Design • Design airframe structures (fuselage, wing, empennage, joints, fittings, hatches, and mounts) in composites and metals to meet strength, stiffness, weight, and manufacturability targets • Design and analyse bolted, bonded, and fastened joints and local load-introduction features, such as engine mounts, attachment points, and payload interfaces • Work on composite layup design, material selection and allowables, and manufacturing processes (wet layup, prepreg, vacuum bagging, machining) Mechanisms Design • Design and develop vehicle mechanisms, including hold-and-release, parachute deployment, and other latching, separation, and deployment systems • Analyse mechanisms for kinematics, friction, tolerance stack-ups, release and deployment loads, and failure modes (FMEA) • Select and integrate actuators and release devices, and work with avionics on commands and interlocks Loads & Structural Analysis • Define load cases (flight, ground handling, launch, landing, recovery) and derive load paths through structures and mechanisms • Run hand calculations and FEA for strength, buckling, fatigue, and stiffness, and cross-check FEA against analytical estimates Testing & Validation • Plan and run structural and mechanism tests: coupon, sub-component, proof load, repeatability, functional, and deployment trials • Correlate test results with analysis Documentation • Prepare drawings, GD&T, BOMs, stress reports, and test reports to a standard that supports certification and range-safety review Integration & Flight Operations • Work with propulsion, avionics, recovery, and flight-test teams on interfaces and mass budgets • Support assembly, integration, flight-test operations, and root-cause analysis of any structural or mechanism anomaly

The selected candidate will take hardware from load cases and analysis through fabrication and testing, working closely with the propulsion, avionics, recovery, and flight-test teams, and will see their work fly within months of joining. Key Responsibilities Airframe Structures Design • Design airframe structures (fuselage, wing, empennage, joints, fittings, hatches, and mounts) in composites and metals to meet strength, stiffness, weight, and manufacturability targets • Design and analyse bolted, bonded, and fastened joints and local load-introduction features, such as engine mounts, attachment points, and payload interfaces • Work on composite layup design, material selection and allowables, and manufacturing processes (wet layup, prepreg, vacuum bagging, machining) Mechanisms Design • Design and develop vehicle mechanisms, including hold-and-release, parachute deployment, and other latching, separation, and deployment systems • Analyse mechanisms for kinematics, friction, tolerance stack-ups, release and deployment loads, and failure modes (FMEA) • Select and integrate actuators and release devices, and work with avionics on commands and interlocks Loads & Structural Analysis • Define load cases (flight, ground handling, launch, landing, recovery) and derive load paths through structures and mechanisms • Run hand calculations and FEA for strength, buckling, fatigue, and stiffness, and cross-check FEA against analytical estimates Testing & Validation • Plan and run structural and mechanism tests: coupon, sub-component, proof load, repeatability, functional, and deployment trials • Correlate test results with analysis Documentation • Prepare drawings, GD&T, BOMs, stress reports, and test reports to a standard that supports certification and range-safety review Integration & Flight Operations • Work with propulsion, avionics, recovery, and flight-test teams on interfaces and mass budgets • Support assembly, integration, flight-test operations, and root-cause analysis of any structural or mechanism anomaly

About Groww: We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo. Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat. Our Vision Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians. Our Values Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves. The values that form our foundation are: Radical customer centricity Ownership-driven culture Keeping everything simple Long-term thinking Complete transparency There are Product Managers who write PRDs, build mocks, plan sprints and analyse data. And then there are Product Managers who ship changes to the world order with every sprint. At Groww, PMs do both. Come be part of a product tribe that democratised investment in India. Your customer obsession will find its home. Learn to craft bespoke user experiences tailored to tens of millions of users. As a Product Intern at Groww, you will: Support the crafting of product strategy centered around the user, based on tradeoffs and the competitive landscape. Contribute to measurable outcomes by collaborating with engineering, design, operations, analytics, finance and compliance Help a billion Indians Groww Qualifications Pursuing or recently completed a degree; prior internship or project experience in product is a plus. Fintech exposure is preferred but not necessary. Ability to articulate user pain points and synthesise them into a compelling roadmap; comfortable experimenting with tools like Replit, Lovable or Bolt to showcase ideas. Curiosity or early exposure to AI/ML product development, or an interest in financial systems related to Risk, Margin and trading platforms. Speak tech: Willingness to learn and discuss HLDs and LLDs with engineering counterparts to understand how solutions work at scale. Good decision-making skills based on first principles and data. Hands-on data fluency — SQL, Sheets/Excel is necessary. People champion — able to build cross-functional relationships, cut through clutter and help align stakeholders. Strong written and oral communication skills. Genuine passion and hunger to solve problems.

About Groww: We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo. Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat. Our Vision Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians. Our Values Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves. The values that form our foundation are: Radical customer centricity Ownership-driven culture Keeping everything simple Long-term thinking Complete transparency There are Product Managers who write PRDs, build mocks, plan sprints and analyse data. And then there are Product Managers who ship changes to the world order with every sprint. At Groww, PMs do both. Come be part of a product tribe that democratised investment in India. Your customer obsession will find its home. Learn to craft bespoke user experiences tailored to tens of millions of users. As a Product Intern at Groww, you will: Support the crafting of product strategy centered around the user, based on tradeoffs and the competitive landscape. Contribute to measurable outcomes by collaborating with engineering, design, operations, analytics, finance and compliance Help a billion Indians Groww Qualifications Pursuing or recently completed a degree; prior internship or project experience in product is a plus. Fintech exposure is preferred but not necessary. Ability to articulate user pain points and synthesise them into a compelling roadmap; comfortable experimenting with tools like Replit, Lovable or Bolt to showcase ideas. Curiosity or early exposure to AI/ML product development, or an interest in financial systems related to Risk, Margin and trading platforms. Speak tech: Willingness to learn and discuss HLDs and LLDs with engineering counterparts to understand how solutions work at scale. Good decision-making skills based on first principles and data. Hands-on data fluency — SQL, Sheets/Excel is necessary. People champion — able to build cross-functional relationships, cut through clutter and help align stakeholders. Strong written and oral communication skills. Genuine passion and hunger to solve problems.

Building out our core AI platform requires ingesting massive streams of data from access control and video management systems, piping it through high-throughput databases, and processing it for real-time analysis and visualization. Job Description
We are hiring our first Associate Product Manager to work directly with Hakimo's founding product manager. Our product sits where computer vision, human operators and real-world security meet, so every decision has to work for three groups at once: the customers paying for protection, the operators responding to alerts, and the AI models generating them. You will start by owning real problems from week one: investigating incidents, turning customer and operator feedback into specs, and shipping features with our engineering and AI teams. As you grow, you will take ownership of a product area end to end.

The cornerstone of Hakimo's platform is computer vision, where Deep Learning, Multimodal AI and Visual generative models power the core of our AI capabilities. We are looking for talented Applied ML(Machine Learning) Engineers to join us directly from campus and help build, optimize, and scale the vision intelligence driving our products. In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world deployment. As a Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, multi-cloud platforms, edge compute, and real-time streaming architectures. Hakimo is seeking a Founder's Office Analyst to work with Founder's Office (IIT, IIM and McKinsey alumnus). This role sits at the high-velocity intersection of strategy, data analytics, go-to-market (GTM) execution, and cross-functional operations. As an Analyst, you will tackle ambiguous, high-priority business problems across the company. You will move fluidly between quantitative research, revenue pipeline analysis, cross-team alignment, and hands-on operational work handling multiple critical threads with direct mentorship and significant ownership from day one. companies.description:
We are looking for Full-Stack AI Engineers to design, build and ship AI-powered products across our healthcare data platform and build and test features and pipelines with guidance. You will work across machine learning and GenAI, backend services, frontend applications, data engineering and DevOps, taking problems from raw healthcare data all the way to reliable production systems and the interfaces our customers use every day. Technologies you'll work with- Languages: Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, Golang. Rust Backend: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Spring Boot, Node.js, Celery Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI (including MUI X DataGrid), Tailwind CSS, Vite, Highcharts AI/ML: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Amazon Bedrock models; small and open-source models (for example Llama, Mistral, Qwen) served with vLLM or Ollama; LangChain/LangGraph; PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, XGBoost; Ray; Langfuse for LLM tracing and cost tracking Data: Spark/PySpark on AWS EMR, Airflow, AWS Lambda and Step Functions; PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redshift, DuckDB, Redis; OpenSearch; SQS and Kafka Cloud: AWS (primary), with Azure for selected deployments

That momentum is rooted in a tech-first product engine: seven proprietary solutions that combine agentic AI, machine learning, domain-trained LLMs, and generative AI to clean up the industry’s hardest data problems—from directory errors and ghost networks to roster mismatches, contract complexity, and unstructured clinical data. The result is faster operations, less manual work, stronger compliance, and smarter decisions at scale. Our impact has been recognized by JAMA, KLAS, and the Inc. 5000, and it’s driven by a global team from leading institutions. If you’re a builder who wants to shape the future of healthcare, start with us.

Job Description
We are looking for Full-Stack AI Engineers to design, build and ship AI-powered products across our healthcare data platform and build and test features and pipelines with guidance. You will work across machine learning and GenAI, backend services, frontend applications, data engineering and DevOps, taking problems from raw healthcare data all the way to reliable production systems and the interfaces our customers use every day. Technologies you'll work with- Languages: Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, Golang. Rust Backend: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Spring Boot, Node.js, Celery Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI (including MUI X DataGrid), Tailwind CSS, Vite, Highcharts AI/ML: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Amazon Bedrock models; small and open-source models (for example Llama, Mistral, Qwen) served with vLLM or Ollama; LangChain/LangGraph; PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, XGBoost; Ray; Langfuse for LLM tracing and cost tracking Data: Spark/PySpark on AWS EMR, Airflow, AWS Lambda and Step Functions; PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redshift, DuckDB, Redis; OpenSearch; SQS and Kafka Cloud: AWS (primary), with Azure for selected deployments

companies.description:
We are looking for a Associate Product Manager who enjoys being close to customers, deep in data, and hands-on with product delivery. As a delivery-oriented product manager, you will be working directly with US healthcare clients - understanding their workflows and data, shaping solutions, partnering closely with engineering, and turning real-world problems into scalable products. What you will do: • Lead client discovery and shape product requirements • Analyze healthcare data using SQL • Partner with Engineering, Data Science & Implementation to ship solutions • Drive multiple client deployments end-to-end • Balance client needs with scalable product strategy • Own solution design, adoption, and continuous improvement What we are looking for: Strong client-facing skills, hands-on SQL, experience in shipping products with engineering teams, and ideally exposure to US healthcare, data products, and AI/ML.

Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

companies.description:
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. About your future dream team: Our team is pivotal for delivering the vision – Always You First. This team acts as a center of excellence to provide accurate and timely insights and data driven solutions to drive personalized and innovative product offerings to our customers. At IDFC First bank, we know that not everyone can bring all the skills & experiences to the table, therefore, we are more focused on people bringing a growth mindset to their approach to work. Learning on the job is the way we work, so don’t worry if don’t have all! The Purpose The Associate Data Scientist-AI supports the design, development, and deployment of Generative AI solutions that enhance business processes, customer experience, and decision-making. The role focuses on building, fine-tuning, and evaluating large language models (LLMs) and other generative models, working closely with senior data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to translate use cases into scalable AI solutions. Roles & Responsibilities Generative AI Development: • Assist in developing, fine-tuning, and evaluating Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, embedding models) for business use cases such as text generation, summarization, classification, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Implement prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and guardrails to improve model performance, safety, and reliability. • Support experimentation with open-source and commercial GenAI models and frameworks. Data Preparation & Modeling • Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured data (text, documents, logs, etc.) to support GenAI pipelines. • Create and maintain feature sets, embeddings, and vector databases for downstream applications. • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns and insights that inform model design. Model Evaluation & Optimization • Define and execute evaluation strategies using quantitative metrics and qualitative assessments (e.g., relevance, accuracy, hallucination rate). • Analyze model outputs, identify failure modes, and recommend improvements. • Support A/B testing and continuous monitoring of deployed GenAI solutions. Deployment & Collaboration • Assist in deploying GenAI solutions into production environments in collaboration with ML engineers and platform teams. • Work with product managers, business analysts, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Document models, experiments, and best practices for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. Governance & Best Practices • Adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security guidelines. • Support compliance with internal AI governance, ethical AI standards, and regulatory requirements. • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI techniques, tools, and industry trends Skills: • You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them) • You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet) • You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding! • You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business! • You know when to look things up on the internet!

Job Description
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. The Purpose The Associate Data Scientist-AI supports the design, development, and deployment of Generative AI solutions that enhance business processes, customer experience, and decision-making. The role focuses on building, fine-tuning, and evaluating large language models (LLMs) and other generative models, working closely with senior data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to translate use cases into scalable AI solutions. Roles & Responsibilities Generative AI Development: • Assist in developing, fine-tuning, and evaluating Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, embedding models) for business use cases such as text generation, summarization, classification, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Implement prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and guardrails to improve model performance, safety, and reliability. • Support experimentation with open-source and commercial GenAI models and frameworks. Data Preparation & Modeling • Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured data (text, documents, logs, etc.) to support GenAI pipelines. • Create and maintain feature sets, embeddings, and vector databases for downstream applications. • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns and insights that inform model design. Model Evaluation & Optimization • Define and execute evaluation strategies using quantitative metrics and qualitative assessments (e.g., relevance, accuracy, hallucination rate). • Analyze model outputs, identify failure modes, and recommend improvements. • Support A/B testing and continuous monitoring of deployed GenAI solutions. Deployment & Collaboration • Assist in deploying GenAI solutions into production environments in collaboration with ML engineers and platform teams. • Work with product managers, business analysts, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Document models, experiments, and best practices for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. Governance & Best Practices • Adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security guidelines. • Support compliance with internal AI governance, ethical AI standards, and regulatory requirements. • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI techniques, tools, and industry trends Skills: • You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them) • You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet) • You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding! • You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business! • You know when to look things up on the internet!

Scale: IDFC FIRST Bank is one of India’s fast-growing private banks, building its UI, UX, and tech stack like a fintech. As of June 30, 2026, the Bank has a customer business of Rs. 6,04,776 crore including deposits and loans, with YoY growth of around 20%. 3. Scope: We are a universal Bank offering complete range of services, including Retail, MSME, Rural, Startups, Corporate Banking, Cash Management, Credit Cards, Wealth Management, Deposits, Government Banking, Working Capital, Trade Finance, and Treasury solutions. 4. Ethical Banking: We are committed to doing right even when customers are not watching. We have simplified descriptions, calculations, and legal jargon to avoid confusing customers. 5. Digital Banking: The Bank's modern technology stack delivers high-quality services across all channels like mobile, branch, internet banking, call centers and relationship managers. Built on cloud-native, API-led, microservices architecture, supported with data, analytics, AI, and fine aesthetics, we strive to deliver fintech-grade experiences on banking platform. 6. Social Good: We have served over 40 million customers in inclusive banking, including 3.6 million women entrepreneurs, 7.5 million lifestyle improvement loans, 2 million livelihood loans, 300,000+ SMEs, 2.7 lakh water and sanitation loans, and 2.5 lakh electric vehicles. Our ESG credentials are strong and steadily improving. 7. Customer Friendly Banking: We make banking easy by having a customer first approach. We have waived fees on 36 essential savings account services which are commonly charged in the market, the first and only bank in India to do so. We create “pull” products that customers actively seek out. 8. Governance: We adhere to regulatory guidelines in letter and spirit and actively work with regulators to make things better. We take pride in maintaining highest levels of corporate governance. 9. Shareholders: We are building a well-diversified universal banking portfolio designed to deliver consistent ROE of 16%+. 10. Employees: IDFC FIRST Bank is designed to be a happy place to work, with cutting-edge roles, meaningful growth opportunities, and a culture of meritocracy. Compensation is healthy, efforts are recognized, and employees experience the pride and excitement of creating a world-class Bank in India.

Job Role: Associate (Consulting) Experience: Fresher CTC: ₹32.1 LPA (detailed breakup below) Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Website: www.indusinsights.com About Us Indus Insights is a VC-funded, ISO-27001 certified, specialized management consulting firm focused on the Financial Services. Our leaders are quoted by leading global publications such as Forbes, CIO magazine, VentureBeat, Fox Business, Information Week, etc. This is a front-end opportunity which will allow you to use Analytics & Machine Learning to address some of the most exciting problems in fintech, banking & digital sectors while directly liaising with CEOs, CMOs, CROs, and Heads of P&L. You will have unparalleled, complete ownership of your projects. Why Indus? • Fast moving organization for someone who is keen to climb an exponential growth trajectory • Exposure to multi-faceted projects, helping you gain deep insights into various businesses • A rigorous on-the-job training regimen that trains you in critical analytical and programming skills (Python, SQL, R, Tableau) from the ground-up, with no prerequisites • A bright, driven, & extremely talented team of colleagues • Cutting-edge work wherein data science meets Fintech and Insurtech with a presence across multiple countries • A strong ethic of employee centricity that invests heavily in holistic professional development of every individual If you like the overlap of business, math, and technology, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, this role is tailor-made for you! More Details: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvmkiysf10Hg3tXNw8Sh3HrISEobBkt4a&feature=shared Roles and Responsibilities 1. Drive analytics projects for our clients a. Translate broad business problems into clear, coherent frameworks b. Deploy a complex toolkit a of problem-solving approaches, participate in brainstorming sessions with the team c. Manipulate, merge, and create hygienic datasets from a variety of sources; be the subject-matter expert on client data and trends d. Use advanced statistical techniques (regression, machine learning) to create predictive algorithms, economic valuation models, perform impact sizing, stress testing. Evaluate their performance and finetune them to suit business needs e. Combine insights from data and deep business understanding to create business cases and sharing recommendations with CXOs 2. Client and Project Management a. Work directly with client maps to understand the business context and data trends b. Partner with them to address data issues and ensure consistency between data trends and actual business performance c. Present findings, updates, and recommendations to clients on a periodic basis d. Ensure smooth delivery of the project, provide periodic updates to Indus leadership & to clients, highlight roadblocks, etc. 3. Other Activities a. Be involved in hiring activities of Indus b. Lead internal workstreams, such as internal R&D projects, business development assistance, lead new joining training sessions, etc. Sample Business Problems Addressed We develop sophisticated predictive models & machine learning algorithms for our clients, and act as their extended teams for ongoing analytical needs. Our focus is the financial services sector, where we add value in marketing analytics, customer management analytics (churn, lifetime value modelling, next-best-offer, etc), and analytics in credit risk, pricing collections & fraud areas. 1. Reducing cost of operating airlines by creating accurate and optimized schedules 2. Reducing losses for lending firms by creating machine learning-based models to identify high risk borrowers 3. Increasing marketing effectiveness by targeting customers likely to use the credit card being offered Key Expectations 1. Professional Qualifications Eligible courses: a. B. Tech, M. Tech and Dual Degree courses 2. Competencies a. A curious person with a drive to solve business problems and being solution oriented b. Someone with an entrepreneurial mindset & humility c. Be inclined to be a part of high growth company d. Highly collaborative in nature and drive excellent relationships e. Demonstrate ability to manage/interact with global stakeholders (internal & external) Recruitment Process • Stage 1: Aptitude Test • Stage 2: Case Workshop + Buddy Program • Stage 3: Final Interviews CTC Breakup 1. Base: 21 Lakhs 2. Joining Bonus: 1 Lakh (Paid with first-month salary) 3. Variable: up to 3.15 Lakhs (10% of Base; Performance-Based) 4. LTIP: up to 6.3 lakhs 5. Gratuity: 35K 6. Health Insurance: 22K 7. Total Compensation: 32.1 LPA

Today, our portfolio includes Naukri.com, AmbitionBox, iimjobs, Hirist, Coding Ninjas, Jeevansathi, Shiksha, and 99acres. Every day, millions of users interact with our products, generating one of India's richest proprietary datasets across recruitment, real estate, education, and consumer behaviour. This unique combination of scale, data, and deep domain expertise enables us to solve AI problems that few organizations can. AI is at the core of our long-term vision. companies.description:
Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

companies.description:
You would be responsible for researching, designing, implementing, and evaluating state-of-the-art agentic AI harnesses for real-life enterprise use cases. You will work with both frontier LLMs and locally hosted models running on GPU clusters. Your responsibilities will include, among other things, the following: Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques in agentic AI, LLM reasoning, tool use, planning, orchestration and evaluation. Design and build agentic harnesses involving LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval, memory, planning and verification. Experiment with commercial frontier models as well as open-source/local models deployed on GPU infrastructure. Research and engineer GPU inference and serving infrastructure to efficiently handle asynchronous, concurrent workloads, improving GPU utilization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency. Break down complex business problems into algorithmic and system-level solutions and develop rapid prototypes to test hypotheses. Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to compare models, agent architectures and approaches across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost. Analyse agent failures, identify root causes and develop techniques for improving robustness, reasoning and task completion. Stay up to date with the latest research, models and open-source developments in LLMs and agentic AI, and identify techniques that can be incorporated into existing and future products. Work closely with research, product and engineering teams to convert successful prototypes into scalable and reliable production systems. Ownership of meaningful problems from day one, with direct mentorship from senior AI architects in a player-coach model. Hands-on access to frontier LLM APIs and dedicated GPU clusters for training, fine-tuning and serving. Exposure to production AI systems used by tier-1 global banks and asset managers. A fast-growing, well-funded environment where strong performers grow into research and technical leadership roles quickly.

Job Description
You would be responsible for researching, designing, implementing, and evaluating state-of-the-art agentic AI harnesses for real-life enterprise use cases. You will work with both frontier LLMs and locally hosted models running on GPU clusters. Your responsibilities will include, among other things, the following: Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques in agentic AI, LLM reasoning, tool use, planning, orchestration and evaluation. Design and build agentic harnesses involving LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval, memory, planning and verification. Experiment with commercial frontier models as well as open-source/local models deployed on GPU infrastructure. Research and engineer GPU inference and serving infrastructure to efficiently handle asynchronous, concurrent workloads, improving GPU utilization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency. Break down complex business problems into algorithmic and system-level solutions and develop rapid prototypes to test hypotheses. Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to compare models, agent architectures and approaches across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost. Analyse agent failures, identify root causes and develop techniques for improving robustness, reasoning and task completion. Stay up to date with the latest research, models and open-source developments in LLMs and agentic AI, and identify techniques that can be incorporated into existing and future products. Work closely with research, product and engineering teams to convert successful prototypes into scalable and reliable production systems. Ownership of meaningful problems from day one, with direct mentorship from senior AI architects in a player-coach model. Hands-on access to frontier LLM APIs and dedicated GPU clusters for training, fine-tuning and serving. Exposure to production AI systems used by tier-1 global banks and asset managers. A fast-growing, well-funded environment where strong performers grow into research and technical leadership roles quickly.

About the company	If you are looking to build AI that runs financial institutions—not slideware—this is your place. At Intellimation.ai, you work on production systems embedded at the core of global banks and capital-markets firms, where a single error has real consequences. You will tackle problems most AI teams avoid: broken workflows, edge cases, controls, and ambiguity where generic models and predefined playbooks fail. You will design precision-first systems where correctness is a constraint, not an afterthought. Your work will directly influence CXO-level decisions on risk, efficiency, and operational control—early in your career. We do not follow conventions because our clients operate beyond them. Our AI solutions are built for deeply regulated, exception-heavy environments where horizontal tools fall short, delivering measurable impact across risk management, exception handling, and operational resilience. Every hypothesis is validated against live financial data, and systems are stress-tested in enterprise environments before deployment. Here, “impossible” is not an answer—it is an invitation to engineer a superior solution. If you’re looking for comfort, this role isn’t for you. At Intellimation.ai, you work on production systems embedded at the core of global banks and capital-markets firms, where a single error has real consequences. You will tackle problems most AI teams avoid: broken workflows, edge cases, controls, and ambiguity where generic models and predefined playbooks fail. You will design precision-first systems where correctness is a constraint, not an afterthought. Your work will directly influence CXO-level decisions on risk, efficiency, and operational control—early in your career. We do not follow conventions because our clients operate beyond them. Our AI solutions are built for deeply regulated, exception-heavy environments where horizontal tools fall short, delivering measurable impact across risk management, exception handling, and operational resilience. Every hypothesis is validated against live financial data, and systems are stress-tested in enterprise environments before deployment. We have solved problems others step away from, replaced persistent manual effort with durable intelligence, and built platforms that scale with institutional risk and compliance requirements. Here, “impossible” is not an answer—it is an invitation to engineer a superior solution. If you’re looking for comfort, this role isn’t for you. But if you value depth over comfort, judgment over shortcuts, and early ownership of high-impact, strategically critical work—this is where you build real intelligence, not just credentials.

companies.description:
We are hiring exceptional fresh graduates from the IITs to join our Algorithm team. You will work at the frontier of applied AI – building LLM-powered systems, engineering GPU inference infrastructure, and running rigorous experiments – for real-life enterprise use cases in global financial services. You will work hands-on with both commercial frontier LLMs and locally hosted open-source models running on our GPU clusters, mentored directly by senior architects and researchers. Responsibilities: LLM Engineering Design and build agentic harnesses involving LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval (RAG), memory, planning and verification for enterprise workflows. Implement state-of-the-art techniques in LLM reasoning, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs and context engineering. Fine-tune, adapt and evaluate open-source models alongside commercial frontier models, selecting the right model for each task on accuracy, latency and cost. Build guardrails, verification layers and quality pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable enough for banking-grade production systems. GPU Engineering Engineer GPU inference and serving infrastructure to efficiently handle asynchronous, concurrent workloads – improving utilization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency. Work with modern serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton) and techniques such as continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization and speculative decoding. Profile and optimize model deployment across single-GPU and multi-GPU setups, and instrument the stack with metrics for utilization and cost. Experimentation & Research Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to compare models, agent architectures and approaches across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost. Analyse agent failures, identify root causes and develop techniques for improving robustness, reasoning and task completion. Break down complex business problems into algorithmic and system-level solutions and build rapid prototypes to test hypotheses. Stay current with the latest research, models and open-source developments in LLMs and agentic AI; reproduce promising results and incorporate proven techniques into our products. Work closely with research, product and engineering teams to convert successful prototypes into scalable, reliable production systems.

Job Description
We are hiring exceptional fresh graduates from the IITs to join our Algorithm team. You will work at the frontier of applied AI – building LLM-powered systems, engineering GPU inference infrastructure, and running rigorous experiments – for real-life enterprise use cases in global financial services. You will work hands-on with both commercial frontier LLMs and locally hosted open-source models running on our GPU clusters, mentored directly by senior architects and researchers. Responsibilities: LLM Engineering Design and build agentic harnesses involving LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval (RAG), memory, planning and verification for enterprise workflows. Implement state-of-the-art techniques in LLM reasoning, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs and context engineering. Fine-tune, adapt and evaluate open-source models alongside commercial frontier models, selecting the right model for each task on accuracy, latency and cost. Build guardrails, verification layers and quality pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable enough for banking-grade production systems. GPU Engineering Engineer GPU inference and serving infrastructure to efficiently handle asynchronous, concurrent workloads – improving utilization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency. Work with modern serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton) and techniques such as continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization and speculative decoding. Profile and optimize model deployment across single-GPU and multi-GPU setups, and instrument the stack with metrics for utilization and cost. Experimentation & Research Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to compare models, agent architectures and approaches across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost. Analyse agent failures, identify root causes and develop techniques for improving robustness, reasoning and task completion. Break down complex business problems into algorithmic and system-level solutions and build rapid prototypes to test hypotheses. Stay current with the latest research, models and open-source developments in LLMs and agentic AI; reproduce promising results and incorporate proven techniques into our products. Work closely with research, product and engineering teams to convert successful prototypes into scalable, reliable production systems.

At Intellimation.ai, you work on production systems embedded at the core of global banks and capital-markets firms, where a single error has real consequences. You will tackle problems most AI teams avoid: broken workflows, edge cases, controls, and ambiguity where generic models and predefined playbooks fail. You will design precision-first systems where correctness is a constraint, not an afterthought. Your work will directly influence CXO-level decisions on risk, efficiency, and operational control—early in your career. We do not follow conventions because our clients operate beyond them. Our AI solutions are built for deeply regulated, exception-heavy environments where horizontal tools fall short, delivering measurable impact across risk management, exception handling, and operational resilience. Every hypothesis is validated against live financial data, and systems are stress-tested in enterprise environments before deployment. We have solved problems others step away from, replaced persistent manual effort with durable intelligence, and built platforms that scale with institutional risk and compliance requirements. Here, “impossible” is not an answer—it is an invitation to engineer a superior solution. If you’re looking for comfort, this role isn’t for you. But if you value depth over comfort, judgment over shortcuts, and early ownership of high-impact, strategically critical work—this is where you build real intelligence, not just credentials.

Job Description
We are hiring exceptional fresh graduates from the IITs to join our Algorithm team. You will work at the frontier of applied AI – building LLM-powered systems, engineering GPU inference infrastructure, and running rigorous experiments – for real-life enterprise use cases in global financial services. You will work hands-on with both commercial frontier LLMs and locally hosted open-source models running on our GPU clusters, mentored directly by senior architects and researchers. Responsibilities: LLM Engineering Design and build agentic harnesses involving LLMs, tools, APIs, retrieval (RAG), memory, planning and verification for enterprise workflows. Implement state-of-the-art techniques in LLM reasoning, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs and context engineering. Fine-tune, adapt and evaluate open-source models alongside commercial frontier models, selecting the right model for each task on accuracy, latency and cost. Build guardrails, verification layers and quality pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable enough for banking-grade production systems. GPU Engineering Engineer GPU inference and serving infrastructure to efficiently handle asynchronous, concurrent workloads – improving utilization, throughput, latency and resource efficiency. Work with modern serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton) and techniques such as continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization and speculative decoding. Profile and optimize model deployment across single-GPU and multi-GPU setups, and instrument the stack with metrics for utilization and cost. Experimentation & Research Design experiments and evaluation frameworks to compare models, agent architectures and approaches across accuracy, reliability, latency and cost. Analyse agent failures, identify root causes and develop techniques for improving robustness, reasoning and task completion. Break down complex business problems into algorithmic and system-level solutions and build rapid prototypes to test hypotheses. Stay current with the latest research, models and open-source developments in LLMs and agentic AI; reproduce promising results and incorporate proven techniques into our products. Work closely with research, product and engineering teams to convert successful prototypes into scalable, reliable production systems.
