companies.description:
In this role, you will be one of the resources in our extended team working out of Mumbai, with an opportunity to be involved in the entire spectrum of activities in a VC fund, as well as work on portfolio-specific business development opportunities. You will be closely involved with portfolio company activities on behalf of the Fund, including business development activities, tracking and monitoring and strategy be reviewing and preparing business plans, performing valuation analysis, assist in providing primary and secondary sources of research, conducting due diligence, preparing investing memos, develop investment theses and deal pipeline through primary and secondary research (including but not limited to industry research, company research, macro research, etc.) meet and source excellent investment ideas (business development), be hands-on in existing deals run by senior deal team members, assist with fund-raising initiatives and investor relations, crucially, you will understand the nuances of early-stage investing.

companies.description:
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

PLACEMENT	IC Design Engineer II	4100000 INR			0.0

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. Keywords: Embedded Systems, Wearables, C/C++, MCU Firmware, Bare Metal, Low-Power Design, Wi-R, Startup, Equity, I2C, SPI, BLE, Embedded Debugging

Job Description
Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. Keywords: Embedded Systems, Wearables, C/C++, MCU Firmware, Bare Metal, Low-Power Design, Wi-R, Startup, Equity, I2C, SPI, BLE, Embedded Debugging

Job Description
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

JAVIS is looking for an Associate Product Manager (Front End) who will play a pivotal role in shaping the user interface & experience of our product & ensuring it aligns with our business goals. Responsibilities: ● Collaborate with product managers to define product vision and strategy. ● Work closely with Product designers to ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience. ● Create detailed product requirements documents (PRDs) and wireframes. ● Break down complex product features into user stories and prioritize them effectively. ● Analyse user behaviour data and product metrics to identify trends and opportunities. About the company	A World Where Work Runs Itself. The future of work lies in autonomous systems that guarantee execution, freeing people from managing complex processes and allowing organisations to focus on what matters most. Since its inception, JAVIS has been driven by this belief. The company was founded with a vision to rethink how enterprises manage Quote-to-Cash, building a future where complex business processes are not just automated, but intelligently executed end to end. Today, JAVIS is an Autonomous Execution Platform bringing together proprietary Document AI, an Enterprise Knowledge Fabric and Agentic AI Workers to transform how enterprises capture, fulfil and settle orders. The platform captures purchase orders across APIs, EDI, documents, emails, WhatsApp and customer portals, irrespective of customer technology or document formats. It intelligently processes enterprise data to prioritise orders, optimise inventory allocation and maximise product availability. Its AI workers negotiate delivery appointments, complete reconciliations and resolve disputes autonomously, within enterprise-defined governance and decision guardrails. JAVIS partners with some of the most respected enterprises, transforming mission-critical operations at scale. These partnerships deliver measurable outcomes, including up to 5–12% improvement in fill rates, up to 80% reduction in operational headcount, lower deductions and faster cash realisation. As JAVIS continues to grow, the company remains committed to pushing the boundaries of autonomous systems and reimagining the relationship between people, technology and work. JAVIS envisions a future where work does not need to be constantly managed, monitored or chased. It simply gets done. For individuals passionate about technology, solving meaningful problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible, JAVIS offers an opportunity to contribute to this vision. Building a world where work runs itself.

About the company	A World Where Work Runs Itself. The future of work lies in autonomous systems that guarantee execution, freeing people from managing complex processes and allowing organisations to focus on what matters most. Since its inception, JAVIS has been driven by this belief. The company was founded with a vision to rethink how enterprises manage Quote-to-Cash, building a future where complex business processes are not just automated, but intelligently executed end to end. Today, JAVIS is an Autonomous Execution Platform bringing together proprietary Document AI, an Enterprise Knowledge Fabric and Agentic AI Workers to transform how enterprises capture, fulfil and settle orders. The platform captures purchase orders across APIs, EDI, documents, emails, WhatsApp and customer portals, irrespective of customer technology or document formats. It intelligently processes enterprise data to prioritise orders, optimise inventory allocation and maximise product availability. Its AI workers negotiate delivery appointments, complete reconciliations and resolve disputes autonomously, within enterprise-defined governance and decision guardrails. JAVIS partners with some of the most respected enterprises, transforming mission-critical operations at scale. These partnerships deliver measurable outcomes, including up to 5–12% improvement in fill rates, up to 80% reduction in operational headcount, lower deductions and faster cash realisation. As JAVIS continues to grow, the company remains committed to pushing the boundaries of autonomous systems and reimagining the relationship between people, technology and work. JAVIS envisions a future where work does not need to be constantly managed, monitored or chased. It simply gets done. For individuals passionate about technology, solving meaningful problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible, JAVIS offers an opportunity to contribute to this vision. Building a world where work runs itself.

About the company	A World Where Work Runs Itself. The future of work lies in autonomous systems that guarantee execution, freeing people from managing complex processes and allowing organisations to focus on what matters most. Since its inception, JAVIS has been driven by this belief. The company was founded with a vision to rethink how enterprises manage Quote-to-Cash, building a future where complex business processes are not just automated, but intelligently executed end to end. Today, JAVIS is an Autonomous Execution Platform bringing together proprietary Document AI, an Enterprise Knowledge Fabric and Agentic AI Workers to transform how enterprises capture, fulfil and settle orders. The platform captures purchase orders across APIs, EDI, documents, emails, WhatsApp and customer portals, irrespective of customer technology or document formats. It intelligently processes enterprise data to prioritise orders, optimise inventory allocation and maximise product availability. Its AI workers negotiate delivery appointments, complete reconciliations and resolve disputes autonomously, within enterprise-defined governance and decision guardrails. JAVIS partners with some of the most respected enterprises, transforming mission-critical operations at scale. These partnerships deliver measurable outcomes, including up to 5–12% improvement in fill rates, up to 80% reduction in operational headcount, lower deductions and faster cash realisation. As JAVIS continues to grow, the company remains committed to pushing the boundaries of autonomous systems and reimagining the relationship between people, technology and work. JAVIS envisions a future where work does not need to be constantly managed, monitored or chased. It simply gets done. For individuals passionate about technology, solving meaningful problems and pushing the boundaries of what is possible, JAVIS offers an opportunity to contribute to this vision. Building a world where work runs itself.

About the company	Kalam Labs is a defence research lab redesigning airplanes from scratch to fly above 50,000 ft, where the air is 15% as dense as at sea level and temperatures fall to -70 °C. Conventional airframes, propellers, batteries and electronics fail at this altitude, and the few aircraft built for it, such as the Global Hawk with its 40 m wing, are large and expensive. We have rebuilt each subsystem in-house: (i) carbon-fibre airframes and aerofoils that take our ISR UAV to 50,000 ft; (ii) variable-pitch propellers that change pitch through the climb to 50,000 ft, where a fixed-pitch propeller is efficient at one speed only; (iii) navigation on GPS, NavIC and inertial sensors that works at 30 km, where many GPS receivers stop at 18 km; (iv) AES-encrypted links to hundreds of kilometres, where hobby video links reach a few kilometres; and (v) flight control firmware designed for autonomous stratospheric flight, where standard autopilots are tuned for dense air. We now fly routinely above 50,000 ft, beyond the reach of short-range air defences, conducting stealth surveillance and strike missions on targets behind high mountains and on hidden targets. Our autonomous planes have completed 180+ stratospheric missions in locations such as frigid Siachen, including essential cross-border missions for the Indian Army. Further, the Indian Air Force and Navy have contracted us to research and develop Supersonic Autonomous Spaceplanes, Near Space Swarm UAVs and manoeuvrable stratospheric airships, an estimated US$ 225 Mn of procurement once development completes within 24 months. We are looking for hands-on engineers who are looking to develop the next generation of aircraft systems from India.

About the company	Kalam Labs is a defence research lab redesigning airplanes from scratch to fly above 50,000 ft, where the air is 15% as dense as at sea level and temperatures fall to -70 °C. Conventional airframes, propellers, batteries and electronics fail at this altitude, and the few aircraft built for it, such as the Global Hawk with its 40 m wing, are large and expensive. We have rebuilt each subsystem in-house: (i) carbon-fibre airframes and aerofoils that take our ISR UAV to 50,000 ft; (ii) variable-pitch propellers that change pitch through the climb to 50,000 ft, where a fixed-pitch propeller is efficient at one speed only; (iii) navigation on GPS, NavIC and inertial sensors that works at 30 km, where many GPS receivers stop at 18 km; (iv) AES-encrypted links to hundreds of kilometres, where hobby video links reach a few kilometres; and (v) flight control firmware designed for autonomous stratospheric flight, where standard autopilots are tuned for dense air. We now fly routinely above 50,000 ft, beyond the reach of short-range air defences, conducting stealth surveillance and strike missions on targets behind high mountains and on hidden targets. Our autonomous planes have completed 180+ stratospheric missions in locations such as frigid Siachen, including essential cross-border missions for the Indian Army. Further, the Indian Air Force and Navy have contracted us to research and develop Supersonic Autonomous Spaceplanes, Near Space Swarm UAVs and manoeuvrable stratospheric airships, an estimated US$ 225 Mn of procurement once development completes within 24 months. We are looking for hands-on engineers who are looking to develop the next generation of aircraft systems from India.

About the company	Kalam Labs is a defence research lab redesigning airplanes from scratch to fly above 50,000 ft, where the air is 15% as dense as at sea level and temperatures fall to -70 °C. Conventional airframes, propellers, batteries and electronics fail at this altitude, and the few aircraft built for it, such as the Global Hawk with its 40 m wing, are large and expensive. We have rebuilt each subsystem in-house: (i) carbon-fibre airframes and aerofoils that take our ISR UAV to 50,000 ft; (ii) variable-pitch propellers that change pitch through the climb to 50,000 ft, where a fixed-pitch propeller is efficient at one speed only; (iii) navigation on GPS, NavIC and inertial sensors that works at 30 km, where many GPS receivers stop at 18 km; (iv) AES-encrypted links to hundreds of kilometres, where hobby video links reach a few kilometres; and (v) flight control firmware designed for autonomous stratospheric flight, where standard autopilots are tuned for dense air. We now fly routinely above 50,000 ft, beyond the reach of short-range air defences, conducting stealth surveillance and strike missions on targets behind high mountains and on hidden targets. Our autonomous planes have completed 180+ stratospheric missions in locations such as frigid Siachen, including essential cross-border missions for the Indian Army. Further, the Indian Air Force and Navy have contracted us to research and develop Supersonic Autonomous Spaceplanes, Near Space Swarm UAVs and manoeuvrable stratospheric airships, an estimated US$ 225 Mn of procurement once development completes within 24 months. We are looking for hands-on engineers who are looking to develop the next generation of aircraft systems from India.

companies.description:
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Job Profile

Form Type	Designation	Cost to Company per year	Bond / Service Contract	Additional Criteria	CGPA Cut-off
PLACEMENT	Full Stack Engineer	16000000 INR			0.0

Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company, backed by top-tier investors, that is solving India's massive property dispute problem by offering the nation's fastest and most comprehensive property title search engine. Our platform retrieves critical legal documents in seconds, effectively building the operating system for property ownership in India and transforming a $200 billion industry currently responsible for two-thirds of all court cases. Landeed is scaling rapidly, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. The role of an early-stage Software Engineer involves working directly with the founding team to design scalable backend systems, build AI/ML solutions for data extraction and analytics, and create intuitive frontends, requiring strong skills in languages like Python and JavaScript. This is a high-impact, wealth-building opportunity to join the first 50 employees of a fast-growing startup, gain expertise in proptech and legal tech, and directly influence product strategy that impacts millions of Indian families. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company, backed by top-tier investors, that is solving India's massive property dispute problem by offering the nation's fastest and most comprehensive property title search engine. Our platform retrieves critical legal documents in seconds, effectively building the operating system for property ownership in India and transforming a $200 billion industry currently responsible for two-thirds of all court cases. Landeed is scaling rapidly, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. The role of an early-stage Software Engineer involves working directly with the founding team to design scalable backend systems, build AI/ML solutions for data extraction and analytics, and create intuitive frontends, requiring strong skills in languages like Python and JavaScript. This is a high-impact, wealth-building opportunity to join the first 50 employees of a fast-growing startup, gain expertise in proptech and legal tech, and directly influence product strategy that impacts millions of Indian families. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

companies.description:
Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact Ownership from day one - your own analyses, your own components, one desk away from the people making the biggest calls Build the future of sustainable aviation in a secure India

About the company	Imagine a world where flying is as easy as taking a bus – where air travel isn't reserved for major cities, but reaches everyone, everywhere. No congested hubs, no security lines, no hours lost in transit. Just seamless, affordable, on-demand flights connecting thousands of destinations the world has overlooked for too long. We're building the future of mass aviation: a network of high-frequency, low-cost, 8-seater STOL (short take-off and landing) aircraft that make every city, town, and community accessible. Our aircraft take off and land from compact "air-stops" no bigger than a parking lot – no baggage belts, no bottlenecks, none of the expensive airport infrastructure that regional travel was never meant to need. But easy flight is the outcome of hard engineering – and that engineering doesn't stop at the airframe. The engine that powers it, the autonomy that flies it, the systems that defend it are all the same problem. So we're building three capabilities India should own itself: Civil: an 8-seater hybrid-electric STOL aircraft, designed ground-up for efficiency and built for affordability. Gas Turbine Engines: world-class gas turbine engines developed in-house, laying the foundations of a true aerospace ecosystem. Defence: sovereign autonomy and defence systems that perceive, decide, and act in the real world. Aerodynamics from first principles. Propulsion built in-house. Autonomy from day one. This isn't the supersonic fantasy you've been sold. It's the aviation our communities actually need.

About the company	● About the company (in short) -Coyu (www.coyu.com) is an early stage startup with a mission to transform the way Indian women discover and purchase premium fashion and lifestyle products. Recognizing the unique dynamics of the Indian market, where the premium fashion segment and the share of women's apparel are growing rapidly, Coyu is positioned to cater to these fast growing demand segments. By 2030, the Fashion & Lifestyle category in India is expected to be a $300 billion+ market, doubling from its current $150 billion value. Within this booming industry, women's fashion is set to be the largest growth category. Unlike the global trend where the women-to-men ratio in apparel share is about 2:1 in developed countries, India's share is currently just around 1:1 and is expected to grow faster than any other category within fashion.Despite the significant growth, there is a noticeable gap between premium mass-market products and luxury offerings in the Indian fashion and lifestyle sector. Coyu is strategically positioned to bridge this gap, offering products that elevate the premium experience while making luxury more accessible. By doing so, Coyu is creating a new space in the market, providing Indian women with a curated selection of fashion and lifestyle products that combine quality, design, and exclusivity at a more attainable price point. ● Founded by Mohit Gupta and Mukesh Bansal , Coyu's mission is to deliver a delightful and seamless shopping experience, both in-store and online. We are building an omnichannel premium destination dedicated to women's fashion and lifestyle, ensuring that our customers can enjoy the best of both worlds—whether they prefer the tactile experience of in-store shopping or the convenience of online purchasing. Through our innovative approach, Coyu aims to redefine premium shopping in India, offering a carefully curated selection that resonates with the modern Indian woman. Earlier this year, Coyu raised USD 26Mn in seed funding and is backed by top-tier VC firms like PeakXV, Prosus, Sofina and DST Global partners, and is well positioned to scale and build to its vision.

About the company	● About the company (in short) -Coyu (www.coyu.com) is an early stage startup with a mission to transform the way Indian women discover and purchase premium fashion and lifestyle products. Recognizing the unique dynamics of the Indian market, where the premium fashion segment and the share of women's apparel are growing rapidly, Coyu is positioned to cater to these fast growing demand segments. By 2030, the Fashion & Lifestyle category in India is expected to be a $300 billion+ market, doubling from its current $150 billion value. Within this booming industry, women's fashion is set to be the largest growth category. Unlike the global trend where the women-to-men ratio in apparel share is about 2:1 in developed countries, India's share is currently just around 1:1 and is expected to grow faster than any other category within fashion.Despite the significant growth, there is a noticeable gap between premium mass-market products and luxury offerings in the Indian fashion and lifestyle sector. Coyu is strategically positioned to bridge this gap, offering products that elevate the premium experience while making luxury more accessible. By doing so, Coyu is creating a new space in the market, providing Indian women with a curated selection of fashion and lifestyle products that combine quality, design, and exclusivity at a more attainable price point. ● Founded by Mohit Gupta and Mukesh Bansal , Coyu's mission is to deliver a delightful and seamless shopping experience, both in-store and online. We are building an omnichannel premium destination dedicated to women's fashion and lifestyle, ensuring that our customers can enjoy the best of both worlds—whether they prefer the tactile experience of in-store shopping or the convenience of online purchasing. Through our innovative approach, Coyu aims to redefine premium shopping in India, offering a carefully curated selection that resonates with the modern Indian woman. Earlier this year, Coyu raised USD 26Mn in seed funding and is backed by top-tier VC firms like PeakXV, Prosus, Sofina and DST Global partners, and is well positioned to scale and build to its vision.

Job Description
The role provides a very good mix of technical and business exposure to the exciting world of online advertising. As a part of the Product Management Team, you will work with world class engineering, data sciences, usability, business development, design and marketing teams to develop and evangelize one or more ground- breaking, globally distributed, large scale products. ● Product Analysts work with product managers to implement new products/features, as well as utilize data to suggest improvements. ● Utilize product data to research market trends. ● Create reports about the performance of a given product/feature and suggest possible improvements. ● Must liaise with numerous stakeholders from different business teams. ● Study the competition to see what is already on the market, and what upgrades can be introduced to create a better or more useful product. ● Monitor the products’ performance across different markets and prepare detailed reports.

companies.description:
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

About the company	Meesho is India’s e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce. Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders — consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators — to power inclusive growth at scale. We enable individuals and small businesses to sell online with ease, offering access to a wide customer base, integrated logistics, payment solutions, and platform support. For customers, Meesho offers a broad and affordable selection, tailored for diverse needs across Bharat. We also empower creators to build commerce-driven content that drives discovery and engagement. Our logistics operations are powered by Valmo, Meesho’s asset-light logistics platform that works entirely through partner-led infrastructure to ensure cost-efficient and scalable deliveries.

Job Description
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

Job Description
• You will contribute in partnership with appropriate stakeholder to determine user requirements for a feature and consider a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. • You will learn and contribute to processes for the architecture of a product/solution feature and learns to create proposals by testing design hypotheses and helping to refine code plans under the technical leadership of others as well as help produce code to test hypotheses for technical solutions and assists with technical validation efforts. • With guidance, you will learn to create and implement code that is extensible and maintainable and apply diagnosability, reliability and maintainabilit, and understand when the code is ready to be shared and delivered for a product, service, or feature reusing code as applicable • You will learn to review work items to gain knowledge of product features in partnership with appropriate stakeholders and assist and learn about breaking down work items into tasks and provides estimation as well as escalate any issues that would cause a delay. • You will learn about and contribute to operations of live service as issues arise on a rotational, on-call basis and identify solutions and mitigations to simple issues impacting performance or functionality of Live Site services and escalates as necessary. • You will help develop and contribute to automation within production and deployment of a product feature and run code in simulated or other non-production environments to confirm functionality and error-free runtime for products with oversight. • You will embody our culture and values.

Our unique IP assesses creditworthiness using multiple data sources and does not rely only on the bureau score, thus offering better approval rates and loan amounts. Role: Software Development Engineers (SDE-1) Summary: We are looking for Software Development Engineers (SDE-1) who are strong problem-solvers and passionate about building scalable, reliable products. You will take ownership of engineering problems, build impactful features, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to create technology that powers everyday community living. Roles & Responsibilities:  Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions.  Build robust, maintainable, production-ready features with measurable product impact.  Translate product requirements into effective technical designs and implementations.  Own features end-to-end, from development and testing through deployment.  Debug and resolve issues to improve system reliability, performance, and scalability.  Work with APIs, databases, distributed components, and application technologies.  Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to deliver solutions at scale.  Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering improvement initiatives. Requirements:  Strong fundamentals in Data Structures & Algorithms and Object Oriented Programming.  Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript.  Good understanding of DBMS, SQL, Operating Systems, and Computer Networks.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.  Ability to design logical and scalable solutions to technical problems  Strong ownership, execution, and attention to code quality.  Ability to learn quickly and work effectively in a fast-paced collaborative environment. Why Mygate? ● High-demand product with a massive market opportunity ● Work with a collaborative, fast-paced team where your impact is visible ● Be part of a well-funded start-up driving innovation in community living About Mygate: Mygate is India’s leading community living SaaS platform, trusted by 4 million+ residents across 25,000+ gated communities. At its core, Mygate is a Software-as-a-Service solution that empowers housing societies with a powerful suite of tools for security management, communication, payments, and community engagement. What began as a smarter way to manage visitor entry has evolved into a 360° living experience ecosystem, enabling communities to operate more efficiently while enhancing the quality of everyday life. Our Ecosystem Includes: ● SaaS Platform (Core): End-to-end community management software: visitor management, digital payments, facility booking, ERP integration, accounting, complaint management, and communication tools. ● Advertising Platform: A premium channel that connects brands with affluent, verified households inside gated communities. Expected to contribute ₹160+ crore annually, forming a key revenue driver. ● Smart Devices: Mygate Values: Expanding beyond software into IoT-powered security and lifestyle devices. Positioned as a ₹300 crore+ growth opportunity in home automation and consumer electronics. Innovation | Speed | Excellence | Client Service | Confidentiality | Collaboration | Frugality Disclaimer: Mygate is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in maintaining a diverse environment. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, or any other reason.

Nation with NaMo: The Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP) 2027 Associate When you picture yourself at the beginning of your career, what comes to your mind? A cubicle? A 9-to-5 job? Building Excel models to structure financial products? Hustling to launch a product in a new city? Pitching your business idea to potential investors? Working as part of a larger software team on a subset of a project? Researching legal positions and advising clients? We are confident that most likely you will end up doing these things as part of a reputed organization, working with good people in a steady job. And there is absolutely nothing wrong with that. If this aligns with your career aspirations, you can stop reading now, and we wish you the best in your career. However, if this is not quite enough for you, imagine this: Sitting in a village, understanding local issues and political trends. Brainstorm with your team to design an impactful election campaign. Strategizing with political stakeholders. Crafting messages that shape public opinion. Engaging in grassroots implementation to bring the campaign to the masses. Developing policy suggestions for election manifestos. Analyzing real-time data to predict electoral outcomes. Witnessing the tangible impact of your work on real people by solving real problems. And doing all this while supporting Prime Minister Modi and his party in their vision to build a new India. If this vision excites you, we have a role for you. If making a real impact is your priority, we welcome you to the Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP). Our team’s background We are a diverse team of passionate, talented young individuals on a mission to make India better through our work. We are creating a platform for young professionals to create real impact by supporting senior political leaders on electioneering, party capability building, and governance. Our team members come from some of the most prestigious academic institutions in the country, including IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, ISB Hyderabad, NLSIU Bangalore, SRCC, LSR and IIT Guwahati What does GILP offer? Every year, lakhs of bright minds graduate from top educational institutes in India and enter the corporate sector, yet the best minds often miss the chance to tackle the nation's most pressing issues. GILP aims to bridge this gap. For college graduates, GILP offers a program where passionate individuals interested in nation-building can actively engage with and contribute to the political ecosystem through direct interactions. It is one of the most ambitious talent development initiatives in our field, aligning with the best global programs in the corporate world. 1. Unique Experience: You will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a fulfilling career in an upcoming space, a chance to work with political stakeholders at all levels to gain in-depth exposure about politics and a real chance to contribute towards solving interesting, unsolved problems at scale. 2. Accelerated learning & growth: You will be part of a small handpicked team of diverse, passionate and talented individuals who will constantly challenge, support and work with you to achieve extraordinary outcomes. GILP will set you on the 9 year path to joining the organizational leadership. 3. Hands-on mentorship: As part of this program, you will be mentored by a team of seasoned professionals who have pioneered the evolution of this space and undertaken various electoral campaigns across the country. 4. Competitive remuneration: We understand the value of the talent we have in sustaining our success and we offer competitive remuneration as part of our commitment to our people. About the role - GILP Political Consultant Starting in the summer of 2027, Political Consultants will join various project teams, advising senior clients in the political domain. They will be involved in multiple election campaigns and tackle some of the most challenging policy and governance issues facing the country. Throughout these campaigns, political consultants interact closely with political leaders and organizers at the constituency, district, state, and national levels. This role offers significant exposure and opportunities but also comes with high expectations for maintaining confidentiality, demonstrating exemplary client management skills, and delivering strong performance. What are we looking for in our Associates? As part of GILP, we are looking for team members at the associate level who demonstrate the following traits: 1. Academic Excellence: Combine an impressive academic record with strong technical skills 2. Prioritise Impact: Optimise for impact above everything else 3. Structured Problem Solving: Tackle complex situations through effective and structured problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking 4. Effective Communication: Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills - both individually and in a group setting 5. Initiative: Adapt to dynamic and ambiguous situations with a clear bias for action 6. Teamwork: Contribute to the strong team ethic and work towards the success of the entire team 7. Leadership Skills: Display the requisite leadership qualities to take ideas forward 8. Strong Ethics: Possess uncompromising ethical principles Eligibility To be eligible to apply for the Political Consultant position in GILP, you must: 1. Be a final-year student at a top engineering, law, commerce, science, or arts college in the country. 2. Be graduating in 2027 from a graduate/undergraduate course (3, 4, or 5-year integrated programs) at such a college. Please note that postgraduate candidates are not eligible for GILP.

Job Description
Nation with NaMo: The Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP) 2027 Associate When you picture yourself at the beginning of your career, what comes to your mind? A cubicle? A 9-to-5 job? Building Excel models to structure financial products? Hustling to launch a product in a new city? Pitching your business idea to potential investors? Working as part of a larger software team on a subset of a project? Researching legal positions and advising clients? We are confident that most likely you will end up doing these things as part of a reputed organization, working with good people in a steady job. And there is absolutely nothing wrong with that. If this aligns with your career aspirations, you can stop reading now, and we wish you the best in your career. However, if this is not quite enough for you, imagine this: Sitting in a village, understanding local issues and political trends. Brainstorm with your team to design an impactful election campaign. Strategizing with political stakeholders. Crafting messages that shape public opinion. Engaging in grassroots implementation to bring the campaign to the masses. Developing policy suggestions for election manifestos. Analyzing real-time data to predict electoral outcomes. Witnessing the tangible impact of your work on real people by solving real problems. And doing all this while supporting Prime Minister Modi and his party in their vision to build a new India. If this vision excites you, we have a role for you. If making a real impact is your priority, we welcome you to the Graduate Impact Leadership Program (GILP). Our team’s background We are a diverse team of passionate, talented young individuals on a mission to make India better through our work. We are creating a platform for young professionals to create real impact by supporting senior political leaders on electioneering, party capability building, and governance. Our team members come from some of the most prestigious academic institutions in the country, including IIT Kanpur, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, ISB Hyderabad, NLSIU Bangalore, SRCC, LSR and IIT Guwahati What does GILP offer? Every year, lakhs of bright minds graduate from top educational institutes in India and enter the corporate sector, yet the best minds often miss the chance to tackle the nation's most pressing issues. GILP aims to bridge this gap. For college graduates, GILP offers a program where passionate individuals interested in nation-building can actively engage with and contribute to the political ecosystem through direct interactions. It is one of the most ambitious talent development initiatives in our field, aligning with the best global programs in the corporate world. 1. Unique Experience: You will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a fulfilling career in an upcoming space, a chance to work with political stakeholders at all levels to gain in-depth exposure about politics and a real chance to contribute towards solving interesting, unsolved problems at scale. 2. Accelerated learning & growth: You will be part of a small handpicked team of diverse, passionate and talented individuals who will constantly challenge, support and work with you to achieve extraordinary outcomes. GILP will set you on the 9 year path to joining the organizational leadership. 3. Hands-on mentorship: As part of this program, you will be mentored by a team of seasoned professionals who have pioneered the evolution of this space and undertaken various electoral campaigns across the country. 4. Competitive remuneration: We understand the value of the talent we have in sustaining our success and we offer competitive remuneration as part of our commitment to our people. About the role - GILP Political Consultant Starting in the summer of 2027, Political Consultants will join various project teams, advising senior clients in the political domain. They will be involved in multiple election campaigns and tackle some of the most challenging policy and governance issues facing the country. Throughout these campaigns, political consultants interact closely with political leaders and organizers at the constituency, district, state, and national levels. This role offers significant exposure and opportunities but also comes with high expectations for maintaining confidentiality, demonstrating exemplary client management skills, and delivering strong performance. What are we looking for in our Associates? As part of GILP, we are looking for team members at the associate level who demonstrate the following traits: 1. Academic Excellence: Combine an impressive academic record with strong technical skills 2. Prioritise Impact: Optimise for impact above everything else 3. Structured Problem Solving: Tackle complex situations through effective and structured problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking 4. Effective Communication: Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills - both individually and in a group setting 5. Initiative: Adapt to dynamic and ambiguous situations with a clear bias for action 6. Teamwork: Contribute to the strong team ethic and work towards the success of the entire team 7. Leadership Skills: Display the requisite leadership qualities to take ideas forward 8. Strong Ethics: Possess uncompromising ethical principles Eligibility To be eligible to apply for the Political Consultant position in GILP, you must: 1. Be a final-year student at a top engineering, law, commerce, science, or arts college in the country. 2. Be graduating in 2027 from a graduate/undergraduate course (3, 4, or 5-year integrated programs) at such a college. Please note that postgraduate candidates are not eligible for GILP.

Associate Product Manager I Location: Bengaluru About the Team Navi’s Product Team builds solutions that are simple, scalable, and centered on real user needs. The team strongly collaborates across functions—engineering, design, data, and business—to turn insight into impact. About the Role This role provides an opportunity for individuals with a foundational understanding of product analysis to contribute to data-driven decision-making and play a vital role in shaping the success of our products. The Product Analyst will work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and contribute to the overall product strategy. What We Expect From You Gather and analyze data to extract insights, providing valuable input for data-driven decision-making. Use SQL for efficient data querying and analysis. Identify and address product-related issues, relying on established procedures for basic problem-solving. Focus on user insights and data analysis for specific product features. Contribute to the understanding of product performance based on data-driven observations. Demonstrate basic awareness of design principles. Show a sense of good vs. bad design. Pay attention to detail in product analysis. Have basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Understand basic feature prioritization, typically guided by senior product management. Communicate clearly with all stakeholders, seeking help from managers in case of blockers or conflicts. Focus on data analysis and reporting to contribute to decision-making processes. Must Haves 0-2 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a related field. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data. Proficient in SQL for data querying and analysis. Basic understanding of user needs and product features. Basic awareness of design principles and the ability to distinguish good vs. bad design. Basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate findings and insights effectively. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. What We Expect From You Build and Deliver: Design scalable systems, develop, test and deploy high-quality technology solutions to solve real-world problems. Solve Complex Problems: Apply strong analytical thinking, engineering fundamentals and data-driven approaches to translate ambiguous problems into effective solutions. Explore and Innovate: Experiment with algorithms, architectures and emerging technologies across Software Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Data Engineering and GenAI. Own End-to-End Outcomes: Take accountability from problem definition and solution design through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Must Haves Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.
