Job Description
Software Engineer I Location: Bangalore About Navi We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold - we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. What We Expect From You Build and Deliver: Design scalable systems, develop, test and deploy high-quality technology solutions to solve real-world problems. Solve Complex Problems: Apply strong analytical thinking, engineering fundamentals and data-driven approaches to translate ambiguous problems into effective solutions. Explore and Innovate: Experiment with algorithms, architectures and emerging technologies across Software Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Data Engineering and GenAI. Own End-to-End Outcomes: Take accountability from problem definition and solution design through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Must Haves Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.

As a Data Scientist I at Navi, the candidate will be responsible for developing and deploying scalable data science and AI-driven solutions across financial services, including lending, insurance, investments, UPI, collections, KYC and recommendation systems. companies.description:
Data/App Engineer — Job Description Location: Pune, India Type: Full-Time Department: Product Engineering Reports To: Director of Engineering --- ## About Us At NexusOne, we are building the data and AI infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise intelligence. We believe AI is only as good as the data behind it — and most enterprises are not yet ready. That is the problem we solve. Our platform, NexusOne, is a composable data lakehouse built on Apache Iceberg, Spark, and Trino. It gives enterprises the modern, governed, AI-ready data foundation they need to move from experimentation to production — fast. Our clients include some of the largest financial institutions in the world, and we handle the hard work of data modernization so they can focus on what matters: making smarter decisions and building intelligent products. We are a team of builders across the US and India, and we are growing fast. --- ## The Opportunity We are looking for a Data/App Engineer to join our product and delivery team — someone who is excited about working at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the pipelines, features, and integrations that power real enterprise AI deployments, including agentic workflows that put data to work autonomously. You will work closely with solution architects and senior engineers to onboard enterprise customers onto NexusOne, build new product features, and contribute to the AI-native capabilities that make our platform differentiated. If you are intellectually curious, love learning new technologies, and want to see your work running at scale in production, this is the right place. --- ## What You Will Do - Assist in onboarding enterprise customer workloads to NexusOne, including data ingestion, transformation, analytics, AI ops, and application modernization - Build and deploy new product features with a focus on performance, quality, and scale - Contribute to agentic data workflows — pipelines and integrations that enable AI agents to act on enterprise data in real time - Work with modern data technologies including Kubernetes, Apache Spark, dbt, Trino, Airflow, and Iceberg - Use Python, Java, or Scala to implement product features and modernize customer workloads - Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities; contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement - Troubleshoot and debug data issues under the guidance of senior engineers - Participate in product roadmap discussions and rapid proof-of-concept evaluations --- ## Who You Are - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field - Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and coding best practices (flow control, inheritance, separation of concerns, error handling, etc.) - Experience or coursework with Python, Java/Scala, and/or .NET languages - Familiarity with backend concepts including object-oriented design, ETL, and REST APIs - Genuine curiosity about AI, agentic systems, and how data infrastructure enables intelligent automation - Experience with database systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a self-directed learning mindset - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across a distributed team - Preferred: familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and open source data projects --- ## Why NexusOne At NexusOne, you will be working on problems that actually matter — at the foundation of enterprise AI. The work is hard, the technology is cutting edge, and the team is excellent. We are building a culture where curiosity is rewarded, ownership is expected, and every engineer has a meaningful impact on what we ship. We are deeply committed to a collaborative, supportive environment where every voice is valued and every team member can grow. If you are ready to build the infrastructure that powers the next wave of enterprise intelligence, we would love to meet you.

Job Description
Data/App Engineer — Job Description Location: Pune, India Type: Full-Time Department: Product Engineering Reports To: Director of Engineering --- ## About Us At NexusOne, we are building the data and AI infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise intelligence. We believe AI is only as good as the data behind it — and most enterprises are not yet ready. That is the problem we solve. Our platform, NexusOne, is a composable data lakehouse built on Apache Iceberg, Spark, and Trino. It gives enterprises the modern, governed, AI-ready data foundation they need to move from experimentation to production — fast. Our clients include some of the largest financial institutions in the world, and we handle the hard work of data modernization so they can focus on what matters: making smarter decisions and building intelligent products. We are a team of builders across the US and India, and we are growing fast. --- ## The Opportunity We are looking for a Data/App Engineer to join our product and delivery team — someone who is excited about working at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the pipelines, features, and integrations that power real enterprise AI deployments, including agentic workflows that put data to work autonomously. You will work closely with solution architects and senior engineers to onboard enterprise customers onto NexusOne, build new product features, and contribute to the AI-native capabilities that make our platform differentiated. If you are intellectually curious, love learning new technologies, and want to see your work running at scale in production, this is the right place. --- ## What You Will Do - Assist in onboarding enterprise customer workloads to NexusOne, including data ingestion, transformation, analytics, AI ops, and application modernization - Build and deploy new product features with a focus on performance, quality, and scale - Contribute to agentic data workflows — pipelines and integrations that enable AI agents to act on enterprise data in real time - Work with modern data technologies including Kubernetes, Apache Spark, dbt, Trino, Airflow, and Iceberg - Use Python, Java, or Scala to implement product features and modernize customer workloads - Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities; contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement - Troubleshoot and debug data issues under the guidance of senior engineers - Participate in product roadmap discussions and rapid proof-of-concept evaluations --- ## Who You Are - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field - Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and coding best practices (flow control, inheritance, separation of concerns, error handling, etc.) - Experience or coursework with Python, Java/Scala, and/or .NET languages - Familiarity with backend concepts including object-oriented design, ETL, and REST APIs - Genuine curiosity about AI, agentic systems, and how data infrastructure enables intelligent automation - Experience with database systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a self-directed learning mindset - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across a distributed team - Preferred: familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and open source data projects --- ## Why NexusOne At NexusOne, you will be working on problems that actually matter — at the foundation of enterprise AI. The work is hard, the technology is cutting edge, and the team is excellent. We are building a culture where curiosity is rewarded, ownership is expected, and every engineer has a meaningful impact on what we ship. We are deeply committed to a collaborative, supportive environment where every voice is valued and every team member can grow. If you are ready to build the infrastructure that powers the next wave of enterprise intelligence, we would love to meet you.

Job Description
Data/App Engineer — Job Description Location: Pune, India Type: Full-Time Department: Product Engineering Reports To: Director of Engineering --- ## About Us At NexusOne, we are building the data and AI infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise intelligence. We believe AI is only as good as the data behind it — and most enterprises are not yet ready. That is the problem we solve. Our platform, NexusOne, is a composable data lakehouse built on Apache Iceberg, Spark, and Trino. It gives enterprises the modern, governed, AI-ready data foundation they need to move from experimentation to production — fast. Our clients include some of the largest financial institutions in the world, and we handle the hard work of data modernization so they can focus on what matters: making smarter decisions and building intelligent products. We are a team of builders across the US and India, and we are growing fast. --- ## The Opportunity We are looking for a Data/App Engineer to join our product and delivery team — someone who is excited about working at the intersection of modern data engineering and AI. This is not a maintenance role. You will be building the pipelines, features, and integrations that power real enterprise AI deployments, including agentic workflows that put data to work autonomously. You will work closely with solution architects and senior engineers to onboard enterprise customers onto NexusOne, build new product features, and contribute to the AI-native capabilities that make our platform differentiated. If you are intellectually curious, love learning new technologies, and want to see your work running at scale in production, this is the right place. --- ## What You Will Do - Assist in onboarding enterprise customer workloads to NexusOne, including data ingestion, transformation, analytics, AI ops, and application modernization - Build and deploy new product features with a focus on performance, quality, and scale - Contribute to agentic data workflows — pipelines and integrations that enable AI agents to act on enterprise data in real time - Work with modern data technologies including Kubernetes, Apache Spark, dbt, Trino, Airflow, and Iceberg - Use Python, Java, or Scala to implement product features and modernize customer workloads - Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities; contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement - Troubleshoot and debug data issues under the guidance of senior engineers - Participate in product roadmap discussions and rapid proof-of-concept evaluations --- ## Who You Are - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field - Foundational understanding of data structures, algorithms, and coding best practices (flow control, inheritance, separation of concerns, error handling, etc.) - Experience or coursework with Python, Java/Scala, and/or .NET languages - Familiarity with backend concepts including object-oriented design, ETL, and REST APIs - Genuine curiosity about AI, agentic systems, and how data infrastructure enables intelligent automation - Experience with database systems such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a self-directed learning mindset - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across a distributed team - Preferred: familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and open source data projects --- ## Why NexusOne At NexusOne, you will be working on problems that actually matter — at the foundation of enterprise AI. The work is hard, the technology is cutting edge, and the team is excellent. We are building a culture where curiosity is rewarded, ownership is expected, and every engineer has a meaningful impact on what we ship. We are deeply committed to a collaborative, supportive environment where every voice is valued and every team member can grow. If you are ready to build the infrastructure that powers the next wave of enterprise intelligence, we would love to meet you.

The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

Job Description
The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

companies.description:
Job Title: Founder’s Program – General Management Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We bring an entrepreneurial spirit to creating world-class products across mobility, electric vehicles, energy and AI. About the Founder’s Program The Founders Program is designed to bring the brightest minds together at Ola, immerse them in how entrepreneurial businesses are built, and channel their capabilities into the company’s highest-priority business outcomes. The objective is exceptional productivity and meaningful impact during the period each individual works with Ola. Participants are expected to learn quickly, have first-principles thinking, question assumptions, build solutions and deliver real results. The Program is designed around Velocity [Fast learning], Vertical Integration [Deep business understanding] and, Vision [Shape what’s next - Business Impact] The role ● The General Management stream offers a broad view of how our businesses operate and grow. ● Participants will work with experienced business leaders across business units, departments and functions, bringing a general management perspective to strategy, operations and execution. ● Participants will connect customer needs, commercial priorities, financial outcomes and operating realities to turn ideas into results. What you will do ● Translate leadership priorities into project plans, resolve dependencies and bring timely decisions to the right leaders. ● Own clearly defined business problems from diagnosis to implementation, with agreed targets, timelines and measurable solutions which create differential business impact. ● Analyze business data, trends, forecast, economics and operating processes to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency and better customer experience. ● Use AI and digital tools to improve research, analysis, decision-making and everyday business processes. ● Present progress, delivered impact and lessons learned to BU sponsors and senior leaders, taking accountability for outcomes. Where you could work Assignments may span automotive and manufacturing operations; sales, service and fulfillment; sourcing and supply chain; finance, HR, Finance, marketing and growth; mobility; and strategic businesses. Assignments depend on business priorities and individual fit; participants may go through 2-3 functional stints across the above areas in their first year. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from experienced business leaders and mentors through live projects, Founder/CXO interactions and cohort learning. Selected projects may involve working directly with the Founder/CXO. Your growth will be shaped by the ownership you take, the problems you solve and the impact you deliver. Bring curiosity, sound judgement and the drive to take a problem from an idea to a working solution. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Description
Job Title: Founder’s Program – General Management Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We bring an entrepreneurial spirit to creating world-class products across mobility, electric vehicles, energy and AI. About the Founder’s Program The Founders Program is designed to bring the brightest minds together at Ola, immerse them in how entrepreneurial businesses are built, and channel their capabilities into the company’s highest-priority business outcomes. The objective is exceptional productivity and meaningful impact during the period each individual works with Ola. Participants are expected to learn quickly, have first-principles thinking, question assumptions, build solutions and deliver real results. The Program is designed around Velocity [Fast learning], Vertical Integration [Deep business understanding] and, Vision [Shape what’s next - Business Impact] The role ● The General Management stream offers a broad view of how our businesses operate and grow. ● Participants will work with experienced business leaders across business units, departments and functions, bringing a general management perspective to strategy, operations and execution. ● Participants will connect customer needs, commercial priorities, financial outcomes and operating realities to turn ideas into results. What you will do ● Translate leadership priorities into project plans, resolve dependencies and bring timely decisions to the right leaders. ● Own clearly defined business problems from diagnosis to implementation, with agreed targets, timelines and measurable solutions which create differential business impact. ● Analyze business data, trends, forecast, economics and operating processes to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency and better customer experience. ● Use AI and digital tools to improve research, analysis, decision-making and everyday business processes. ● Present progress, delivered impact and lessons learned to BU sponsors and senior leaders, taking accountability for outcomes. Where you could work Assignments may span automotive and manufacturing operations; sales, service and fulfillment; sourcing and supply chain; finance, HR, Finance, marketing and growth; mobility; and strategic businesses. Assignments depend on business priorities and individual fit; participants may go through 2-3 functional stints across the above areas in their first year. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from experienced business leaders and mentors through live projects, Founder/CXO interactions and cohort learning. Selected projects may involve working directly with the Founder/CXO. Your growth will be shaped by the ownership you take, the problems you solve and the impact you deliver. Bring curiosity, sound judgement and the drive to take a problem from an idea to a working solution. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Title: Founder’s Program – Technology Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We bring an entrepreneurial spirit to creating world-class products across mobility, electric vehicles, energy and AI. About the Founder’s Program The Founders Program is designed to bring the brightest minds together at Ola, immerse them in how entrepreneurial businesses are built, and channel their capabilities into the company’s highest-priority business outcomes. The objective is exceptional productivity and meaningful impact during the period each individual works with Ola. Participants are expected to learn quickly, have first-principles thinking, question assumptions, build solutions and deliver real results. The Program is designed around Velocity [Fast learning], Vertical Integration [Deep business understanding] and, Vision [Shape what’s next - Business Impact] The role The Technology stream is for people who want to build through their technical expertise while working closely with experienced technology leaders and engaging with founders on priority problems. You will develop depth in an aligned technical team, understand the business context behind engineering decisions and contribute to solutions that work in practice. What you will do Work with technical leaders to define important problems, investigate root causes and turn first-principles ideas into testable solutions. Take hands-on ownership of design, development, experimentation or implementation within your assigned project. Build and test prototypes, models, systems or processes; use evidence to assess performance, reliability, quality and cost. Understand design trade-offs and work with product, operations and other technical teams to integrate solutions into real products and operating environments. Use AI and relevant technical tools to accelerate analysis, development, testing and automation while applying sound technical judgement. Communicate technical choices, results and risks clearly to BU leaders and, where relevant, the Founder’s Office; document learnings and deliver measurable technical outcomes. Where you could work Depending on technical alignment, interests and business requirements, assignments may be in: Automotive: vehicle engineering and product development for two- and four-wheelers, manufacturing engineering, quality, service and fulfilment systems. Cell business: cell research and development, manufacturing engineering and production technology. Battery energy storage systems (BESS): product, system and manufacturing challenges. Software & Product: product development, software engineering, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions across mobility, cell and automotive. Krutrim: cloud engineering, infrastructure and operations. Mobility and cross-business projects: technology-led solutions for customer, revenue, growth and Founder’s priorities. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from experienced technology leaders and BU mentors through hands-on projects, Founder/CXO interactions and cohort learning. Build technical depth alongside an understanding of how technology creates business value. Your growth will be shaped by the quality of your solutions, ownership and delivered impact. Bring technical curiosity, a willingness to test assumptions and the drive to turn ideas into working technology. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Title: Founder’s Program – Technology Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We bring an entrepreneurial spirit to creating world-class products across mobility, electric vehicles, energy and AI. About the Founder’s Program The Founders Program is designed to bring the brightest minds together at Ola, immerse them in how entrepreneurial businesses are built, and channel their capabilities into the company’s highest-priority business outcomes. The objective is exceptional productivity and meaningful impact during the period each individual works with Ola. Participants are expected to learn quickly, have first-principles thinking, question assumptions, build solutions and deliver real results. The Program is designed around Velocity [Fast learning], Vertical Integration [Deep business understanding] and, Vision [Shape what’s next - Business Impact] The role The Technology stream is for people who want to build through their technical expertise while working closely with experienced technology leaders and engaging with founders on priority problems. You will develop depth in an aligned technical team, understand the business context behind engineering decisions and contribute to solutions that work in practice. What you will do Work with technical leaders to define important problems, investigate root causes and turn first-principles ideas into testable solutions. Take hands-on ownership of design, development, experimentation or implementation within your assigned project. Build and test prototypes, models, systems or processes; use evidence to assess performance, reliability, quality and cost. Understand design trade-offs and work with product, operations and other technical teams to integrate solutions into real products and operating environments. Use AI and relevant technical tools to accelerate analysis, development, testing and automation while applying sound technical judgement. Communicate technical choices, results and risks clearly to BU leaders and, where relevant, the Founder’s Office; document learnings and deliver measurable technical outcomes. Where you could work Depending on technical alignment, interests and business requirements, assignments may be in: Automotive: vehicle engineering and product development for two- and four-wheelers, manufacturing engineering, quality, service and fulfilment systems. Cell business: cell research and development, manufacturing engineering and production technology. Battery energy storage systems (BESS): product, system and manufacturing challenges. Software & Product: product development, software engineering, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions across mobility, cell and automotive. Krutrim: cloud engineering, infrastructure and operations. Mobility and cross-business projects: technology-led solutions for customer, revenue, growth and Founder’s priorities. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from experienced technology leaders and BU mentors through hands-on projects, Founder/CXO interactions and cohort learning. Build technical depth alongside an understanding of how technology creates business value. Your growth will be shaped by the quality of your solutions, ownership and delivered impact. Bring technical curiosity, a willingness to test assumptions and the drive to turn ideas into working technology. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

companies.description:
Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Software, Cloud Engineering & AI Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We believe India has a golden opportunity and a destined responsibility to lead the global electric vehicle, clean-tech, and deep-tech revolution. With innovation, hyper-scale engineering, and an uncompromising entrepreneurial spirit, we are building world-class products across electric mobility, battery energy storage, connected platforms, and AI. Objective We look forward to bringing India’s brightest engineering minds into Ola Electric, immerse them in real-world high-throughput engineering challenges, and channel their technical capabilities into the company’s highest-priority digital and cloud initiatives. The objective is exceptional productivity, steep technical mastery, and meaningful impact from Day One. Trainees are expected to learn fast, apply first-principles thinking, question technical assumptions, architect resilient solutions, and deliver measurable engineering results. The role The Software & Cloud Engineering stream offers an immersive experience at the intersection of Enterprise Software, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Architecture. Trainees will be embedded directly within core digital engineering teams at our R&D Center, Ola Campus & Tech Hub in Bangalore. Participants will work closely with distinguished software architects, engineering leaders, and product squads to design, build, and scale resilient microservices, internal developer platforms, and high-availability cloud infrastructure powering Ola Electric’s global footprint. Trainees will connect real-time vehicle telemetry, high-throughput consumer services, cloud-native infrastructure, and operating reliability to turn complex technical challenges into rock-solid software systems. What you will do Microservices & Distributed Systems: Design, develop, and deploy scalable microservices using Java, Go, Python, or Node.js to power core business workflows, fleet management, and consumer applications. Data Modeling & High-Throughput Engines: Architect efficient relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra) schemas to handle high-volume transaction processing and mission-critical state management. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Automation: Provision and manage multi-region cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and maintain container orchestration platforms on Kubernetes (EKS/GKE). Real-Time Telemetry & Event Streaming: Build and optimize event-driven streaming pipelines (Apache Kafka, MQTT, Flink) ingesting millions of vehicle data points per second from MoveOS-connected vehicles. CI/CD & Developer Platforms: Develop automated build, test, and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) with canary deployments, zero-downtime rollouts, and service mesh architectures (Istio, Envoy). Reliability, Security & Observability: Embed proactive monitoring, distributed tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), chaos engineering, and enterprise security (OAuth2/JWT, RBAC) to ensure 99.99% system availability. Where you could work Assignments may span Core Digital Products & MoveOS Cloud; Connected Fleet Telemetry & IoT Platforms; Charging Infrastructure & Grid Tech; Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) at Futurefactory; Customer & Commercial Platforms; and Enterprise Core Services. Assignments are determined by mission-critical technical priorities and individual technical strengths; participants may take on focused stints or end-to-end service ownership within these domains during their first year. Candidate profile & what you bring Foundations & Education: Graduating UG / PG in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related streams with strong academic credentials. Computer Science Depth: Rock-solid fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and Database Systems. Programming & Modern Tech: Hands-on proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Go, Python, C++, TypeScript) along with exposure to Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes, and Git. Mindset & Approach: First-principles thinker, relentless problem solver, and fast learner with the curiosity and drive to take an architectural concept from whiteboarding to production. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from seasoned software architects, platform engineering leads, and technology fellows through live mission-critical projects, tech-talks, and cohort learning. Selected high-impact projects will involve collaborating directly with engineering executive leadership. Your growth will be shaped by the technical ownership you take, the distributed systems you scale, and the architectural breakthroughs you deliver. Bring curiosity, sound technical judgement, and the drive to build robust software systems that shape the future of mobility. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Description
Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Software, Cloud Engineering & AI Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. We believe India has a golden opportunity and a destined responsibility to lead the global electric vehicle, clean-tech, and deep-tech revolution. With innovation, hyper-scale engineering, and an uncompromising entrepreneurial spirit, we are building world-class products across electric mobility, battery energy storage, connected platforms, and AI. Objective We look forward to bringing India’s brightest engineering minds into Ola Electric, immerse them in real-world high-throughput engineering challenges, and channel their technical capabilities into the company’s highest-priority digital and cloud initiatives. The objective is exceptional productivity, steep technical mastery, and meaningful impact from Day One. Trainees are expected to learn fast, apply first-principles thinking, question technical assumptions, architect resilient solutions, and deliver measurable engineering results. The role The Software & Cloud Engineering stream offers an immersive experience at the intersection of Enterprise Software, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Architecture. Trainees will be embedded directly within core digital engineering teams at our R&D Center, Ola Campus & Tech Hub in Bangalore. Participants will work closely with distinguished software architects, engineering leaders, and product squads to design, build, and scale resilient microservices, internal developer platforms, and high-availability cloud infrastructure powering Ola Electric’s global footprint. Trainees will connect real-time vehicle telemetry, high-throughput consumer services, cloud-native infrastructure, and operating reliability to turn complex technical challenges into rock-solid software systems. What you will do Microservices & Distributed Systems: Design, develop, and deploy scalable microservices using Java, Go, Python, or Node.js to power core business workflows, fleet management, and consumer applications. Data Modeling & High-Throughput Engines: Architect efficient relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra) schemas to handle high-volume transaction processing and mission-critical state management. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Automation: Provision and manage multi-region cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and maintain container orchestration platforms on Kubernetes (EKS/GKE). Real-Time Telemetry & Event Streaming: Build and optimize event-driven streaming pipelines (Apache Kafka, MQTT, Flink) ingesting millions of vehicle data points per second from MoveOS-connected vehicles. CI/CD & Developer Platforms: Develop automated build, test, and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) with canary deployments, zero-downtime rollouts, and service mesh architectures (Istio, Envoy). Reliability, Security & Observability: Embed proactive monitoring, distributed tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), chaos engineering, and enterprise security (OAuth2/JWT, RBAC) to ensure 99.99% system availability. Where you could work Assignments may span Core Digital Products & MoveOS Cloud; Connected Fleet Telemetry & IoT Platforms; Charging Infrastructure & Grid Tech; Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) at Futurefactory; Customer & Commercial Platforms; and Enterprise Core Services. Assignments are determined by mission-critical technical priorities and individual technical strengths; participants may take on focused stints or end-to-end service ownership within these domains during their first year. Candidate profile & what you bring Foundations & Education: Graduating UG / PG in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related streams with strong academic credentials. Computer Science Depth: Rock-solid fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and Database Systems. Programming & Modern Tech: Hands-on proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Go, Python, C++, TypeScript) along with exposure to Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes, and Git. Mindset & Approach: First-principles thinker, relentless problem solver, and fast learner with the curiosity and drive to take an architectural concept from whiteboarding to production. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from seasoned software architects, platform engineering leads, and technology fellows through live mission-critical projects, tech-talks, and cohort learning. Selected high-impact projects will involve collaborating directly with engineering executive leadership. Your growth will be shaped by the technical ownership you take, the distributed systems you scale, and the architectural breakthroughs you deliver. Bring curiosity, sound technical judgement, and the drive to build robust software systems that shape the future of mobility. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Where you could work Assignments may span Core Digital Products & MoveOS Cloud; Connected Fleet Telemetry & IoT Platforms; Charging Infrastructure & Grid Tech; Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) at Futurefactory; Customer & Commercial Platforms; and Enterprise Core Services. Candidate profile & what you bring Foundations & Education: Graduating UG / PG in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related streams with strong academic credentials. Programming & Modern Tech: Hands-on proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Go, Python, C++, TypeScript) along with exposure to Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes, and Git. Mindset & Approach: First-principles thinker, relentless problem solver, and fast learner with the curiosity and drive to take an architectural concept from whiteboarding to production. Learning, exposure and growth Learn from seasoned software architects, platform engineering leads, and technology fellows through live mission-critical projects, tech-talks, and cohort learning. Selected high-impact projects will involve collaborating directly with engineering executive leadership. Your growth will be shaped by the technical ownership you take, the distributed systems you scale, and the architectural breakthroughs you deliver. Bring curiosity, sound technical judgement, and the drive to build robust software systems that shape the future of mobility. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Product Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. Ola Electric brings this vision to sustainable mobility through EV design, advanced cell chemistry, lightweight engineering and large-scale manufacturing. Objective We look forward to bringing India’s brightest engineering minds into Ola Electric, immerse them in real-world high- throughput engineering challenges, and channel their technical capabilities into the company’s highest-priority across core engineering, manufacturing and R&D functions. Working with experienced engineers, trainees will apply first- principles thinking and technical rigour to improve product quality, structural integrity and manufacturing scalability. The Role Work at the intersection of mechanical design, advanced manufacturing, metallurgy and polymer engineering, supporting the development and production of electric vehicles. Collaborate with R&D, Quality Control, Supply Chain and Plant Operations to connect engineering design with mass production and take ownership of defined technical projects. What you will do Mechanical engineering and vehicle systems ● Support CAD/FEA design, simulation and structural optimization of chassis systems, battery enclosures, thermal management systems and powertrain housings. ● Investigate mechanical wear, stress, fatigue and noise, vibration and harshness (NVH); support endurance, crashworthiness and thermal abuse testing of EV components. Manufacturing and process engineering ● Gain exposure to automated assembly, robotic welding, precision stamping and automated cell packaging at the Futurefactory/ Gigafactory/ OLA R&D Campus. ● Apply Lean, Six Sigma, statistical process control (SPC) and design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) to improve yield, reduce cycle time and eliminate defects across die-casting, injection molding and painting. Metallurgy and advanced polymers ● Evaluate high-strength steels, aluminum alloys and polymer composites for weight reduction and safety. Use microscopy and mechanical testing to investigate grain structures, failures, corrosion and thermal degradation. ● Support the development and evaluation of flame-retardant polymers, thermal interface materials and lightweight enclosures for high-voltage EV battery packs. Where you could work ● Business unit: Ola Electric – Engineering and Manufacturing Operations. Assignments span mechanical engineering, manufacturing and process engineering, metallurgy, advanced polymers and R&D. ● Location: Future/Giga factory (Krishnagiri / Hosur) and R&D Center (Bangalore). What you will bring ● B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing / Production Engineering, Metallurgy, Materials Science or Polymer Technology, from the graduating batch. ● Strong engineering fundamentals relevant to your discipline, including mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, heat transfer, manufacturing processes, polymer chemistry and physical metallurgy. ● An analytical, first-principles approach to solving complex and unstructured engineering problems. ● Familiarity with CAD/CAE tools such as CATIA, SolidWorks, ANSYS or Creo, statistical analysis software, or material characterization techniques. ● Curiosity, energy, ownership and the ability to collaborate and execute in a fast-paced engineering environment. Learning exposure and growth Learn alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing professionals through hands-on technical work. Build experience in design, validation, materials and production while delivering improvements in manufacturing scalability, material efficiency and product performance. Bring curiosity, sound judgement and the drive to take an engineering problem from an idea to a working solution. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Description
Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Product Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Context At Ola, our vision is to build the technologies of the future and businesses of global impact, from India for the world. Ola Electric brings this vision to sustainable mobility through EV design, advanced cell chemistry, lightweight engineering and large-scale manufacturing. Objective We look forward to bringing India’s brightest engineering minds into Ola Electric, immerse them in real-world high- throughput engineering challenges, and channel their technical capabilities into the company’s highest-priority across core engineering, manufacturing and R&D functions. Working with experienced engineers, trainees will apply first- principles thinking and technical rigour to improve product quality, structural integrity and manufacturing scalability. The Role Work at the intersection of mechanical design, advanced manufacturing, metallurgy and polymer engineering, supporting the development and production of electric vehicles. Collaborate with R&D, Quality Control, Supply Chain and Plant Operations to connect engineering design with mass production and take ownership of defined technical projects. What you will do Mechanical engineering and vehicle systems ● Support CAD/FEA design, simulation and structural optimization of chassis systems, battery enclosures, thermal management systems and powertrain housings. ● Investigate mechanical wear, stress, fatigue and noise, vibration and harshness (NVH); support endurance, crashworthiness and thermal abuse testing of EV components. Manufacturing and process engineering ● Gain exposure to automated assembly, robotic welding, precision stamping and automated cell packaging at the Futurefactory/ Gigafactory/ OLA R&D Campus. ● Apply Lean, Six Sigma, statistical process control (SPC) and design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) to improve yield, reduce cycle time and eliminate defects across die-casting, injection molding and painting. Metallurgy and advanced polymers ● Evaluate high-strength steels, aluminum alloys and polymer composites for weight reduction and safety. Use microscopy and mechanical testing to investigate grain structures, failures, corrosion and thermal degradation. ● Support the development and evaluation of flame-retardant polymers, thermal interface materials and lightweight enclosures for high-voltage EV battery packs. Where you could work ● Business unit: Ola Electric – Engineering and Manufacturing Operations. Assignments span mechanical engineering, manufacturing and process engineering, metallurgy, advanced polymers and R&D. ● Location: Future/Giga factory (Krishnagiri / Hosur) and R&D Center (Bangalore). What you will bring ● B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing / Production Engineering, Metallurgy, Materials Science or Polymer Technology, from the graduating batch. ● Strong engineering fundamentals relevant to your discipline, including mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, heat transfer, manufacturing processes, polymer chemistry and physical metallurgy. ● An analytical, first-principles approach to solving complex and unstructured engineering problems. ● Familiarity with CAD/CAE tools such as CATIA, SolidWorks, ANSYS or Creo, statistical analysis software, or material characterization techniques. ● Curiosity, energy, ownership and the ability to collaborate and execute in a fast-paced engineering environment. Learning exposure and growth Learn alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing professionals through hands-on technical work. Build experience in design, validation, materials and production while delivering improvements in manufacturing scalability, material efficiency and product performance. Bring curiosity, sound judgement and the drive to take an engineering problem from an idea to a working solution. #BuildTheFuture with Ola.

Job Description: Operations Research Scientist I : ORMAE is looking for Operations Research Scientist with good analytics background to deliver solutions for complex problems of our clients. OR Scientist I Should have a scientific mindset and interest in Operation Research algorithms like routing optimization, mathematical modeling, meta-heuristics, heuristics, forecasting, simulation model, inventory optimization. (S)he should have supply chain management background along with advanced analytics experience. (S)He should have strong interest and ability to solve mathematical modelling including LP tools like Cplex, Gurobi, AIIMS, GAMS, AMPL. Programming experience in Python/Java/C#/ C++/R of the optimization algorithm is preferred including background in data structures, graph theory, object oriented programming. Software Engineer, Gen AI & Robotics About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role You’ll build the software that turns a capable robot into a product customers rely on, from the Claude code like agentic harness, the cloud services and data infrastructure down to the robot software itself. What you’ll work on Physical agentic framework: Build agents that turn a job into a plan of steps, execute each one, verify it against real operating procedures, and escalate to a human when unsure. Build in tool use, memory, failure recovery, and human-in-the-loop handoffs. Cloud planners and fleet orchestration: Build services that break work orders into tasks, schedule them across robot fleets, and track progress and exceptions in real time. Vertical integrations and product: Connect our agents to each industry’s existing systems, such as data center management, ticketing, maintenance workflows, and manufacturing execution systems. Build customer-facing dashboards, job setup, and audit trails. On-robot software and hardware integration: Build the ROS-based stack for perception, control, and task execution. Bring up and integrate robot arms, sensors, cameras, and teleop rigs. Data infrastructure and tooling: Build ingest, storage, indexing, and retrieval for large volumes of multimodal robot data. Build the tools our data operations team uses daily for capture, review, and annotation. Training and evaluation infrastructure: Partner with ML engineers on job orchestration, compute management, and reproducible pipelines. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related branch Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and systems design Fluency in Python and at least one of C++, Rust, Go, or TypeScript At least one substantial project you built and shipped, where other people used it or it ran on something real Preferred Experience building with LLMs and agents: tool use, planning, and agent frameworks Experience with backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP, containers, databases) Frontend experience: you can put a usable UI in front of a backend (React or similar) Experience with ROS or ROS 2, embedded systems, or real-time software Experience with distributed systems or data pipelines (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet) Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects Internships at product companies or startups, or meaningful open-source contributions What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Job Profile

PLACEMENT	Machine Learning Engineer, Robotic Foundation Models	3500000 INR			7.5

Job Description
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. PLACEMENT	Machine Learning Engineer, Robotic Foundation Models	3500000 INR
Job Description
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Description
As an APM, you'll own a slice of a live product from day one, working with engineering, design, data and content. You'll be placed in one or more of these areas, depending on business needs and your strengths: • Building learning solutions at scale, including practice, tests and assessment • Building AI tutors and conversational learning and support experiences • Solving deep consumer-internet engagement and retention problems • Optimising growth funnels, from acquisition to activation to conversion What you'll do • Understand learners deeply through data, user research and conversations, and turn insights into clear problems worth solving • Define, prototype and ship features, using AI tools to move faster than a traditional PM could • Write sharp product specs, set success metrics and run experiments • Work with engineers and designers to take ideas from prototype to production • Track outcomes, learn from what didn't work, and iterate quickly Who we're looking for • Hands-on builders who are ahead of the curve on AI. We care more about what you've built than where you've studied. • You've built and shipped something: a product, prototype, side project, startup or business, however small • You use AI tools daily to build, ship and think, and can show it (portfolio, GitHub repo, live demo) • You're comfortable with the technical side and can work with engineers as a peer • You're curious about users and have strong analytical and structured-thinking skills • You communicate clearly in writing and in person Strong plus: a prior product internship at a startup or a fast-moving tech company.

companies.description:
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

Based on the philosophy of ‘Doing Well and Doing Good’, the Group continues to create long-term value for its stakeholders and the community at large. The values of Knowledge, Action, Care and Impact have helped us develop a reputation of integrity, customer[1]centricity and long-term value creation for all our stakeholders. The Group aspires to create a positive impact on the society with each endeavor. Piramal Retail Finance, the consumer lending platform of Piramal Enterprises Limited, engages in various financial services businesses. It is focused on serving all lending needs of consumers and small businesses across Bharat, differentiating through product personalisation & superior customer experience. currently offers multiple products in its target markets including Affordable Housing loans, Mass Affluent Housing loans, Loans Against Property, Secured Small Business Lending, Digital Purchase Finance, Digital Personal Loans, and Used-Car loans across Tier I, II and III cities. Focused on building strong partnerships, the Company offers an Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled multi-product retail lending platform by augmenting a ‘Digital at its Core’ strategy via physical customer connect-points for budget customers of Bharat. Its vision is to reach to ‘Bharat’ customer segments, especially those that do not have easy access to the Indian financial systems, across geographies. SDE - 1
