About the company	Piramal Group is a global business conglomerate with diverse interests in Pharma, Financial Services and Real Estate. The Group has offices in over 30 countries and a global brand presence in more than 100 markets and has a global team of over 10,000 people from 21 diverse nationalities Led by Mr. Ajay Piramal, the Chairman, Piramal Group is a torchbearer of trusteeship and responsible business ethos. Based on the philosophy of ‘Doing Well and Doing Good’, the Group continues to create long-term value for its stakeholders and the community at large. The values of Knowledge, Action, Care and Impact have helped us develop a reputation of integrity, customer[1]centricity and long-term value creation for all our stakeholders. The Group aspires to create a positive impact on the society with each endeavor. Piramal Retail Finance, the consumer lending platform of Piramal Enterprises Limited, engages in various financial services businesses. It is focused on serving all lending needs of consumers and small businesses across Bharat, differentiating through product personalisation & superior customer experience. currently offers multiple products in its target markets including Affordable Housing loans, Mass Affluent Housing loans, Loans Against Property, Secured Small Business Lending, Digital Purchase Finance, Digital Personal Loans, and Used-Car loans across Tier I, II and III cities. Focused on building strong partnerships, the Company offers an Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled multi-product retail lending platform by augmenting a ‘Digital at its Core’ strategy via physical customer connect-points for budget customers of Bharat. Its vision is to reach to ‘Bharat’ customer segments, especially those that do not have easy access to the Indian financial systems, across geographies. SDE - 1

Qualifications : The ideal candidate will have : - A strong background in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming, preferably in C++ or C. - Strong working knowledge of Linux - Knowledge with Python and Shell - The ability to notice, analyze, and resolve problems quickly and effectively - The capacity to multitask in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment Please Note: This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: Bachelor’s and Dual Degree in Computer Science and Engineering Bachelor’s and Dual Degree in Electrical Engineering (excluding Instrumentation Engineering) Bachelor’s and Dual Degree in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering Bachelor’s and Dual Degree/Integrated Masters in Mathematics In addition, eligibility will extend to students from other departments who are pursuing a Minor in Computer Science.

companies.description:
Curious Learner | Structured Thinker | Strong Problem Solver As an Associate Product Manager at Porter, you work alongside experienced PMs on products that power millions of real-world transactions for customers and driver-partners. You take small, well-defined problems, execute them with guidance, and build the foundational skills to grow into independent product ownership. You are trusted with: ● Leading execution on a defined feature or workstream within a larger product charter ● Translating user and data insights into clear user stories ● Learning how product decisions connect to business impact ● Building strong execution habits and product fundamentals from day one This role is about building strong foundations through hands-on execution. You work on clearly scoped tasks with close guidance, and deliver real outcomes as you learn and grow. Key Responsibilities Learn to Identify Problems ● Conduct research with customers, driver-partners, and ground ops teams to understand real pain points ● Support discovery research for your workstream, testing hypotheses through data analysis ● Practice framing problems clearly before jumping to solutions Execute with Guidance ● Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria with minimal guidance ● Understand the technical context of proposed solutions ● Drive execution end-to-end from problem definition to launch and post-release validations Execution & Planning ● Break down assigned tasks into clear steps, flagging risks early ● Actively participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives) to stay aligned with team priorities ● Share updates on progress and risks with relevant team members Data & Metrics ● Support data collection and documentation for your workstream ● Develop a foundational understanding of key product and business metrics ● Use available data and insights to support decisions Business & Product Understanding ● Learn the company’s mission, vision, and business model ● Understand the product, its key features, and how it serves customers ● Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and execute assigned tasks Team & Collaboration ● Build relationships within your immediate team and collaborate on assigned tasks ● Follow predefined communication processes to ensure visibility and transparency ● Seek feedback proactively and act on it Continuous Learning ● Use AI tools to work more efficiently, and learn to validate their outputs yourself ● Stay curious - ask questions, seek context, and learn from the senior PMs around you What We’re Looking For Experience ● This role is designed as an entry point into product management ● Internships, projects, case competitions, or side builds that show product thinking are a plus Skills ● Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability ● Comfort with data (Excel or SQL); ability to read numbers and draw insights ● Clear written and verbal communication ● Basic understanding of how technology products are built ● A genuine curiosity about how large-scale consumer products work AI & First-Principles Thinking ● Use AI as a productivity tool and learn to validate its outputs independently ● Break problems down to fundamentals rather than relying on frameworks alone Leadership & Mindset (what we’ll look for as you grow into this role) ● Own It: Delivers results on assigned tasks and takes accountability for outcomes ● Keep Moving: Prioritises well on defined tasks and adapts to change ● Empathy Driven: Communicates clearly, seeks feedback, and shares disagreements transparently ● Collaborate to Win: Works well with others and responds effectively to team needs ● User Obsession: Builds an understanding of user needs through guided research ● Curious, coachable, and eager to learn quickly Why Join Porter? ● Learn product management hands-on at massive scale from day one ● Work alongside and be mentored by experienced PMs ● Build strong execution fundamentals in a high-ownership culture ● Work in a culture that values ownership, frugality, speed, and impact ● A clear growth path Location: Bengaluru, India

SDE-1 Job Description — Porter About Porter Porter is building the operating system for intra-city logistics in India. With ~25 million orders per month, 500K+ daily-active drivers, and 1.5x growth expected next year, we solve complex real-world problems at massive scale, balancing speed, reliability, and cost efficiency in a highly operational environment. Role Overview Strong Individual Contributor | Reliable Builder | Future System Owner As a SDE-1 at Porter, you build and ship production code that powers millions of real-world transactions. You take well-scoped problems, own them end-to-end at the feature or module level, and deliver them with quality. You are trusted with: Owning features and modules within a larger service Writing clean, modular, production-ready code Making sound technical choices with an understanding of business impact Learning fast and growing into ownership of larger system components This role is about strong individual execution with growing ownership. You work independently on defined problems and seek guidance on ambiguous or complex ones. Key Responsibilities Build Production-Quality Software Design and implement features and modules within our backend services and distributed systems. Write clean, modular, efficient code that follows best practices and is easy to extend. Apply domain and system design principles to build components that scale. Drive Low-Level Design for your features, with review and guidance from senior engineers; contribute to High-Level Design discussions. Think through edge cases, failure modes, and performance implications of the code you ship. Own Your Deliverables Deliver results end-to-end at the feature level: from design to code, testing, deployment, and validation in production. Find practical ways to prevent mistakes (tests, checks, safer rollouts) and raise them with the team. Balance competing demands and keep your work on track; seek guidance to align others when needed. Look for cost-effective ways to build and run what you own. Operational Hygiene Follow standard operating procedures for deployments, releases, and on-call. Track and report basic operational metrics for your features, with guidance. Participate in monitoring and alerting to improve system stability. Assist in debugging and resolving production incidents under the guidance of senior engineers. Execution & Planning Break down goals into actionable tasks and milestones, anticipating risks along the way. Plan and execute small projects with defined timelines and constraints. Manage dependencies and adjust plans when unforeseen issues come up. Communicate progress and blockers clearly and early to stakeholders. Business & Product Impact Understand how your features affect drivers, customers, and cost efficiency. Track key metrics for what you build and use data to adjust technical priorities. Align your technical work with business and user needs, prioritizing impact. Recognize distinct user needs and apply established solutions, with guidance where needed. Team & Collaboration Collaborate with Product, Data, and Operations to deliver on shared goals. Seek and act on feedback; give constructive feedback in code reviews and discussions. Share disagreements openly and respectfully. Contribute to team cohesion and engineering culture within your pod. Continuous Learning Explore new tools and methodologies, including AI tools, to work more efficiently. Identify opportunities to improve processes and code. Keep learning and share what you learn with peers. What We're Looking For Experience 0–2 years of software development experience (strong new graduates welcome). Experience building and shipping software, through internships, production work, or substantial projects. Exposure to backend services and APIs is a must. Exposure to cloud infrastructure is a plus. Interest in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. Technical Skills Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, along with its frameworks and tooling. Working knowledge of databases, APIs, and basic system design concepts. Familiarity with testing, debugging, and version control practices. AI & First-Principles Thinking Uses AI as a productivity tool, not a crutch. Validates AI-generated code and reasons through it independently. Breaks problems down to fundamentals rather than pattern-matching solutions. Leadership & Mindset Own It: delivers results individually and takes accountability for quality. Keep Moving: prioritizes well, breaks down complex goals, and adapts to change. Empathy Driven: communicates clearly, seeks feedback, and shares disagreements transparently. Collaborate to Win: works well with others and makes independent decisions on defined problems. User Obsession: understands who the user is and why the work matters to them. Curious, coachable, and eager to grow quickly. Why Join Porter? Build systems that operate at massive real-world scale from day one. Solve unique logistics and operational challenges. Learn fast alongside strong engineers through code reviews, mentorship, and real ownership. Work in a culture that values ownership, frugality, speed, and impact. A clear growth path.

About the company	Founded in 2014, Porter is a leading Goods Transport Agency offering a wide range of logistics solutions. The company operates across multiple segments of the logistics sector, including on-demand intra-city goods transportation through various categories of vehicles, Packers & Movers and Porter Enterprise. Backed by a 2,600-member team, Porter has leveraged technology to drive efficiencies, offer MSMEs accessible and cost-effective logistics, and strengthen India’s transition towards an organized and connected economy. Porter serves over 30 lakh customers - including 20 lakh MSMEs and 3 lakh driver-partners every month across 35 cities in India. Having started its journey in India, Porter has now expanded its footprint internationally across two countries.

Job Description
SDE-1 Job Description — Porter About Porter Porter is building the operating system for intra-city logistics in India. With ~25 million orders per month, 500K+ daily-active drivers, and 1.5x growth expected next year, we solve complex real-world problems at massive scale, balancing speed, reliability, and cost efficiency in a highly operational environment. Role Overview Strong Individual Contributor | Reliable Builder | Future System Owner As a SDE-1 at Porter, you build and ship production code that powers millions of real-world transactions. You take well-scoped problems, own them end-to-end at the feature or module level, and deliver them with quality. You are trusted with: Owning features and modules within a larger service Writing clean, modular, production-ready code Making sound technical choices with an understanding of business impact Learning fast and growing into ownership of larger system components This role is about strong individual execution with growing ownership. You work independently on defined problems and seek guidance on ambiguous or complex ones. Key Responsibilities Build Production-Quality Software Design and implement features and modules within our backend services and distributed systems. Write clean, modular, efficient code that follows best practices and is easy to extend. Apply domain and system design principles to build components that scale. Drive Low-Level Design for your features, with review and guidance from senior engineers; contribute to High-Level Design discussions. Think through edge cases, failure modes, and performance implications of the code you ship. Own Your Deliverables Deliver results end-to-end at the feature level: from design to code, testing, deployment, and validation in production. Find practical ways to prevent mistakes (tests, checks, safer rollouts) and raise them with the team. Balance competing demands and keep your work on track; seek guidance to align others when needed. Look for cost-effective ways to build and run what you own. Operational Hygiene Follow standard operating procedures for deployments, releases, and on-call. Track and report basic operational metrics for your features, with guidance. Participate in monitoring and alerting to improve system stability. Assist in debugging and resolving production incidents under the guidance of senior engineers. Execution & Planning Break down goals into actionable tasks and milestones, anticipating risks along the way. Plan and execute small projects with defined timelines and constraints. Manage dependencies and adjust plans when unforeseen issues come up. Communicate progress and blockers clearly and early to stakeholders. Business & Product Impact Understand how your features affect drivers, customers, and cost efficiency. Track key metrics for what you build and use data to adjust technical priorities. Align your technical work with business and user needs, prioritizing impact. Recognize distinct user needs and apply established solutions, with guidance where needed. Team & Collaboration Collaborate with Product, Data, and Operations to deliver on shared goals. Seek and act on feedback; give constructive feedback in code reviews and discussions. Share disagreements openly and respectfully. Contribute to team cohesion and engineering culture within your pod. Continuous Learning Explore new tools and methodologies, including AI tools, to work more efficiently. Identify opportunities to improve processes and code. Keep learning and share what you learn with peers. What We're Looking For Experience 0–2 years of software development experience (strong new graduates welcome). Experience building and shipping software, through internships, production work, or substantial projects. Exposure to backend services and APIs is a must. Exposure to cloud infrastructure is a plus. Interest in fast-paced, high-ownership environments. Technical Skills Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, along with its frameworks and tooling. Working knowledge of databases, APIs, and basic system design concepts. Familiarity with testing, debugging, and version control practices. AI & First-Principles Thinking Uses AI as a productivity tool, not a crutch. Validates AI-generated code and reasons through it independently. Breaks problems down to fundamentals rather than pattern-matching solutions. Leadership & Mindset Own It: delivers results individually and takes accountability for quality. Keep Moving: prioritizes well, breaks down complex goals, and adapts to change. Empathy Driven: communicates clearly, seeks feedback, and shares disagreements transparently. Collaborate to Win: works well with others and makes independent decisions on defined problems. User Obsession: understands who the user is and why the work matters to them. Curious, coachable, and eager to grow quickly. Why Join Porter? Build systems that operate at massive real-world scale from day one. Solve unique logistics and operational challenges. Learn fast alongside strong engineers through code reviews, mentorship, and real ownership. Work in a culture that values ownership, frugality, speed, and impact. A clear growth path.

About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje (IIT Bombay CSE 2008) https://youtu.be/za0YpZxcWsA?si=7mQ6fn0pcy3sR-7z *About The Team* You’ll join Prodigal’s Consulting team. We partner with creditors in consumer finance (banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies) to transform how they engage with consumers using data-driven insights and AI-agents. The team sits at the intersection of product, data science, and client operations: designing strategy, building execution pipelines, and running experiments that deliver measurable lifts business operations. *The role* Most consulting ends with a recommendation. Here, that’s where your work starts. In this role, you own business outcomes for our clients. You get to the root of the problem, strategize & design the solution, put it into production and keep improving it until the numbers move. You’ll work with client CXOs, alongside our data science and engineering teams, and you’ll see the real impact of your work. *What you’ll do* Diagnose: Understand how a client’s business actually runs and find where the biggest opportunity lies. Strategize: Turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and solutions, using data and first-principles thinking. Deploy: Take solutions from idea to live execution, working with internal teams and client stakeholders. Drive results: Track performance, experiment, iterate and scale what works. Advise: Become a trusted advisor to client leadership on what’s best for their business. *What you get* End-to-end ownership from day one Direct exposure to CXOs at US enterprises Periodic travel to the US for client meetings and industry conferences A fast-track path to a Lead role, based on your performance and how quickly you learn *Who we’re looking for* Any discipline, with strong analytical ability A structured thinker who enjoys messy, ambiguous problems A clear communicator, comfortable with senior stakeholders High ownership, with a bias for getting things done Interested in consulting, strategy or how businesses really work Proficiency in Excel, Python, SQL, and Tableau/other BI tools is preferred *Mode of work - 5 days in office* *Evaluation Process :* Intro and communication (15 minutes) Problem/puzzle solving (30 minutes) Case study (60 minutes) Culture fit (20 minutes) *Job Benefits:* World-class team - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, YCP, Kearney, FSG, Nomura, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus. Continuous education - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab. Food at the office – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle. Health insurance - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family. Flexible schedule - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration. Unlimited leaves - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind. Recreation & team activities – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, cooking sessions and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)

Job Description
About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje (IIT Bombay CSE 2008) https://youtu.be/za0YpZxcWsA?si=7mQ6fn0pcy3sR-7z *About The Team* You’ll join Prodigal’s Consulting team. We partner with creditors in consumer finance (banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies) to transform how they engage with consumers using data-driven insights and AI-agents. The team sits at the intersection of product, data science, and client operations: designing strategy, building execution pipelines, and running experiments that deliver measurable lifts business operations. *The role* Most consulting ends with a recommendation. Here, that’s where your work starts. In this role, you own business outcomes for our clients. You get to the root of the problem, strategize & design the solution, put it into production and keep improving it until the numbers move. You’ll work with client CXOs, alongside our data science and engineering teams, and you’ll see the real impact of your work. *What you’ll do* Diagnose: Understand how a client’s business actually runs and find where the biggest opportunity lies. Strategize: Turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and solutions, using data and first-principles thinking. Deploy: Take solutions from idea to live execution, working with internal teams and client stakeholders. Drive results: Track performance, experiment, iterate and scale what works. Advise: Become a trusted advisor to client leadership on what’s best for their business. *What you get* End-to-end ownership from day one Direct exposure to CXOs at US enterprises Periodic travel to the US for client meetings and industry conferences A fast-track path to a Lead role, based on your performance and how quickly you learn *Who we’re looking for* Any discipline, with strong analytical ability A structured thinker who enjoys messy, ambiguous problems A clear communicator, comfortable with senior stakeholders High ownership, with a bias for getting things done Interested in consulting, strategy or how businesses really work Proficiency in Excel, Python, SQL, and Tableau/other BI tools is preferred *Mode of work - 5 days in office* *Evaluation Process :* Intro and communication (15 minutes) Problem/puzzle solving (30 minutes) Case study (60 minutes) Culture fit (20 minutes) *Job Benefits:* World-class team - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, YCP, Kearney, FSG, Nomura, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus. Continuous education - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab. Food at the office – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle. Health insurance - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family. Flexible schedule - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration. Unlimited leaves - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind. Recreation & team activities – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, cooking sessions and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)

About the company	Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 13 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences. Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials. What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach. In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures. With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

companies.description:
Route Mobile is seeking a Software Development Engineer 1 for our conversational AI engineering team to write, test, and ship code for a platform powering AI chatbots and voice agents for enterprise customers across WhatsApp and phone calls. In this role, you will build and maintain backend services and APIs, working across the stack with Python and Node.js on the backend, alongside frontend features in the web dashboard. Your responsibilities will span integrating third-party and customer APIs—such as the WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, and payment and telephony providers—writing unit tests, debugging production issues, and collaborating with product and solutioning teams to translate customer requirements into working features. Additionally, you will be expected to handle generalist business work to support broader team and company objectives. We are looking for candidates graduating in 2027 with a B.Tech, Dual Degree, or M.Tech in any branch who possess strong programming fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and either Python or JavaScript, with a strong interest in AI, LLMs, and conversational products being a major plus.

Job Description
Route Mobile is seeking a Software Development Engineer 1 for our conversational AI engineering team to write, test, and ship code for a platform powering AI chatbots and voice agents for enterprise customers across WhatsApp and phone calls. In this role, you will build and maintain backend services and APIs, working across the stack with Python and Node.js on the backend, alongside frontend features in the web dashboard. Your responsibilities will span integrating third-party and customer APIs—such as the WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, and payment and telephony providers—writing unit tests, debugging production issues, and collaborating with product and solutioning teams to translate customer requirements into working features. Additionally, you will be expected to handle generalist business work to support broader team and company objectives. We are looking for candidates graduating in 2027 with a B.Tech, Dual Degree, or M.Tech in any branch who possess strong programming fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and either Python or JavaScript, with a strong interest in AI, LLMs, and conversational products being a major plus.

Job Description
Route Mobile is seeking a Software Development Engineer 1 for our conversational AI engineering team to write, test, and ship code for a platform powering AI chatbots and voice agents for enterprise customers across WhatsApp and phone calls. In this role, you will build and maintain backend services and APIs, working across the stack with Python and Node.js on the backend, alongside frontend features in the web dashboard. Your responsibilities will span integrating third-party and customer APIs—such as the WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, and payment and telephony providers—writing unit tests, debugging production issues, and collaborating with product and solutioning teams to translate customer requirements into working features. Additionally, you will be expected to handle generalist business work to support broader team and company objectives. We are looking for candidates graduating in 2027 with a B.Tech, Dual Degree, or M.Tech in any branch who possess strong programming fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and either Python or JavaScript, with a strong interest in AI, LLMs, and conversational products being a major plus.

Over the last 20+ years, Searce has been a trusted technology partner for over 3,000 clients across Retail, TTL, Financial Services, Healthcare, and other industries. Driven by an engineering excellence mindset, Searce cares most about delivering intelligent, impactful & futuristic business outcomes. Specializing in modernizing clients' business processes, infrastructure, and applications (improving, automating & transforming) with the full scope of AI, data & analytics, cloud & software engineering expertise. As a proven Google Cloud Premier partner & AWS Advanced Consulting Firm, Searce understands the cloud landscape and has deep strategic relationships with both providers. At Searce, we solve for better at each iteration and focus on having customers for life and improving the lives of each customer.

companies.description:
SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited Engineer, R&D (Rnd-SysE-AppE-CSA-COE) The job profile has multiple tracks: 1. R&D track (candidate is involved in “proof of concepts” for new technology development) 2. Systems engineering track (candidate is product owners involved in designing products that go into production, especially for new product lines) 3. Applications engineering track (the role is like systems engineering, but more relevant for scaling existing product lines to high volumes) 4. Control systems architect track (candidate works on writing control-intensive software that goes into production) 5. Center of Excellence track (candidate focuses on engineering verticals such as FEA / CFD simulations) All tracks will follow a common selection procedure, including a common written test. Once selected, the candidate will be assigned one of the above tracks based on the candidate's interests and the candidate's performance in the written tests and interviews. About the job The candidate is expected to participate in building technologies and products for automotive & off-highway powertrains such that the built products and technologies are deployed in large numbers world-wide. S/he is expected build technology differentiators and/or well-engineered robust products and work with a cross functional team to execute the same. Major Responsibilities The candidate will work on creating technology differentiators and/or robust in domains such as engine controls, motor controls, battery technology, electric machines and inertial measurement systems. The candidate will also likely have to lead a team of engineers depending on the nature of problem statement / product line assigned to the candidate. Depending on the track the candidate is assigned when the candidate joins SEDEMAC, the candidate’s day-to-day job will be a suitable subset of the below activities: • Develop a first principles understanding of the physics behind systems being considered; examples of systems being electric machines, IMUs, buck-boost converters, flux sensors, parasitic inductances of PCBs etc. • Mathematically model the system; design and conduct experiments to validate the hypothesized mathematical model. • Develop "methods/ strategies / circuits" to control / observe the system for desirable behaviour / insights. Examples being strategies and/or circuits for engine lambda control, inertial navigation etc. • Develop proof-of-concept demonstration of methods / strategies / circuits developed, on prototype ECUs (Electronic Control Units) through coordination with cross functional teams (such as hardware & software). • Develop electronics circuits, verify them in simulation domain, build the hardware, and test the built hardware for functionality and endurance. • Perform high-fidelity simulations in the domains of thermal engineering, structural mechanics, electromagnetics such that design decisions are based on simulation results. • Develop control-intensive embedded software that runs in the electronic control units which are deployed in mass volumes by SEDEMAC. • Write white-papers to document the methods / strategies / circuits developed. Desired technical skills • Strong command over engineering physics and mathematics along with enthusiasm for potentially cross-domain ideas (mechanical, electrical etc.). • Skills in electronic instrumentation is desirable. • Experience with software development is desirable. • Experience with new product development is desirable. Desired soft skills • Good written and verbal communication skills. • Ability to work with a cross-functional team. • Professional attitude towards work. • Sense of ownership and urgency when working in the company. • Strong sense of ethics Education: • Bachelor's / Master's degree in Engineering with CGPA 6.0+ throughout (Specializations mentioned under eligibility criteria) Experience: • NA Job Location: • Pune (Baner) About SEDEMAC: At its core, SEDEMAC is the convergence of talented engineers committed to the development and large-scale deployment of innovative control technologies and products. As one of the fastest-growing Tier-1 suppliers in the automotive space, we work with vehicle, motor, and engine manufacturers who are leaders in their own space to deliver fundamental control solutions with real-world impact. Our engineer-led organization prides itself on creating technology propositions and taking them from the drawing board to high-volume production with operational excellence. We foster a culture that values creativity, honesty, and respect—where ideas are judged by their merit, not by hierarchy. With a strong foundation and ambitious growth plans, SEDEMAC is uniquely positioned to shape the future of controls. --------------------------------------------------------- SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited Engineer, Test Automation About the job “Engineer – Test Automation” is expected to design and develop “test systems” for enabling automated testing of electronic control units developed by SEDEMAC. The controllers to-be-tested are intended for applications such as engine controls, motor controls, battery management systems, automotive telematics devices etc. Major Responsibilities The candidate will primarily work on building test systems for testing of electronic control units designed within SEDEMAC during different stages of the product development life cycle (such as for integration-testing, end- of-line testing etc.). The candidate may also be required to build user-interface dashboards for performing activities such as calibration and debugging, to interface with the SEDEMAC’s ECUs; such user interfaces would typically be built on top of LabVIEW. The candidate may also be required to prepare rigs for experimental setups to enable physics-heavy experiments for supporting research activity ongoing at SEDEMAC. In the text that follows, the term “test-rig” refers to either “product test-rig”, “software dashboard” or “experimental setup”. The candidate will be required to • Gather requirements and develop a systematic understanding of the controller to-be-tested and understand the context in which the controller operates. • Design the test-rig based on gathered requirements, while having design ownership of different aspects of the test-rig development activity, including software, mechanical, electronics. • Perform the “project manager” role for test-rig development activity, including planning delivery of the test-rig with pre-determined timelines, keep internal/external customers informed of the test-rig development state, and de-risking uncertainties during the development activity. • Prepare and document operation manuals, design architecture and learnings for the test-rigs developed. Also prepare validation-plan, maintenance-plan, periodic-calibration-plan for qualifying the test rigs developed. • Deploy the test rig and provide suitable training and support to end-users during the operating life of the test-rig. • Proactively identify new projects which can benefit from test-automation activity and prepare proof-of- concept to demonstrate its utility. Technical Skills & Experience • LabVIEW experience is desirable. • Comfort with tools such as MATLAB, Python. • Good understanding of concepts of electronic, and operational familiarity with instruments such as oscilloscope, DC load bank, programmable power supply etc. • Comfort with engineering physics and mathematics along with enthusiasm for potentially cross- domain ideas (mechanical, electrical etc.). Desired Soft skills • Good written and verbal communication skills. • Ability to work with a cross-functional team. • Professional attitude towards work. • Sense of ownership and urgency when working in the company. • Strong sense of ethics Education: • Bachelor's / Master's degree in Engineering with CGPA 6.0+ throughout (Specializations mentioned under eligibility criteria) Experience: • NA Information on Selection Process • The selection process will be multi-phased tests plus interviews • There will be a focus on evaluating the candidate’s understanding of subject matter, expertise in leading hardware product development, project management, communication skills, analytical & logical skills Job Location: • Pune (Baner) About SEDEMAC: At its core, SEDEMAC is the convergence of talented engineers committed to the development and large- scale deployment of innovative control technologies and products. As one of the fastest-growing Tier-1 suppliers in the automotive space, we work with vehicle, motor, and engine manufacturers who are leaders in their own space to deliver fundamental control solutions with real-world impact. Our engineer-led organization prides itself on creating technology propositions and taking them from the drawing board to high-volume production with operational excellence. We foster a culture that values creativity, honesty, and respect—where ideas are judged by their merit, not by hierarchy. With a strong foundation and ambitious growth plans, SEDEMAC is uniquely positioned to shape the future of controls.

SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited Engineer, R&D (Rnd-SysE-AppE-CSA-COE) The job profile has multiple tracks: 1. R&D track (candidate is involved in “proof of concepts” for new technology development) 2. Systems engineering track (candidate is product owners involved in designing products that go into production, especially for new product lines) 3. Applications engineering track (the role is like systems engineering, but more relevant for scaling existing product lines to high volumes) 4. Control systems architect track (candidate works on writing control-intensive software that goes into production) 5. Center of Excellence track (candidate focuses on engineering verticals such as FEA / CFD simulations) All tracks will follow a common selection procedure, including a common written test. Once selected, the candidate will be assigned one of the above tracks based on the candidate's interests and the candidate's performance in the written tests and interviews. About the job The candidate is expected to participate in building technologies and products for automotive & off-highway powertrains such that the built products and technologies are deployed in large numbers world-wide. S/he is expected build technology differentiators and/or well-engineered robust products and work with a cross functional team to execute the same. Major Responsibilities The candidate will work on creating technology differentiators and/or robust in domains such as engine controls, motor controls, battery technology, electric machines and inertial measurement systems. The candidate will also likely have to lead a team of engineers depending on the nature of problem statement / product line assigned to the candidate. Depending on the track the candidate is assigned when the candidate joins SEDEMAC, the candidate’s day-to-day job will be a suitable subset of the below activities: • Develop a first principles understanding of the physics behind systems being considered; examples of systems being electric machines, IMUs, buck-boost converters, flux sensors, parasitic inductances of PCBs etc. • Mathematically model the system; design and conduct experiments to validate the hypothesized mathematical model. • Develop "methods/ strategies / circuits" to control / observe the system for desirable behaviour / insights. Examples being strategies and/or circuits for engine lambda control, inertial navigation etc. • Develop proof-of-concept demonstration of methods / strategies / circuits developed, on prototype ECUs (Electronic Control Units) through coordination with cross functional teams (such as hardware & software). • Develop electronics circuits, verify them in simulation domain, build the hardware, and test the built hardware for functionality and endurance. • Perform high-fidelity simulations in the domains of thermal engineering, structural mechanics, electromagnetics such that design decisions are based on simulation results. • Develop control-intensive embedded software that runs in the electronic control units which are deployed in mass volumes by SEDEMAC. • Write white-papers to document the methods / strategies / circuits developed. Desired technical skills • Strong command over engineering physics and mathematics along with enthusiasm for potentially cross-domain ideas (mechanical, electrical etc.). • Skills in electronic instrumentation is desirable. • Experience with software development is desirable. • Experience with new product development is desirable. The controllers to-be-tested are intended for applications such as engine controls, motor controls, battery management systems, automotive telematics devices etc. Major Responsibilities The candidate will primarily work on building test systems for testing of electronic control units designed within SEDEMAC during different stages of the product development life cycle (such as for integration-testing, end- of-line testing etc.). The candidate may also be required to build user-interface dashboards for performing activities such as calibration and debugging, to interface with the SEDEMAC’s ECUs; such user interfaces would typically be built on top of LabVIEW. The candidate may also be required to prepare rigs for experimental setups to enable physics-heavy experiments for supporting research activity ongoing at SEDEMAC. In the text that follows, the term “test-rig” refers to either “product test-rig”, “software dashboard” or “experimental setup”. The candidate will be required to • Gather requirements and develop a systematic understanding of the controller to-be-tested and understand the context in which the controller operates. • Design the test-rig based on gathered requirements, while having design ownership of different aspects of the test-rig development activity, including software, mechanical, electronics. • Perform the “project manager” role for test-rig development activity, including planning delivery of the test-rig with pre-determined timelines, keep internal/external customers informed of the test-rig development state, and de-risking uncertainties during the development activity. • Prepare and document operation manuals, design architecture and learnings for the test-rigs developed. Also prepare validation-plan, maintenance-plan, periodic-calibration-plan for qualifying the test rigs developed. • Deploy the test rig and provide suitable training and support to end-users during the operating life of the test-rig. • Proactively identify new projects which can benefit from test-automation activity and prepare proof-of- concept to demonstrate its utility. SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering About the Job: SEDEMAC is expanding its manufacturing engineering capabilities to support advanced mechatronic products such as gearboxes and electric motors. As “Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering”, you will join a team that is actively shaping and strengthening SEDEMAC’s manufacturing engineering practices. This is an exciting opportunity for sharp and enthusiastic engineers who want to learn how designs become manufacturable products at scale. You don’t need prior production know-how—we will guide you. What matters most is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to build expertise in manufacturing domain. Major Responsibilities: • Support new product development by helping prototypes transition smoothly into production-ready products. • Learn and contribute to Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) reviews, while assisting in the preparation of process documents such as flow charts, work instructions, and quality checklists. • Collaborate with suppliers and production teams during trial runs, tooling validations, and fixture development to ensure robust manufacturing processes. • Audit supplier processes and help define detailed production steps covering fabrication, inspection, and assembly. • Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of production issues, support implementation of corrective actions, and contribute fresh ideas for improvement. • Engage in continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, cost, and efficiency, applying structured methods like statistical analysis to monitor and optimize processes. • Contribute to reliability engineering by analyzing failure modes, recommending design/process improvements, and ensuring products meet lifecycle and durability requirements. • Work with design and quality teams to perform reliability assessments and implement preventive measures for long-term product performance. • Assist in the development and improvement of manufacturing test setups, including end-of-line testers, to ensure every product shipped meets performance and quality standards. • Capture and document lessons learned to strengthen SEDEMAC’s manufacturing know-how and develop internal best practices. Desired Technical Skills: • Strong fundamentals in Physics, Mathematics, and Mechanical/Electro-Mechanical concepts. • Exposure to common manufacturing processes such as casting, machining, moulding, sheet metal, and assembly. • Ability to interpret engineering drawings; familiarity with GD&T is desirable. • Comfort with CAD tools (Creo or equivalent) and proficiency in Excel; exposure to Python scripting is an advantage. • Awareness of product development and quality frameworks (PPAP, APQP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA) through academics or projects is a plus. • Familiarity with quality and problem-solving tools (5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto) and basic Lean/Six Sigma practices (Kaizen, 5S) is a plus. Desired Soft Skills: • Strong analytical ability to find root causes and propose practical solutions. • Clear, concise communication with design, production, and supplier teams. • Proactive and self-driven, eager to learn and improve manufacturing practices. • Ability to balance quality, cost, and delivery timelines in decision-making. • Professional work ethic with a sense of ownership and accountability. With a strong foundation and ambitious growth plans, SEDEMAC is uniquely positioned to shape the future of controls. Job Location Pune

companies.description:
About the team Be it huge, medium, small, tiny, micro - every decision falls under the eyes of our Analytics team. Every analysis and insight drawn by the Analytics team directly impacts our business without fail and that's why the team is full of people who make sure the impact’s legen - wait for it - dary - Legendary. If digging into numbers and unlocking insights sounds like your kind of fun, you’ll fit right in. About the role As an Analyst at slice, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Product, Growth, Credit, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you. What You will do You'll start with first principles thinking - breaking down problems to their core, using data and analytical reasoning to uncover insights that really move the needle for the business and create a better experience for our customers. You'll get hands-on across the analytics spectrum: Descriptive – building clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards Diagnostic – digging into the why behind trends and performance Prescriptive – turning insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions You’ll work side-by-side with functional leaders and business partners across teams like Growth, Retention, Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing Fraud, and Ops, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving. And most importantly, you’ll turn complex data into simple, actionable stories - crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale. What you will need Hustle + Heart: You’ve got the drive to build data solutions that touch millions of lives and the curiosity to keep asking “what’s next?” You speak data fluently: Advanced SQL is your second language, and you’re comfortable in Python, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it. Problem-solving at your core: You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces - and crafting smart, scalable solutions. Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About us slice the way you bank slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

Job Description
About the team Be it huge, medium, small, tiny, micro - every decision falls under the eyes of our Analytics team. Every analysis and insight drawn by the Analytics team directly impacts our business without fail and that's why the team is full of people who make sure the impact’s legen - wait for it - dary - Legendary. If digging into numbers and unlocking insights sounds like your kind of fun, you’ll fit right in. About the role As an Analyst at slice, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Product, Growth, Credit, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you. What You will do You'll start with first principles thinking - breaking down problems to their core, using data and analytical reasoning to uncover insights that really move the needle for the business and create a better experience for our customers. You'll get hands-on across the analytics spectrum: Descriptive – building clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards Diagnostic – digging into the why behind trends and performance Prescriptive – turning insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions You’ll work side-by-side with functional leaders and business partners across teams like Growth, Retention, Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing Fraud, and Ops, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving. And most importantly, you’ll turn complex data into simple, actionable stories - crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale. What you will need Hustle + Heart: You’ve got the drive to build data solutions that touch millions of lives and the curiosity to keep asking “what’s next?” You speak data fluently: Advanced SQL is your second language, and you’re comfortable in Python, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it. Problem-solving at your core: You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces - and crafting smart, scalable solutions. Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About us slice the way you bank slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

Job Description
About the team: Are you fascinated with building a problem-solving, customer-facing, intuitive, creative tech-products that adds value to their life? Well, if you’ve landed on this page, your answer is most-likely YES. Visionary, cynical, upskilling - a few adjectives to describe our Product team. If you feel the vibe, step 1 is done. About the role: As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of product, analytics, and execution. You’ll help break down real-world payment problems, turn data into insights, and support the building of simple, intuitive experiences used by millions of young Indians. This role is perfect if you’re excited about learning product craft, using data to guide decisions, and shipping features that create visible impact. What You will do: - Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer problems, business goals, and stakeholder requirements - Turn raw data into sharp insights that shape what gets built next - Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with data, metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL/Excel. - Help write the requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that turn ideas into shipped features - Bring structure to roadmap conversations, blending gut instinct with hard numbers - Work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and analytics to take features from whiteboard to millions of screens - Own the post-launch story - track what worked, what didn't, and why, then use that to make the next version sharper - Develop a deep understanding of how users interact with slice products and where we can make experiences simpler and better What you will need: - Strong first-principles and structured problem-solving ability - you'd rather break a problem down from scratch than reach for a template - Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply - High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding - Prior internship experience in product management, analytics, consulting, or related roles is a plus - Genuine curiosity about how India spends, saves, and borrows Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: - Competitive salaries. Period. - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. - Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About slice: slice A new bank for a new India slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

companies.description:
We are looking for highly motivated graduates or early career professionals with an interest in finance and a background in computer science, engineering, mathematics or other STEM degrees to join our Desk Quant Analyst three-year program. You will spend these three years working in close collaboration with experienced Quantitative Researchers and Traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. | Overview of Desk Quant Analyst Position: • Maintain and upgrade the codebase and configuration of strategies within the firm’s automated trading framework. • Manage large datasets used in both research and production environments. • Perform live as well as historical monitoring of trading activities. For instance, do some post-trade analysis or production reconciliation. • Work in close collaboration with quant researchers and traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. Typical Day of Desk Quant Analyst • Before market open, check that all required data and related processes are ready for the trading day. • During market hours, sporadically monitor behavior and performance of strategies. • Work on various longer-term projects required for expanding our systematic trading activities and ensuring their robustness.

companies.description:
We’re looking for Graduates to kick-start their career in technology with us. We want to invite smart, self-driven, inquisitive people with a strong quantitative or engineering mindset to join us. At Squarepoint, you will work alongside Senior Technologists, in small groups, to design and build the next generation of production grade trading & research software, systems, and infrastructure. Join one of Squarepoint's technology tracks and align your interests to ours. Select the track that best fits your career goals, qualifications, and experience. | Squarepoint Capital is seeking smart, self-driven and inquisitive individuals who want an opportunity to apply their advanced skills and knowledge in a challenging and innovative environment. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, in small groups, to design and build the next generation of production grade trading and research software systems. Step into a career of continuous learning and development, surrounded by some of the most talented individuals in the industry, and grow your skills in a highly collegiate work environment. When applying, you can indicate your preference for one or more of the following tracks. We will however work to ensure your role at Squarepoint is best suited to your skillset. Python Development: Applications, services, and data driven systems: Projects within this track focus on developing and maintaining scalable services, full-stack web applications, and data processing algorithms, tools, and frameworks. • Build and maintain the core tooling, libraries, and frameworks we use for developing applications at Squarepoint, • Manage the software development lifecycle of libraries and frameworks used globally by our teams of technologists, • Contribute to data driven applications, pipelines, and systems used to feed predictive models in research and trading, • Build software products used worldwide by traders, researchers, data scientists, and other teams at Squarepoint to fuel our trading success. C++ Development: Distributed, low latency, high performance systems: Projects within this track focus on developing and maintaining performance sensitive, reliable and scalable back-ends which are critical to our trading infrastructure. • Work on high performance, low-latency systems powering critical trading operations, • Drive the design and implementation of trading frameworks, market data solutions and global market connectivity, • Build massively parallel, high-volume, distributed applications to enable our technology to scale as we grow, • Create distributed frameworks, tools, and platforms which process massive volumes of data and underpin the stack used by other technology teams.

companies.description:
Sun Valley Investment Group, through Sun Valley Resources Private Limited, is hiring Researchers to support the Group’s gold, critical metals and natural resources portfolio. The role will involve industry and technical research across mining, geology, metallurgy and mineral processing, with responsibilities including technical due diligence, resource and reserve analysis, mine and project research, metallurgical studies, process plant performance analysis, market and industry intelligence, project evaluation, data analytics, and AI-driven research. Researchers will work closely with the Group’s technical, investment and project teams to support data-driven decision-making, prepare research reports and presentations, and coordinate with operations, consultants and project partners. The initial posting will be in India, with opportunities to travel to project and plant sites as required. Based on performance, expertise and business requirements, Researchers may be offered international assignments and exposure at Group operations and projects, including Mineros S.A. in Colombia and Nicaragua, Canagold Resources in Canada, and other Sun Valley Investment Group projects.

Job Profile

Form Type	Designation	Cost to Company per year	Bond / Service Contract	Additional Criteria	CGPA Cut-off
PLACEMENT	Research Analyst	2000000 INR			6.5

Job Description
Sun Valley Investment Group, through Sun Valley Resources Private Limited, is hiring Researchers to support the Group’s gold, critical metals and natural resources portfolio. The role will involve industry and technical research across mining, geology, metallurgy and mineral processing, with responsibilities including technical due diligence, resource and reserve analysis, mine and project research, metallurgical studies, process plant performance analysis, market and industry intelligence, project evaluation, data analytics, and AI-driven research. Researchers will work closely with the Group’s technical, investment and project teams to support data-driven decision-making, prepare research reports and presentations, and coordinate with operations, consultants and project partners. The initial posting will be in India, with opportunities to travel to project and plant sites as required. Based on performance, expertise and business requirements, Researchers may be offered international assignments and exposure at Group operations and projects, including Mineros S.A. in Colombia and Nicaragua, Canagold Resources in Canada, and other Sun Valley Investment Group projects.

About the company	Sun Valley Investment is a global private investment group focused on the precious and critical metals mining industry (gold, silver, antimony). The Group finances the full value chain – mineral exploration, mine construction, production, processing and refining – with operations in Latin America and Canada and offices in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. Its portfolio includes Mineros S.A. (Colombia, Nicaragua) and Canagold Resources (Canada), with a workforce of 3,500+ including mining operations. In India the Group operates through Sun Valley Resources Private Limited. Managing Partner Mr. Vikram Sodhi has funded the Vikram Sodhi Centre of Excellence for AI in Mining at IIT Kharagpur.

PLACEMENT	Research Analyst	2000000 INR
Job Description
Sun Valley Investment Group, through Sun Valley Resources Private Limited, is hiring Researchers to support the Group’s gold, critical metals and natural resources portfolio. The role will involve industry and technical research across mining, geology, metallurgy and mineral processing, with responsibilities including technical due diligence, resource and reserve analysis, mine and project research, metallurgical studies, process plant performance analysis, market and industry intelligence, project evaluation, data analytics, and AI-driven research. Researchers will work closely with the Group’s technical, investment and project teams to support data-driven decision-making, prepare research reports and presentations, and coordinate with operations, consultants and project partners. The initial posting will be in India, with opportunities to travel to project and plant sites as required. Based on performance, expertise and business requirements, Researchers may be offered international assignments and exposure at Group operations and projects, including Mineros S.A. in Colombia and Nicaragua, Canagold Resources in Canada, and other Sun Valley Investment Group projects.

Job Description About the Business Telus Digital AI Data Solutions (TI AI) has been a trailblazer in data services since 2005, recently debuting on the NYSE on February 21 . TI AI is known for delivering high-quality datasets critical for training and validating machine learning models—especially in the field of computer vision. Our in-house labeling platform, GT Studio, powers a wide array of data solutions across industries, with a special focus on autonomous vehicles and emerging computer vision use cases. As we continue to grow, our mission remains the same: to provide cutting-edge, reliable datasets that help AI teams around the world build better, safer, and more effective models. About the Team The Telus Digital AI team partners closely with clients to define data annotation and collection strategies, ensuring successful delivery through expert consulting and execution. Our Technical Project Management team sits at the center of this process, supporting post-sales execution and serving as the bridge between client needs and technical delivery. Overview We are seeking an experienced Associate Project Manager with a strong interest in AI and computer vision to lead data annotation and labeling projects for enterprise clients. This role involves managing multiple initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery across AI/ML programs. The ideal candidate brings solid project management skills, an understanding of technical workflows, and a passion for delivering impactful results in a fast-moving tech environment. Key Responsibilities Serve as the main point of contact for clients post-sale, translating project goals into clear action plans. Lead the planning and delivery of AI/ML projects—especially those focused on computer vision and data annotation. Collaborate with solution engineers, data specialists, and QA teams to manage both automated and manual labeling workflows. Monitor project performance, identify risks, and drive resolution of issues to keep initiatives on track. Coordinate resource planning, reporting, and timeline tracking using industry-standard tools and practices. Partner with internal teams (engineering, R&D, and product) to communicate client feedback and align on project goals. Contribute to process improvements and best practice documentation to enhance delivery efficiency and consistency. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field (STEM preferred) project management experience, ideally in AI /ML, software engineering, or data-driven environment. Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, computer vision, or data annotation workflows is a plus. Experience working with cross-functional teams in dynamic, client-facing roles. Comfort with tools such as Monday.com, Clickup, JIRA, Trello, Asana, or similar project management platforms. A proactive mindset, collaborative spirit, and desire to grow within a high-tech, fast-evolving space. Willingness to travel occasionally, if required. Why Join Us? At TI AI, you’ll work with industry leaders shaping the future of AI-powered solutions. You’ll gain exposure to cutting-edge projects, play a key role in delivering high-impact work, and grow your career in one of the most exciting fields in tech.
